name: Gold Cloth
description: One of the twelve Gold Cloths, forged for a constellation and worn by its Saint. It answers to you and to no one else. You can summon or dismiss the Cloth with a single Interact action. While dismissed it is not on your person and cannot be taken from you. It cannot be removed from you against your will by any means short of destroying it, and it accepts armor runes normally. If you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Cloth cracks: it stops providing its item bonus to AC until repaired. It self-repairs after 24 hours, or instantly in the hands of a Saint of Aries. Granted by The Cloth
icon_brief: A Gold Cloth assembled in its object form: a gleaming golden statue of a zodiac figure on a pedestal, radiating hard white-gold light against a dark starfield, the twelve zodiac glyphs ringed faintly around it.

name: Saint
description: A Gold Saint stands in the attack, wearing gold, and punches a god. Eleven days out of thirteen you are an excellent but not dominant martial. On the thirteenth — the day your own constellation rises — the Cloth burns and you become something else. And on one day in a hundred and thirty, the sky exalts you, and for that day you are very nearly unstoppable. You are not a spellcaster. Your power is your own inner cosmo; the sky only wakes it. Key Ability Strength or Dexterity. Your Cosmo DC uses whichever you chose. Hit Points 10 plus your Constitution modifier The Three-Tier Curve Sky state You are Effect Frequency Normal day ~15% weaker than a comparable martial baseline ~11 days in 13 Ascendant ~30% stronger Techniques heighten as if +4 levels 1 day in 13 Zenith ~100% stronger Techniques heighten as if +8 levels 1 day in 130 The −15% floor lives in the Strike line: the fist is 1d6 and there is no flurry. The +30% / +100% lives in the Techniques and the boons. Defensive and control Cloths pay their multiplier in scope rather than dice — their flat damage line is correct by design. Techniques Techniques have no rank . You gain four, at levels 1, 6, 11, and 16 , and each heightens once per 2 character levels above the level it was gained. All four converge on 20d6 / 10d8 by 20th level, so an early Technique never becomes dead weight — later slots buy new shapes , not bigger numbers. Spell-attack Techniques get no potency runes , so a Technique's attack bonus is 2 lower than your Strike. Say this at the table. Proficiencies At 1st level: Perception trained; Fortitude and Reflex expert, Will trained; Athletics plus three other skills trained; unarmed attacks trained (no weapon proficiency); unarmored defense and light and medium armor trained; Cosmo DC trained.
icon_brief: A single golden fist punching upward into a dark sky, a blaze of gold cosmo trailing from it, and one constellation flaring bright above among twelve dim ones.

name: Adapt
description: Frequency once per round Trigger You would be damaged by an effect you have already adapted to. You heighten your adaptation. Until the start of your next turn, your resistance to that effect increases to twice your level , and if the effect required a save, you improve your degree of success by one step. Granted by the Not by the Same Attack feat.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — 'the same technique never works twice on a Saint'
icon_brief: An incoming energy blast splitting harmlessly around a golden open palm, its shards fanning away; a faint glowing copy of that same blast already etched in the palm like a learned pattern.

name: Arayashiki
description: Frequency once per day Trigger You are reduced to 0 Hit Points or killed. You keep acting for 1 minute or until the encounter ends. You cannot drop below 1 Hit Point; you are immune to death effects and to the dying, unconscious, and paralyzed conditions; and you ignore the wounded and drained conditions. When it ends you are dying 3 and your Cloth shatters. If the trigger killed you, you die when the minute ends , beyond the reach of anything short of wish -tier return. You may end Arayashiki early. If you do, you are merely dying 1 and your Cloth is intact. Granted by Eighth Sense (Arayashiki)
icon_brief: A golden spark of consciousness rising out of a dark abyss, a vertical rift of pale lotus-light opening between life and death; drifting gray soul-wisps below, the spark climbing upward untouched.

name: Athena's Temper
description: The last rung of the Arms Advance, gained at 19th level. Frequency once per day Every Libra weapon gains a fifth damage die , past the game's own cap — that part is permanent — and one property rune of your choice , re-chosen each morning. This action is that choice. The rune applies to all twelve weapons at once and lasts until you choose again tomorrow. A property rune you bought and etched yourself is untouched; only the one Athena's Temper granted last is replaced. Granted by Libra — the Weapons at 19th level.
icon_brief: Six pairs of golden weapons — swords, tridents, three-section staffs, nunchaku, tonfa, round shields — arranged in a radiating wheel, each tempered to white-hot glowing edges as if fresh from the forge, rune sparks rising.

name: Attuned Casting
description: Frequency once per day You cast a Technique of 2 actions or fewer without spending a Focus Point . Granted by Cloth Attunement
icon_brief: A small golden technique-sigil igniting from a fingertip with no flame of cost: a constellation glyph lighting itself, a tiny closed circuit of gold light looping back into the hand.

name: Aurora Execution
description: Frequency once per minute 60-foot line. Each creature takes 16d6[cold] damage with a basic Fortitude save. A creature that critically fails is frozen solid — petrified, and shatterable by any critical hit. Incapacitation. Granted by the Aquarius Zenith Boon.
icon_brief: Two gauntleted hands clasped together high overhead in the shape of a water jar, a torrent of absolute-zero cold pouring down in a straight beam, ribboned with green and violet aurora light.

name: Bloody Rose
description: Frequency once per minute 60 feet, one creature. Fortitude save. Failure 10d6[poison] damage and enfeebled 2. Critical Failure It dies . Incapacitation. Granted by the Pisces Zenith Boon.
icon_brief: A single pure-white rose flying stem-first like a dart, its petals turning crimson from the base upward as it drinks blood; a thin red trail behind it.

name: Burn Your Cosmo
description: Frequency once per day Requirements Your constellation is ascendant today. You force the sky's hand. Treat today as Exalted : your Zenith Boon activates for 1 minute. If the day is already Exalted, instead extend your Zenith Boon to all allies within 30 feet for 1 minute. Granted by Seventh Sense. Apply your Cloth's Sky: Zenith effect alongside this one for the duration, or use the sky tracker's Schedule Zenith control.
icon_brief: A golden aura erupting skyward like a pillar of fire from a clenched fist, the wearer's constellation blazing white at its peak, embers of gold stars swirling around.

name: Dimension Step
description: You teleport up to 60 feet to a space you can see. Granted by the Aries Ascendant and Zenith Boons.
icon_brief: Two matching circles of shimmering lavender-gold starlight, one fading and one forming a short distance away, a faint stream of stardust arcing between them.

name: Dissolve
description: Frequency once per 10 minutes You touch one unattended object of up to 10 Bulk, or a 10-foot cube of a structure. It is destroyed , its atoms parted and scattered as a fine glittering dust. This cannot destroy artifacts, Cloths, or objects of similar significance. Against a creature's attended object, that creature may attempt a Reflex save against your Cosmo DC to pull it clear. On any day your constellation is ascendant or Exalted, this has no frequency limit and its size limit increases to 40 Bulk or a 20-foot cube. Granted by the Atomic Dissolution feat.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Camus: freezing is stilling the atoms
icon_brief: A golden fingertip touching a stone block that is breaking apart into a cloud of fine glittering dust, cubes dissolving into sparkling motes from the point of contact.

name: Golden Arrow: Named Shot
description: Frequency once per minute Any creature you can name within a mile, through any barrier short of a planar boundary. It takes @Golden Arrow's damage, plus an additional 8 dice. Automation note: Foundry has no way to target a creature purely by name, off the current scene or otherwise undetected — this reaches anyone on the viewed scene within range, ignoring line of effect, which is the mechanical half of the Boon. Naming a creature elsewhere on the map is the GM's call. Granted by the Sagittarius Zenith Boon.
icon_brief: A golden arrow in flight crossing an enormous distance, passing straight through a stone wall that ripples like water around it; a lone target-sigil glowing on the horizon.

name: Om
description: Shaka fights with his eyes closed and opens them only when he intends to end things. You close your eyes. Using this action applies Effect: Om, which is what blinds you and what holds the count. While they are closed you are blinded — fully, with all that entails — but you gain one Om stack at the end of each of your turns, to a maximum of 5 (7 on a day Virgo is ascendant). While you have at least 1 stack you gain a +1 status bonus per stack to your Technique DCs and to unarmed Strike damage. From 7th level your Sixth Sense functions as a precise sense out to 30 feet, letting you fight blind. The cost is real and the sheet enforces it — the class guide is explicit that the table should not wave it away. To spend the stacks, use Open Your Eyes.
icon_brief: A pair of serenely closed eyes drawn as two gold arcs, the Sanskrit ॐ glowing between them, cosmo pooling and building like still water behind the lids.

name: Open Your Eyes
description: You open your eyes, and whatever you have been holding goes out all at once. Using this action flips Eyes Open on Effect: Om. Your blindness lifts immediately, and the next Technique you cast or unarmed Strike you make before the end of this turn is empowered: +2 damage dice per stack spent, and a −1 circumstance penalty per 2 stacks spent to any saving throw it allows. The effect stays on you until you have taken that roll, because the dice the stacks are worth are added by rule elements that read the toggle — spending earlier would empower nothing. Once the roll is taken the effect is deleted for you; anything unspent lapses at the end of your turn. Your eyes also open automatically, spending nothing, if you are knocked unconscious. The save penalty is applied as an equal bonus to your Technique DC — the same number from the side Foundry can actually roll.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Shaka opening his eyes
icon_brief: Two eyes snapping open, pure white-gold light bursting out of them in twin beams; a lotus mandala shattering outward from the force.

name: Place a Scarlet Needle
description: Trigger You hit a creature with an unarmed Strike. You add one needle to that creature, to a maximum of 15. Target it before you use this action; the needle lands on whoever you have targeted. At 5 needles it is enfeebled 1. At 10 it is blinded. At 14 it is stunned 2 and its Strikes lose all runes. All three happen by themselves, once each, as the count passes them — see Effect: Scarlet Needle, which is where the count lives. Granted by Scorpio — the Needle. Needles are counted on each creature separately and last until the encounter ends.
icon_brief: A single long crimson fingernail extended from a golden gauntlet, a tiny red star of light at its tip, with a thin streak of red where it has just struck.

name: Rozan Hyaku Ryū Ha
description: Frequency once per round 60-foot line. Each creature takes 12d10[bludgeoning] damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature that critically fails is knocked prone and stunned 2. Granted by the Libra Zenith Boon.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Rozan Hyaku Ryū Ha
icon_brief: A hundred green-and-gold Chinese dragons of cosmo surging upward in a dense braided torrent from a single fist, a waterfall in mist behind them.

name: Sever
description: Frequency once per turn Trigger A creature attacks you, or a spell effect enters your space. You sever it. The attack or effect has no effect. Automation note: Foundry has no hook that lets a third party void an attack or a spell already in motion — the same limit that keeps Taurus' Titan's Stance from retargeting an incoming attack. This action exists so the frequency is real and a click records that it happened; what "no effect" undoes is the table's call. The guide's "once per turn per creature" is a per-creature limit pf2e's own frequency tracking cannot express, so this enforces once per turn, flat. Granted by the Capricorn Zenith Boon.
icon_brief: A golden knife-hand slicing through the air, a blade-thin line of white light cutting an oncoming fireball cleanly in two, the halves dissipating.

name: Six Realms Unmade
description: Frequency once per minute 60-foot emanation. Each enemy must attempt a Will save against your Cosmo DC or lose all five senses for 1 minute: blinded, deafened, and the loss of smell, taste and touch. Critical Failure The loss lasts until the creature receives restoration — the four effects are applied with no duration, so nothing takes them off on a timer. Incapacitation. Granted by the Virgo Zenith Boon.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Shaka's Rikudō / Tenbu Hōrin
icon_brief: A six-spoked wheel of golden light spinning in a dark void, each spoke a different realm; the five senses shown as eye, ear, nose, tongue and hand symbols fading to ash around it.

name: Star Guard
description: Trigger A creature within 60 feet makes a ranged or spell attack, or targets an ally with a spell. You send the effect nowhere . It is expended with no result. Ascendant: once per round. Zenith: no frequency limit, and once per minute you may instead target a creature within 60 feet — Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC, and on a critical failure it is teleported one mile away ( incapacitation ). Granted by the Aries Ascendant and Zenith Boons.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Mu's Crystal Wall / dimension
icon_brief: An incoming magic bolt striking a pane of faint violet starlight and vanishing into it as if into deep space, leaving only scattered star specks.

name: Star Guard: Exile
description: Trigger A creature within 60 feet makes a ranged or spell attack, or targets an ally with a spell. Instead of sending the effect nowhere, you send the creature . It attempts a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC; on a critical failure it is teleported one mile away. The module moves the token along the line from you to it, as far as the scene allows, and reports the distance actually travelled. Granted by the Aries Zenith Boon only. Once per minute.
icon_brief: A swirling spiral of stars opening like a whirlpool in the night sky, a dark silhouette being pulled into it and vanishing in sparkles.

name: Summon an Arm
description: You call one of the Cloth's six Arms into your hands, or send it back. An Arm is a matched pair , and it always arrives as both weapons at once, one in each hand — there is no half of an Arm to hold. Summoning one therefore dismisses whichever Arm you were holding, and you gain the new pair's Art in place of the old one. On a day your constellation is Ascendant , The Balance lets you keep one weapon from each of two different Arms and gain both their Arts, so the Arm you were holding is left where it is; on a Zenith the Cloth holds what your hands cannot and nothing is ever set down. Libra weapons can never be disarmed, sundered, or destroyed. They are set down rather than unmade, so any property rune you have etched onto one is still there when you call it back. Granted by Libra — the Weapons. Using this whispers you a card of the six Arms; picking one arms you.
icon_brief: A pair of matching golden weapons materializing from twin beams of light descending into two open hands, with the Libra scales glyph ♎ glowing above.

name: Summon or Dismiss Cloth
description: Your Gold Cloth answers instantly. You summon your Cloth onto your body, or dismiss it. While dismissed it is not on your person and cannot be taken from you. The Cloth cannot be removed from you against your will by any means short of destroying it. Granted by The Cloth
icon_brief: A golden Cloth disassembling into separate glowing armor pieces flying through the air toward an empty silhouette, each trailing a streak of light, the opened Pandora Box below.

name: Swap Aspect
description: Frequency once per hour You change between your Light and Shadow aspects. Your appearance, voice, and aura change completely; nothing short of true seeing connects the two. In Shadow, your 1st Technique becomes a single-target confuse effect (Will save, confused 1 round on a failure) instead of its usual effect. Granted by Gemini — the Other Dimension. Using this action flips the Two Faces toggle for you, so every predicate that reads your aspect follows without anything further to remember.
icon_brief: A single golden mask split vertically down the middle: one half serene and lit in white light, the other half snarling and shrouded in black-violet shadow.

name: The Yellow Spring Is Here
description: Frequency once per Zenith day 30-foot emanation. Every enemy at half Hit Points or fewer must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or die . Incapacitation. Granted by the Cancer Zenith Boon.
icon_brief: A wide ring of blue will-o'-wisp fire spreading across the ground, and from it pale soul-wisps tearing free of fallen bodies and drifting toward a gaping pit on a gray hillside.

name: The Yellow Spring Opens
description: Frequency once per round A creature within 30 feet at half Hit Points or fewer must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or take 8d6[void] damage and be slowed 1. Granted by the Cancer Ascendant Boon. While that boon is active, any creature you reduce to 0 Hit Points also dies with no save.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Deathmask's Sekishiki Meikai Ha
icon_brief: A single finger pointing upward, a pale blue soul being pulled out of a wounded figure in a thin stream of ghostly light toward a dark yawning crack in the ground.

name: Vow's Answer
description: Frequency once per round Trigger The target of your Vow would be reduced to 0 Hit Points while within 30 feet of you. You Stride up to your Speed toward them. If this brings them within your reach, they remain at 1 Hit Point instead. A given ally can be saved this way only once per hour. Granted by the Saint's Vow feat.
icon_brief: A golden streak of motion crossing the gap to catch a falling ally, a glowing oath-ribbon of light linking the two, the ally's falling silhouette frozen at the brink.

name: Armor Expertise
description: Wearing your Cloth has become as natural as wearing your own skin. Your proficiency ranks for unarmored defense and for light and medium armor increase to expert. This is the Saint's own Armor Expertise. It deliberately does not grant heavy armor, which the Saint never trains in.
icon_brief: A golden armor plate fused seamlessly with skin at the edges, the metal following the shape of a muscle like a second skin, glowing at the seam.

name: Ascendant Constellation
description: You always know when your own constellation is ascendant and what its aspect is. You know nothing of the other twelve. When the day's sign is your Cloth's: Ascendant (any aspect): you gain your Cloth's Ascendant Boon , and your Techniques heighten as though you were 4 levels higher . Exalted: you gain your Cloth's Zenith Boon instead, and your Techniques heighten as though you were 8 levels higher . The sky's position wakes the Cloth; its energy only decides which boon you get. A Saint stands untouched in a Malefic sky while everyone around them suffers — that is Unfailing Cosmo. Odds: Ascendant 1 in 13 (7.69%); Zenith 1 in 130 (0.77%). The GM can still schedule a Zenith — that scene is the whole class, and it should not wait on a die. The extra heightening is automated on each Technique's damage. Riders that scale with heightening but aren't damage — extra targets, longer range, wider bursts — are in each Technique's text and applied by hand.
icon_brief: A single zodiac constellation (star points joined by gold lines) rising over a dark horizon, bright and gold, while the other signs stay dim and gray.

name: Cloth Attunement
description: You and the Cloth have stopped being two things. All your Techniques gain one additional heightening step , as though you were 2 levels higher than you are. Once per day you may cast a Technique of 2 actions or fewer without spending a Focus Point . The extra step is automated as bonus damage dice on every Technique; the non-damage riders of a heightening step are applied by hand from the Technique's text.
icon_brief: A golden gauntlet and the hand inside it merging into one, the gold armor and veins of cosmo-light flowing together, a stepped arrow of heightening light rising above.

name: Cloth Mastery
description: Your fists have become the equal of any weapon. Your proficiency rank for unarmed attacks increases to master.
icon_brief: A bare golden fist striking a steel sword and shattering the blade, fragments flying, the fist itself unscratched and glowing.

name: Cosmo
description: Your inner cosmo is a wellspring you can spend. You gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point and the Refocus activity; you Refocus by burning your cosmo for 10 minutes. Your Techniques are focus spells with the cosmo trait, using your Cosmo DC and your key ability. Techniques have no rank. Each one heightens once per 2 character levels above the level at which you gained it. You gain your Cloth's Techniques at levels 1, 6, 11, and 16 . Your focus pool increases to 2 points at 7th level and 3 points at 13th level . Implementation note. Foundry has no rankless spell, so each Technique is a focus spell whose base rank is half the level it is gained at, rounded up (1, 3, 6, 8). Focus spells auto-heighten to half your level rounded up, which reproduces the guide exactly for the 1st and 3rd Techniques and converges correctly at 20th for all four; the 2nd and 4th run one heightening step ahead between odd levels. To regain Focus Points, see Refocus.
icon_brief: A small universe — a swirling galaxy of gold stars — glowing inside the outline of a human chest, light spilling out of it like a wellspring.

name: Cosmo Expertise
description: Your command of your own cosmo sharpens. Your proficiency rank for your Cosmo DC increases to expert.
icon_brief: A small flame of golden cosmo sharpening into a focused point, a thin ring of light tightening around it.

name: Cosmo Mastery
description: Your cosmo answers you completely. Your proficiency rank for your Cosmo DC increases to master.
icon_brief: A sphere of golden cosmo held perfectly still in an open palm, perfectly round and calm, concentric rings of light expanding out from it.

name: Cosmo Strike
description: Your cosmo burns in your hands. Your fist deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage and is in the brawling group with the agile, finesse, nonlethal, and unarmed traits. Your unarmed Strikes are magical and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to damage per weapon damage die . At 5th level your proficiency rank for unarmed attacks increases to expert, and you gain the brawling critical specialization effect. GM note: this is the built-in handwraps of mighty blows fix for a class with no weapons. Do not also require handwraps — that taxes the Saint twice.
icon_brief: A clenched fist wrapped in burning golden cosmo, a star-shaped impact flash at the knuckles.

name: Eighth Sense (Arayashiki)
description: You have already crossed death once, and you know the way back. You gain Arayashiki ◆ — a free action, once per day, triggered when you are reduced to 0 Hit Points or killed. It keeps you acting for 1 minute and cannot be refused by death itself; read the action for what it costs you afterward.
icon_brief: A glowing golden figure-outline walking back up out of a dark pit of gray souls, a path of light rising beneath its feet, the underworld below.

name: Expert Cosmo Strike
description: Your attacks with your fists become more precise and deadly. Your proficiency rank for unarmed attacks increases to expert, and you gain the brawling critical specialization effect. This is the 5th-level half of Cosmo Strike, granted as its own feature so the proficiency increase lands on the sheet.
icon_brief: A fist striking with pinpoint precision, the impact a sharp star-flash on a single glowing vital point, crack lines radiating outward.

name: Fourth Technique (Ultimate)
description: You learn your Cloth's 4th Technique — its Ultimate, the one the stories are about. It has no rank and heightens once per 2 character levels above 16th.
icon_brief: The four-pointed star of a fourth technique, its top point blazing far brighter than the others, golden light pillar breaking a stormy sky.

name: Second Cosmo
description: Your cosmo runs deeper. Your focus pool increases by 1 Focus Point.
icon_brief: Two golden flames of cosmo side by side, the second newly lit, burning in a dark chest-shaped silhouette.

name: Second Technique
description: You learn your Cloth's 2nd Technique . Like all Techniques it has no rank, and it heightens once per 2 character levels above 6th. Which Technique this is depends on your Cloth; see your Cloth's entry.
icon_brief: A second star joining a constellation line, lighting up in gold beside the first, a short line of light connecting them.

name: Seventh Sense
description: You have touched the seventh sense, and the world's ordinary rules have stopped applying to your fists. Passive. Your Strikes ignore resistances and bypass all material weaknesses and immunities; you strike incorporeal creatures normally. You automatically know the location of anything that has damaged you in the last minute. You gain Burn Your Cosmo ◆ — a free action, once per day, that treats today as Exalted for 1 minute.
icon_brief: A cosmo aura exploding from gold into blinding pure white, a fist passing through a ghostly incorporeal shape and breaking it, seven small lights in a ring.

name: Shelter of the Cloth
description: Your cosmo spills outward far enough to shade the people near you. Allies within 30 feet treat the day's aspect as one step milder: Malefic becomes Retrograde, and Retrograde becomes nothing. This is passive and always on. It stacks with a Stargazer's Forewarned — a party with both is simply immune to the sky.
icon_brief: A dome of soft golden cosmo spread like a canopy over several small silhouettes, the storm-dark sky outside dimmed and calmed where the dome covers it.

name: Sixth Sense
description: You perceive cosmo directly. You gain an imprecise sense with a range of 60 feet that detects everything with a cosmo. You are never off-guard to undetected or hidden creatures, and you cannot be flanked by anything your sixth sense perceives. The sense and the immunity to flanking are on the sheet. "Never off-guard to undetected or hidden creatures" is a note: pf2e applies that off-guard from the attacker's side, and there is no rule element that refuses it.
icon_brief: A closed eye with a ring of golden ripples spreading outward from it like sonar, hidden figures in the dark lit up as glowing outlines where the ripples touch.

name: Sky-Reading
description: Years of watching one constellation have taught you to read the rest of the sky, even though it will never answer you the way yours does. You become trained in a skill of your choice, and in Astronomy Lore . You can use that Lore to determine the current sign and aspect of the sky, and to identify a Saint's Cloth by the way their cosmo moves.
icon_brief: A brass star chart wheel with all twelve zodiac signs around its rim, one sign brightly gold and the rest faint, a pointer turning between them.

name: The Cloth
description: You are bonded to one of the twelve Gold Cloths. It is medium armor (+4 AC, Dex cap +1, check penalty −2, Strength 16), free at 1st level, and it accepts armor runes normally. You can summon or dismiss it with a single Interact action. It cannot be removed from you by any means short of destroying it. If you are reduced to 0 Hit Points the Cloth cracks; it self-repairs after 24 hours, or instantly in the hands of a Saint of Aries. Your Cloth determines your four Techniques , your Cloth Passive, both of your boons, and the one constellation whose rising you can feel. Aries — the Wall Taurus — the Horn Gemini — the Other Dimension Cancer — the Yellow Spring Leo — the Lightning Virgo — Nearest to God Libra — the Weapons Scorpio — the Needle Sagittarius — the Arrow Capricorn — Excalibur Aquarius — Absolute Zero Pisces — the Roses
icon_brief: A gold Cloth box (Pandora Box) standing upright and open, a golden suit of armor glowing inside it, constellation emblem engraved on the lid.

name: Third Cosmo
description: Your cosmo runs deeper still. Your focus pool increases by 1 Focus Point, to a maximum of 3.
icon_brief: Three golden flames of cosmo rising together in a triangle, the third and largest newly lit at the top.

name: Third Technique (Cloth Ability)
description: Your Cloth has taught you its deepest art. You learn your Cloth's 3rd Technique , its Cloth Ability . It has no rank and heightens once per 2 character levels above 11th.
icon_brief: A golden Cloth plate engraved with a single deep rune that glows from within, the rune unfolding into a burst of the Cloth's signature light.

name: Unfailing Cosmo
description: You never suffer the sky's Retrograde or Malefic aspects, or any of their riders. Ever. You still gain every Ascendant and Exalted benefit normally.
icon_brief: A golden flame burning steady while dark storm clouds and falling black stars break apart around it without touching it.

name: Aquarius — Absolute Zero
description: ♒ The Aquarius Cloth. [OFFENSE/removal] Cloth Passive — Cold Blood You have cold resistance equal to your level and are immune to the effects of severe cold environments. You gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves against emotion effects, and you are trained in Occultism or Arcana (your choice). Techniques 1st — Signature (L1) — Diamond Dust 2nd (L6) — Koliço 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — Freezing Shield 4th — Ultimate (L16) — Freezing Coffin Ascendant Boon — Freezing Coffin [OFFENSE/removal] Cold damage from you forces a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or slowed 1 , cumulative — at slowed 4 the creature is instead petrified in ice , which any critical hit shatters permanently. Your cold damage ignores cold resistance and treats cold immunity as cold resistance 10. Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Aquarius) Zenith Boon — Aurora Execution [removal] As the Ascendant Boon, plus Aurora Execution once per minute ◆◆◆: 60-foot line, 16d6[cold] damage, basic Fortitude; a critical failure leaves the creature frozen solid (petrified, shatterable). Incapacitation. Applied by Sky: Zenith (Aquarius)
icon_brief: The Aquarius glyph ♒ carved in ice, a golden amphora tipping and pouring a stream of frost-white cold that freezes into crystals mid-air.

name: Aries — the Wall
description: ♈ The Aries Cloth. [DEFENSE] Cloth Passive — Cloth Mending You are trained in Crafting. You can Repair any Cloth, armor, or shield in 10 minutes with no check and no repair kit, restoring 10 × your level Hit Points. A Cloth you repair is fully restored regardless of how it was destroyed. Techniques 1st — Signature (L1) — Crystal Wall 2nd (L6) — Starlight Extinction 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — Crystal Net 4th — Ultimate (L16) — Stardust Revolution Ascendant Boon — Star Guard [DEFENSE] +2 status bonus to AC and to all saves . Reaction (once per round): when a creature within 60 feet makes a ranged or spell attack, or targets an ally with a spell, the effect is sent nowhere — expended, no result. You also gain Dimension Step ◆ (teleport 60 feet). Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Aries) Zenith Boon — Star Guard (Zenith) [DEFENSE] As the Ascendant Boon, and the reaction has no frequency limit . Once per minute you may target a creature with the reaction instead: 60 feet, Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC, and on a critical failure it is teleported one mile away. Incapacitation. Applied by Sky: Zenith (Aries)
icon_brief: The Aries glyph ♈ framed by two great spiral ram horns, a faint hexagonal crystal barrier shimmering in front, and a hammer and chisel crossed below for Cloth repair.

name: Cancer — the Yellow Spring
description: ♋ The Cancer Cloth. [OFFENSE] Cloth Passive — The Boundary You can see and speak with spirits, ghosts, and the recently dead. You automatically know the current Hit Point category (healthy, hurt, near death, dying) of every creature within 30 feet. You are trained in Medicine. Techniques 1st — Signature (L1) — Sekishiki Meikai Ha 2nd (L6) — Sekishiki Kisōen 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — Sekishiki Konsō Ha 4th — Ultimate (L16) — Sekishiki Tenryū Ha Ascendant Boon — The Yellow Spring Opens [OFFENSE] Any creature you reduce to 0 Hit Points dies , with no save. Once per round as a free action, a creature within 30 feet at half Hit Points or fewer must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or take 8d6[void] damage and be slowed 1. You always know the direction of the nearest planar boundary. Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Cancer) Zenith Boon — The Yellow Spring Is Here [removal] Once per Zenith day , 30-foot emanation: every enemy at half Hit Points or fewer must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or die . Incapacitation. Applied by Sky: Zenith (Cancer)
icon_brief: The Cancer glyph ♋ set on a gray hillside under a dim sky, ringed by floating blue will-o'-wisp flames, faint ghostly faces in the dark behind it.

name: Capricorn — Excalibur
description: ♑ The Capricorn Cloth. [OFFENSE, conditional] Cloth Passive — The Sword Arm & The Sharpest Sword The Sword Arm. Your unarmed Strikes gain the versatile S and deadly d8 traits. You are trained in Athletics. The Sharpest Sword. Your critical hits with unarmed Strikes sever — the target permanently loses the use of one limb, natural attack, or sense of your choice until it receives regenerate . You also gain the sword group critical specialization with all your Strikes. Techniques 1st — Signature (L1) — Excalibur 2nd (L6) — Jumping Stone 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — Double Excalibur 4th — Ultimate (L16) — Excalibur: The Sword That Cuts Everything Ascendant Boon — Excalibur Cuts Everything [OFFENSE, conditional] Your unarmed Strikes ignore all resistances, physical immunities, and Hardness , and gain +1 damage die . You may Strike incorporeal creatures and force effects; a critical hit destroys a force effect. GM note, print this: Capricorn is a key, not a hammer — its value swings from +0% against a boss with no resistances to +170% against resistance 10. On the day Capricorn rises, ask your GM what's behind the wall; and GMs, seed something resistant, or the boon is a shrug. Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Capricorn) Zenith Boon — Excalibur Cuts Everything (Zenith) [OFFENSE, conditional] As the Ascendant Boon, plus a reaction (once per turn per creature): a creature attacks you or a spell effect enters your space → you sever it , and it has no effect. Applied by Sky: Zenith (Capricorn)
icon_brief: The Capricorn glyph ♑ with a gleaming upright holy sword of white-gold light slicing through it, a single fine cut line across the dark background.

name: Gemini — the Other Dimension
description: ♊ The Gemini Cloth. [OFFENSE] Cloth Passive — Two Faces You are trained in Deception. You have two aspects, Light and Shadow , and swap between them as a free action once per hour. In Shadow, Another Dimension instead becomes a single-target confuse effect (Will save, confused 1 round on a failure). Your appearance, voice, and aura change completely. You have two identities that nothing short of true seeing connects. Techniques 1st — Signature (L1) — Another Dimension 2nd (L6) — Astral Projection 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — Galaxian Explosion 4th — Ultimate (L16) — Mavros Eruption Clast Ascendant Boon — Galaxian Cosmo [OFFENSE] Cast your 1st Technique without spending a Focus Point once per round, and Galaxian Explosion's burst increases by 20 feet. Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Gemini) Zenith Boon — Galaxian Cosmo (Zenith) [OFFENSE] As the Ascendant Boon, plus a duplicate of you appears each turn in an adjacent square: your statistics, acting on your initiative with 2 actions, Strike and Stride only — no Techniques, no Focus Points, no skill actions. One at a time; it vanishes at the start of your next turn. Running the duplicate: copy the token and delete it at the top of the next turn. It is deliberately not a second full character. Applied by Sky: Zenith (Gemini)
icon_brief: The Gemini glyph ♊ split down the middle into a light half and a shadow half, a cracked rift of swirling galaxies opening behind it.

name: Leo — the Lightning
description: ♌ The Leo Cloth. [OFFENSE] Cloth Passive — Pride of the Lion You are immune to the frightened condition and to fear effects. You are trained in Intimidation, with a +1 circumstance bonus to Demoralize. Techniques 1st — Signature (L1) — Lightning Bolt 2nd (L6) — Lightning Crown 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — Lightning Plasma 4th — Ultimate (L16) — Photon Burst Ascendant Boon — Lightning Plasma [OFFENSE] Your fists gain the agile trait and deal an additional 1d6[electricity] damage. You gain a Haste-style extra action each turn, usable only to Strike or Stride. Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Leo) Zenith Boon — Lightning Plasma (Zenith) [OFFENSE] As the Ascendant Boon but with an additional 3d6[electricity] damage, and you are quickened 1 in addition to the Haste action — two extra actions on a Zenith day. Applied by Sky: Zenith (Leo)
icon_brief: The Leo glyph ♌ formed from crackling golden lightning, a roaring lion's head silhouette in electric light behind it.

name: Libra — the Weapons
description: ♎ The Libra Cloth. [OFFENSE/DEFENSE] Cloth Passive — The Cloth of Arms The only Gold Cloth that carries weapons. You are trained in martial weapons , and they advance with your unarmed proficiency automatically. Cosmo Strike applies to Libra weapons — they are magical and gain +1 damage per weapon damage die, exactly as your fists do. Your Cloth holds six Arms , and every Arm is a matched pair — twelve weapons in total, the arsenal Athena entrusted to one Saint. Summoning or dismissing an Arm is a free action (Summon an Arm), and it always arrives as both weapons at once, one in each hand. You therefore fight two-weapon by default: every Libra weapon has the twin trait, so the second Strike you make each turn with the other half of a matched pair adds a circumstance bonus to damage equal to its number of damage dice. Libra weapons can never be disarmed, sundered, or destroyed, and they accept weapon runes normally — use the better of a granted tier and an etched rune; property runes always apply. While you are wielding a matched pair, you gain that Arm's Art — the technique the weapon itself teaches the hand that holds it. You gain the benefit of only one Arm's Art at a time; the Ascendant Boon lifts this. The Six Arms Arm Damage Traits Art Twin Swords (Sōken) 1d8 S · sword agile, finesse, magical, twin, versatile P The Crossing Tridents (Sansōgeki) 1d10 P · spear magical, reach, thrown 30 ft, twin, versatile S Setting the Tide Nunchaku (Sōsetsukon) 1d6 B · flail agile, backswing, finesse, magical, trip, twin Rebound Rhythm Shields (Sōtate) 1d6 B · shield magical, shove, twin, versatile S The Twin Bulwark Sanjiegun (Sansetsukon) 1d8 B · flail disarm, magical, reach, sweep, trip, twin The Whirling Circle Tonfa (Tonfā) 1d6 B · club agile, finesse, magical, parry, twin The Turning Guard Every Arm is deliberately one step better than its printed cousin: the real tonfa is 1d4, the real nunchaku has no twin, the real sansetsukon is two-handed for its 1d8, and no printed one-handed weapon combines 1d10 with reach. That is the point of the Cloth — an ally handed one of these by The Twelve Arms is straightforwardly upgrading. Libra pays for it by being the one Saint whose damage lives in items the GM can rule on, rather than in the fist, and by having the plainest four Techniques of the twelve. The Arms Advance Libra weapons grow with the Saint. They never need to be bought, found, or etched with fundamental runes. Your level Every Libra weapon gains Normal PF2e 1 magical, +1 weapon potency, Cosmo Strike's +1 per die, each Arm's Lesser Art +1 at 2nd 4 striking (2 damage dice) 4th 6 +2 weapon potency 10th 8 each Arm's Greater Art — 10 greater striking (3 damage dice) 12th 12 +3 weapon potency 16th 14 each Arm's Perfect Art — 16 major striking (4 damage dice) 19th 19 Athena's Temper — a fifth damage die , past the game's cap, and one property rune of your choice on each Arm, re-chosen each morning — Techniques 1st — Signature (L1) — Rozan Shō Ryū Ha 2nd (L6) — The Twelve Arms 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — Rozan Ryū Hi Shō 4th — Ultimate (L16) — Athena's Arsenal: Overdrive Ascendant Boon — The Balance [OFFENSE/DEFENSE] You may wield one weapon from each of two different Arms at once and gain both their Arts; the two count as a matched pair for the twin trait. Your Arms Advance counts as one tier higher in both potency and striking (maximum +4 and five damage dice). +2 status bonus to all saves; the first natural 1 you roll each hour counts as a 10. Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Libra) Zenith Boon — The Balance (Zenith) [OFFENSE/DEFENSE] As the Ascendant Boon, except you wield all six Arms at once — the Cloth holds what your hands cannot — gaining every Art simultaneously. In addition, Rozan Hyaku Ryū Ha once per round ◆◆◆: 60-foot line, 12d10[bludgeoning] damage, basic Reflex; a critical failure also knocks the target prone and stuns it 2. Applied by Sky: Zenith (Libra)
icon_brief: The Libra glyph ♎ as a golden balance scale, with six pairs of small golden weapons hanging from its arms and crossing beneath it.

name: Pisces — the Roses
description: ♓ The Pisces Cloth. [OFFENSE] Cloth Passive — Royal Demon Rose Roses grow from your Cloth. You are immune to poison . Any creature that touches you or hits you with an unarmed or non-reach melee attack takes 1d6[poison] damage. Techniques 1st — Signature (L1) — Piranha Rose 2nd (L6) — Royal Demon Rose 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — Crimson Fog 4th — Ultimate (L16) — Royal Funeral Ascendant Boon — The Royal Demon Rose Garden [OFFENSE] 10-foot emanation. At the end of each of your turns, enemies inside must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or take 4d6[poison] damage and become enfeebled 1 (cumulative to enfeebled 4). Cap 4 creatures. This requires that you acted hostilely that turn. The emanation persists even while you are unconscious. Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Pisces) Zenith Boon — The Royal Demon Rose Garden (Zenith) [OFFENSE] As the Ascendant Boon with a 15-foot emanation and 8d6[poison] damage per turn . Plus Bloody Rose once per minute ◆◆ ( incapacitation , death): 60 feet, one creature, Fortitude save; on a failure 10d6[poison] damage and enfeebled 2, on a critical failure it dies . Applied by Sky: Zenith (Pisces)
icon_brief: The Pisces glyph ♓ woven out of thorned rose stems, three roses — red, black and white — blooming around it, a haze of poisonous petals.

name: Sagittarius — the Arrow
description: ♐ The Sagittarius Cloth. [UTILITY] Cloth Passive — The Bow Your Cloth includes a bow that uses your unarmed proficiency and can never be disarmed or destroyed. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to notice things beyond 100 feet, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Techniques 1st — Signature (L1) — Golden Arrow 2nd (L6) — Chiron's Light Impulse 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — Infinity Break 4th — Ultimate (L16) — Aiolos's Wings Ascendant Boon — Atomic Thunderbolt [UTILITY] You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed. Golden Arrow's range increment becomes one mile . It ignores all cover, concealment, and the hidden and undetected conditions, and can hit any creature whose location you can name without line of sight. Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Sagittarius) Zenith Boon — Atomic Thunderbolt (Zenith) [UTILITY] As the Ascendant Boon, plus once per minute Golden Arrow reaches any named creature within a mile through any barrier short of a planar boundary and deals +8 dice . Applied by Sky: Zenith (Sagittarius)
icon_brief: The Sagittarius glyph ♐ as a golden drawn bow with a nocked arrow, a pair of great feathered golden wings spread behind it.

name: Scorpio — the Needle
description: ♏ The Scorpio Cloth. [OFFENSE] Cloth Passive — Fifteen Needles Needles are counted on each creature separately, and they reset when the creature takes a full rest or when the encounter ends. Whenever you hit a creature with an unarmed Strike, you may spend a free action — Place a Scarlet Needle — to add one needle, to a maximum of 15. At 5 needles the creature is enfeebled 1. At 10 it is blinded. At 14 it is stunned 2 and its Strikes lose all runes. The count lives on the creature, as the badge of Effect: Scarlet Needle, so several creatures at once each carry their own — and the three thresholds are applied automatically, once each, as the count crosses them. Techniques 1st — Signature (L1) — Scarlet Needle 2nd (L6) — Crimson Mirage 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — Crimson Flurry 4th — Ultimate (L16) — Antares Ascendant Boon — Antares [OFFENSE] Needles land on any attack, hit or miss . Each needle deals 1d6[persistent,bleed] damage, stacking, capped at 10 needles of bleed. At 8 needles the target must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or die . Incapacitation. Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Scorpio) Zenith Boon — Antares (Zenith) [OFFENSE] As the Ascendant Boon; Antares triggers at 5 needles , and your allies' hits apply needles too — every ally in the party carries Effect: The Scorpion's Blessing for the day. Applied by Sky: Zenith (Scorpio)
icon_brief: The Scorpio glyph ♏ ending in a curled scorpion stinger, fifteen small crimson stars tracing the Scorpius constellation around it, the brightest red star at the heart.

name: Taurus — the Horn
description: ♉ The Taurus Cloth. [OFFENSE] Cloth Passive — Bulwark You cannot be moved against your will by any creature or effect of your size or smaller. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks and to your DC against Shove, Trip, Grapple, and Disarm. Techniques 1st — Signature (L1) — Great Horn 2nd (L6) — Pleiades Nova 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — Titan's Stance 4th — Ultimate (L16) — Titan's Break: The Golden Horn Ascendant Boon — The Great Horn [OFFENSE] Your unarmed Strikes gain +1 damage die and force a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC; on a failure the target is pushed 10 feet and knocked prone. You count as one size larger whenever that benefits you. Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Taurus) Zenith Boon — The Great Horn (Zenith) [OFFENSE] As the Ascendant Boon, but with +2 damage dice in total. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level at the start of each of your turns, and Great Horn costs no Focus Point once per round. Applied by Sky: Zenith (Taurus)
icon_brief: The Taurus glyph ♉ with massive forward-curving golden bull horns, a ground-shaking golden shockwave ring at its base.

name: Virgo — Nearest to God
description: ♍ The Virgo Cloth. [CONTROL] Cloth Passive — Om Shaka fights with his eyes closed and opens them only when he intends to end things. As a single action ( concentrate ) you may close your eyes . While your eyes are closed you are blinded — fully, with all that entails — but you gain one Om stack at the end of each of your turns, to a maximum of 5 . While you have at least 1 stack you gain a +1 status bonus per stack to your Technique DCs and to unarmed Strike damage . From 7th level your Sixth Sense functions as a precise sense out to 30 feet, letting you fight blind. Opening your eyes is a free action, usable at any time. All stacks are spent and reset to 0 , and the next Technique you cast or unarmed Strike you make before the end of that turn is empowered : +2 damage dice per stack spent , and if it allows a saving throw, a −1 circumstance penalty per 2 stacks spent to that save. Your eyes open automatically, spending nothing, if you are knocked unconscious. Use Om ◆ to close your eyes and Open Your Eyes to spend the stacks; the count lives on Effect: Om, which also applies the blinded condition for as long as your eyes are closed. It is a real cost and the sheet enforces it. Techniques 1st — Signature (L1) — Tenbu Hōrin 2nd (L6) — Tenpōrin'in 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — Tenma Kōfuku 4th — Ultimate (L16) — Rikudō Rinne Ascendant Boon — Six Paths of Transmigration [CONTROL] Each unarmed hit forces a Will save against your Cosmo DC or the target loses a sense , cumulatively: blind → deaf → smell/taste → touch (−4 to attacks, cannot Grapple). Removed only by restoration or a full rest. Your maximum Om stacks increase to 7 . Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Virgo) Zenith Boon — Six Paths of Transmigration (Zenith) [CONTROL] As the Ascendant Boon, plus once per minute ◆◆◆, 60-foot emanation, Will save ( incapacitation ) or lose all five senses for 1 minute; a critical failure lasts until restoration . Applied by Sky: Zenith (Virgo)
icon_brief: The Virgo glyph ♍ above an open golden lotus, two closed eyes drawn in light above the lotus, a soft mandala halo behind.

name: Rebound Rhythm
description: The Art of the Libra Nunchaku. Frequency once per turn Requirements You are wielding both Libra Nunchaku (Right) and Libra Nunchaku (Left) Trigger You hit a creature with a Nunchaku Strike The chain whips back. Make a Strike with the other Nunchaku against that creature or one adjacent to it. This Strike is made at your current multiple attack penalty and increases it normally, and it always receives the twin bonus. Greater (8th level) The free Strike no longer increases your multiple attack penalty (it still counts toward it afterward). Perfect (14th level) The Art also triggers on a miss . Granted by Libra — the Weapons. Target the creature and use this; the rebound Strike is rolled and followed through to its damage for you. Automation note: below 8th level the rebound is rolled at the second-attack penalty, because the Strike that triggered it was an attack. From 8th it is rolled outside the penalty entirely. The twin bonus is pf2e's own opt-in toggle on the damage dialog — switch it on, since this Strike always qualifies.
icon_brief: Two golden nunchaku in mid-swing, one chain whipping back toward a second target in a curving arc of light, motion trails tracing a figure-eight.

name: Setting the Tide
description: The Art of the Libra Tridents. Frequency once per round Requirements You are wielding both Libra Trident (Right) and Libra Trident (Left) Trigger A creature within your reach uses a move action, or leaves a square within your reach Strike it with a trident. On a hit its movement immediately ends ; on a critical hit it is also pushed 10 feet and knocked prone . Greater (8th level) Your reach with the Tridents becomes 15 feet , and the Art also triggers on a manipulate action; on a critical hit, that action is disrupted . Perfect (14th level) You gain one additional reaction each round , usable only for Setting the Tide — which is what the second use per round below is. Granted by Libra — the Weapons. Target the creature that moved and use this: the Strike is rolled for you, and a critical hit pushes it and puts it down. Automation note: from 8th level the Tridents trade pf2e's flat reach trait for reach 15 ft. , a trait this module registers, because pf2e's own reach is +5 feet and cannot say fifteen.
icon_brief: Two golden tridents planted crossed in the ground, a flowing wall of water-blue light between them blocking a figure trying to step past.

name: The Crossing
description: The Art of the Libra Twin Swords — Rozan Jūjiken. Frequency once per turn Requirements You are wielding both Libra Twin Sword (Right) and Libra Twin Sword (Left) Trigger You hit the same creature with both Twin Swords this turn The cuts cross. The target takes persistent bleed equal to your weapons' number of damage dice in d6s — 2d6 once you have striking, 5d6 at Athena's Temper — and is off-guard until the end of your next turn . Greater (8th level) The Twin Swords also gain deadly d8 . Perfect (14th level) The deadly die becomes d10 , the bleed dice become d8s , and a creature bleeding from The Crossing receives only half the Hit Points from any healing. Granted by Libra — the Weapons. Target the creature you hit twice, then use this; the bleed, the off-guard and the halved healing are all applied for you.
icon_brief: Two golden swords crossing in an X, a glowing crimson X-shaped slash cut in the air behind them, droplets of light falling from the cut.

name: The Turning Guard
description: The Art of the Libra Tonfa. Frequency once per round Requirements You are wielding both Libra Tonfa (Right) and Libra Tonfa (Left) Trigger A melee attack against you critically fails While wielding both Tonfa you gain the parry bonus (+1 circumstance to AC) with no action spent . When the trigger is met, Strike the attacker with a Tonfa; this Strike does not increase your multiple attack penalty. Greater (8th level) The reaction triggers on any miss , and the parry bonus becomes +2 and also applies to Reflex saves . Perfect (14th level) You gain one additional reaction each round , usable only for The Turning Guard — which is the second use per round below. Granted by Libra — the Weapons. Target the attacker and use this; the counter-Strike is rolled outside your multiple attack penalty and followed through to its damage.
icon_brief: Two golden tonfa spinning around the forearms, a deflected enemy blade glancing off in a spray of sparks, a curved motion arc showing the turn.

name: The Twin Bulwark
description: The Art of the Libra Shields. Frequency once per round Requirements You are wielding both Libra Shield (Right) and Libra Shield (Left) While wielding both Shields you may Raise a Shield as a free action once per round — this action — and you can Shield Block as a reaction even without the feat, which the Art grants you outright. Each Shield has Hardness equal to your level , Hit Points equal to 8 × your level , and a Broken Threshold of half that. A Shield reduced to 0 Hit Points is not destroyed but returns to the Cloth and can be re-summoned after 1 minute. Greater (8th level) You may Shield Block twice per round (the second use costs no reaction), and may use it for an adjacent ally . Perfect (14th level) You may Shield Block for any ally within 15 feet , and whenever a Block reduces the damage to 0 the attacker takes your Shield's damage dice in bludgeoning — The Twin Bulwark: Riposte. Granted by Libra — the Weapons. Automation note: pf2e models no reaction budget, so the second Block each round and blocking for somebody else are the table's to count — as they are for every Bastion feat in the game. Everything the Shields themselves are is on the item: Hardness, Hit Points and Broken Threshold all follow your level, and pf2e's own Shield Block dialog does the rest.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Libra shields (Dragon Shield heritage)
icon_brief: Two round golden shields raised side by side, edges overlapping into one wall, a dragon-scale pattern of light across both.

name: The Twin Bulwark: Riposte
description: The Twin Bulwark, Perfect — gained at 14th level. Trigger A Shield Block with a Libra Shield reduces the damage to 0 The attacker takes your Shield's damage dice in bludgeoning — 4d6 with major striking , 5d6 at Athena's Temper . Target the attacker and use this. Granted by The Twin Bulwark at 14th level.
icon_brief: A round golden Libra shield absorbing a strike so completely the blow vanishes at its face, a golden counter-shockwave rebounding outward toward the attacker.

name: The Whirling Circle
description: The Art of the Libra Sanjiegun. Frequency once per round Requirements You are wielding both Libra Sanjiegun (Right) and Libra Sanjiegun (Left) Make one Sanjiegun Strike against each enemy within your reach . Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until you have made all of them . Greater (8th level) The activity costs two actions instead — The Whirling Circle (Greater) replaces this one — and your reach during the whirl increases by 5 feet . Perfect (14th level) Every creature you hit must attempt a Reflex save against your Cosmo DC or be knocked prone ; those you critically hit fall prone with no save. Granted by Libra — the Weapons below 8th level.
icon_brief: A golden three-section staff swinging in a wide circle, a single glowing ring of motion sweeping around the center.

name: The Whirling Circle (Greater)
description: The Art of the Libra Sanjiegun, Greater — gained at 8th level. Frequency once per round Requirements You are wielding both Libra Sanjiegun (Right) and Libra Sanjiegun (Left) Make one Sanjiegun Strike against each enemy within your reach . Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until you have made all of them . Greater (8th level) The activity costs two actions , and your reach during the whirl increases by 5 feet — both are already in this version. Perfect (14th level) Every creature you hit must attempt a Reflex save against your Cosmo DC or be knocked prone ; those you critically hit fall prone with no save. Granted by Libra — the Weapons from 8th level, replacing The Whirling Circle. pf2e has no way to alter an activity’s action cost, so the tier change is a different item rather than a different number.
icon_brief: Two golden three-section staffs whirling in a full circle, a blazing gold ring of motion around a center point, larger and with a second outer ring of light.

name: Libra Nunchaku (Left)
description: One half of the Libra Cloth's Nunchaku (Sōsetsukon) — the left hand. 1d6 bludgeoning, one hand each, flail group; agile, backswing, finesse, magical, trip, twin. An Arm always arrives as both weapons at once, one in each hand: summon or dismiss it with Summon an Arm. It can never be disarmed, sundered, or destroyed, and it accepts weapon runes normally. A Libra Saint uses their unarmed proficiency with it, and it grows on its own along the Arms Advance — potency, striking, and a fifth damage die at 19th level — without ever being bought or etched. Cosmo Strike applies to it exactly as it does to the Saint's fists. While you wield the matched pair you gain its Art, Rebound Rhythm. An ally lent an Arm by The Twelve Arms uses the Saint's proficiency, receives the Saint's Arms Advance, and gains the Art.

name: Sky: Benefic
description: The sky is kind. Today's sign carries a +1 circumstance bonus on its domain — the checks that constellation touches. The sky is terrain. It applies to every creature, not only to a Saint. Sign Automated on Also, by hand Aries initiative The first Strike you make in each encounter is also affected — the module adds it. Taurus fortitude, athletics Athletics to resist forced movement is also affected — apply it by hand: pf2e has no roll for it. Gemini deception, diplomacy Cancer medicine Fortitude saves against disease and poison are also affected. Recovery checks are too — apply that by hand: a recovery check is a flat check, which takes no modifier. Leo intimidation, performance Virgo crafting Recall Knowledge with any skill, and Perception to Seek, are also affected. Libra — Libra's domain is the die itself, not a list of checks — see the effect's own clause. Scorpio stealth, thievery Sagittarius ranged-attack-roll, survival Capricorn athletics to Climb, High Jump, Long Jump and Swim A Leap is not an Athletics check, so it is not affected. Aquarius arcana, nature, occultism, religion, society Counteract checks are also affected. Pisces will Perception against illusions and to disbelieve them is also affected. Only one sign is up on any given day, so only that row applies.

name: Effect: Aiolos's Wings
description: Granted by Aiolos's Wings You have a fly Speed equal to twice your Speed, and you can Fly at full speed while attacking without penalty. Golden Arrow becomes a 1-action Technique that costs no Focus Point.
icon_brief: A great pair of spread golden feathered wings blazing with light, a golden arrow drawn across them, the figure high in a dawn sky.

name: Effect: Aiolos's Wings (Shared)
description: Granted by Aiolos's Wings The Sagittarius Saint shares flight with you. You have a fly Speed equal to your own Speed for the duration.
icon_brief: A small pair of golden feathered wings of light sprouting from an ally's shoulders, a single golden feather drifting down from them.

name: Effect: Arayashiki
description: Granted by Eighth Sense (Arayashiki) You keep acting for 1 minute or until the encounter ends. You cannot drop below 1 Hit Point; you are immune to death effects and to the dying, unconscious, and paralyzed conditions; and you ignore the wounded and drained conditions. When this ends you are dying 3 and your Cloth shatters. If the trigger killed you, you die when the minute ends. You may end it early to be merely dying 1 with an intact Cloth.
icon_brief: A figure outlined in steady white-gold light standing upright while a dark shadow of death pours past and around it without taking hold.

name: Effect: Astral Body
description: A projected consciousness, not a creature. It is invisible to anything without a sixth sense or see invisibility , cannot be damaged or physically interacted with, and cannot attack. Created and removed by Astral Projection.
icon_brief: A translucent, ghostly blue-white double of a figure, glowing at the edges and see-through, floating slightly above the ground.

name: Effect: Astral Projection
description: Applied by Astral Projection Your consciousness is elsewhere. Your own body is unconscious and off-guard for the duration, and you perceive and speak through the astral body instead. You may cast mental Techniques through it, using its position as the origin — the module measures range and line of effect from the astral body for those, and from your own body for everything else. Damage to your body ends this effect and leaves you stunned 1 .
icon_brief: A body lying slumped and dim, with a thin silver cord of light rising from its chest to a faint glowing double far above.

name: Effect: Athena's Arsenal
description: Applied by Athena's Arsenal: Overdrive. For 1 minute the twelve weapons circle you: you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC , and any creature that ends its turn adjacent to you takes 2d8[slashing] damage.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Libra Cloth's twelve weapons
icon_brief: Twelve golden weapons orbiting in a slow spinning ring, blades outward, forming a glittering cutting barrier around an empty center.

name: Effect: Athena's Arsenal (Overdrive)
description: Applied by Athena's Arsenal: Overdrive for the length of the activity. Each of the six Strikes deals its weapon's damage plus 2d8, growing a die per heightening step, and each counts as the second weapon of its pair — so the twin bonus always applies.
icon_brief: Six golden weapons — sword, trident, staff, nunchaku, tonfa, shield — flying outward in all directions like spokes, each leaving a white-hot streak.

name: Effect: Athena's Temper
description: Applied by Athena's Temper. Every Libra weapon carries the property rune you chose this morning, until you choose again tomorrow. Automation note: the rune is added as a strike adjustment rather than etched onto the twelve items. pf2e trims a weapon's property runes to the number of potency slots it has in its own source data , and the Arms Advance grants their potency as an alteration rather than an etched rune — so a rune written onto the item is trimmed straight back off before anyone sees it. A strike adjustment is applied where the Strike is built, after the Advance has been counted, and it reaches the Shields' generated weapon too.
icon_brief: A golden weapon blade with a single rune burning on it in a bright color, the rune changing with a faint sunrise glow behind.

name: Effect: Burn Your Cosmo
description: Granted by Seventh Sense You have forced the sky's hand. Treat today as Exalted : your Zenith Boon is active for 1 minute. If the day was already Exalted, your Zenith Boon instead extends to all allies within 30 feet for 1 minute. Apply your Cloth's Sky: Zenith effect alongside this one for the duration, or use the sky tracker's Burn Cosmo control, which does it for you and reverts when the minute ends.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — burning the cosmo to the Zenith
icon_brief: A constellation forced to blaze at its brightest, every star white-hot, a pillar of golden fire rising from below to meet it.

name: Effect: Chiron's Light Impulse
description: Applied by Chiron's Light Impulse. You are wreathed in golden light for 1 minute. You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, your attacks deal an extra 1d6[force] damage, and you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet — equal to your own Speed once the Saint reaches 14th level. Once during the duration, you may treat one attack roll or saving throw as though you had rolled a 10. The game offers it as a fortune option on the roll itself; taking it spends this effect's one use.
canon_source: Saint Seiya (Episode G) — Aiolos's Chiron's Light Impulse
icon_brief: A figure wrapped in a cocoon of warm golden light, faint feathered shapes of a centaur bow's arrow guiding upward, a gentle golden glow rather than an attack.

name: Effect: Double Excalibur
description: Applied by Double Excalibur for the length of the activity. Both Strikes gain the deadly d12 trait and ignore Hardness, resistance, and immunity to physical damage.
icon_brief: Two crossed blades of white-gold light, edges sharp as razors, carving a clean X through solid rock.

name: Effect: Entrust Your Cosmo (1 Focus)
description: Granted by the Entrust Your Cosmo feat. A Saint has poured 1 Focus Point of their own cosmo into you. You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks, and temporary Hit Points equal to the granting Saint's level. A creature can benefit from Entrust Your Cosmo only once per hour, no matter how many Saints offer it.
icon_brief: A single small golden flame passed from one glowing hand to another, a thin ribbon of light linking them.

name: Effect: Entrust Your Cosmo (2 Focus)
description: Granted by the Entrust Your Cosmo feat. A Saint has poured 2 Focus Points of their own cosmo into you. As 1 Focus Point, and your Strikes count as magical and deal an additional 1d6 damage of the granting Saint's Cloth element. A creature can benefit from Entrust Your Cosmo only once per hour, no matter how many Saints offer it.
icon_brief: Two golden flames flowing from one hand into another, the receiving fist beginning to glow with an elemental colour.

name: Effect: Entrust Your Cosmo (3 Focus)
description: Granted by the Entrust Your Cosmo feat. A Saint has poured 3 Focus Points of their own cosmo into you. As 2 Focus Points, and you are quickened 1 (Strike, Stride, or Step only), and you can see and act normally through any darkness, invisibility, or concealment. A creature can benefit from Entrust Your Cosmo only once per hour, no matter how many Saints offer it.
icon_brief: Three golden flames pouring in a river of light from one hand into another, the receiver blazing fully gold, darkness parting around them.

name: Effect: Excalibur
description: Granted by Excalibur Until the end of your turn, your unarmed Strikes deal slashing damage, gain the deadly d10 trait (d12 from 10th level), and ignore an object's Hardness. From 14th level they deal an additional 1d6 slashing damage, and 2d6 from 18th.
icon_brief: A forearm transformed into a gleaming holy blade of white-gold light, edge glowing, ready to cut.

name: Effect: Freezing Shield
description: Applied by Freezing Shield. A dome of frozen air surrounds you for 1 minute. You and your allies inside gain cold resistance and a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against ranged attacks. Ranged and spell attacks crossing into the dome from outside take a −4 circumstance penalty. Any creature hostile to you that enters the dome or ends its turn inside it takes cold damage with a basic Fortitude save, and is slowed 1 on a failure.
icon_brief: A translucent dome of frozen air and frost crystals, arrows freezing and stopping mid-flight against its surface.

name: Effect: Lightning Plasma (Second Action)
description: Granted by Sky: Zenith (Leo). On a Zenith day the Lion gives you two extra actions each turn, usable only to Strike or Stride. The first is the quickened condition, which pf2e understands. This counter is the second. pf2e keeps no pool of actions — the sheet has no number to decrement — so the count is here, on the token, and it goes back to 1 at the start of each of your turns. Click it down when you spend it.
icon_brief: Two glowing lightning-bolt pips stacked like extra action tokens, behind them a dense lattice of golden lightning beams criss-crossing.

name: Effect: Om
description: Granted by the Virgo Cloth Passive, Virgo — Nearest to God Your eyes are closed. The blinded condition applies for as long as they are, and lifts the moment you open them. Increase this effect's value by 1 at the end of each of your turns, to a maximum of 5 (7 on a day Virgo is ascendant). While your eyes are closed you gain the value as a status bonus to your Technique DCs and to unarmed Strike damage , and from 7th level your Sixth Sense becomes a precise sense out to 30 feet , letting you fight blind. Spending the stacks Toggle Eyes Open on this effect. That immediately removes the blindness and arms the empowerment on your next Technique or unarmed Strike: +2 damage dice per stack , and +1 to the DC per 2 stacks — the guide writes this as a −1 circumstance penalty per 2 stacks to the target's save, which is the same number from the other side, and this is the side Foundry can actually roll. Delete this effect once you have taken that roll. That is the spend; the stacks reset to 0. Your eyes open automatically, spending nothing, if you are knocked unconscious — delete the effect without toggling.
icon_brief: Closed eyes drawn as gold arcs, a counter of small glowing beads gathering in a mala-like ring around them as the held cosmo builds.

name: Effect: Pleiades Nova
description: Applied for the duration of the volley by Pleiades Nova Each Strike deals force damage, and every Strike after the first takes a cumulative −1 penalty as the light scatters.
icon_brief: Seven blue-white points of light (the Pleiades cluster) scattering outward from a single fist, each fainter than the last.

name: Effect: Rise
description: Granted by the Rise feat. You refused to fall. You are at 1 Hit Point and wounded 1 (or your wounded value increased by 1).
icon_brief: A cracked, battered golden gauntlet pushing up off the ground, a single thin line of light along the cracks, dust falling away.

name: Effect: Rising Cosmo
description: Granted by the Rising Cosmo feat. Increase this effect's value by 1 each time you are critically hit, are reduced to half Hit Points or lower for the first time, or are reduced to 0 Hit Points (maximum 3). You gain the value as a status bonus to unarmed Strike damage and to your Technique DCs. At 2 or more you also gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. At 3, once per round you may Step or Stride 5 feet as a free action when you take damage.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — cosmo burning brighter as the Saint is hurt
icon_brief: A cracked golden aura through whose cracks brighter white light pours, three stacked flame tiers growing larger from bottom to top.

name: Effect: Rose-Marked
description: Granted by Royal Funeral. From the rose's colour you know the marked creature's exact current Hit Points, reported at the start of each of your turns. Ends when the encounter does.
icon_brief: A single rose pinned to a creature, its petals' colour shifting from white to deep red like a gauge showing how much life remains.

name: Effect: Rozan Ryū Hi Shō
description: Applied by Rozan Ryū Hi Shō for the length of the activity. The Strike made during the flight deals additional damage — 6d8 at 11th level, and one die more per heightening step, a lit sky included.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Shiryu's Rozan Ryū Hi Shō
icon_brief: A soaring green-gold dragon of cosmo carrying a fist upward in a spiral flight, mist and spray streaming behind it.

name: Effect: Second Ascension
description: Granted by the Second Ascension feat. For 1 minute, treat the day as though your constellation were ascendant (or Exalted, if it was already ascendant). Apply the matching Sky effect for the duration.
icon_brief: A constellation pulled up over the horizon by a beam of golden will, the stars lighting one by one, a sky that was dim now gold.

name: Effect: Soul Consumed
description: Reduced to 0 Hit Points by Sekishiki Kisōen. The demonic blue flames fed on this creature's soul as they burned. It cannot be raised by any effect below resurrect .
icon_brief: A ghostly soul-shape engulfed and consumed by demonic blue onibi flames, only a hollow outline of ash left behind.

name: Effect: Speed of Light
description: Granted by the Speed of Light feat. You are quickened 1 for 1 minute; the extra action can be used only to Strike, Stride, or Step. You also do not trigger reactions based on your movement — you are simply not where the reaction expected you to be.
icon_brief: A figure reduced to a streak of pure golden light, multiple faint afterimages along its path, a reaching enemy hand closing on empty air.

name: Effect: Tenpōrin'in
description: Applied by Tenpōrin'in to the Saint and every ally in the emanation. You gain a status bonus to Will saves and to saves against mental effects, and you are immune to the fascinated and frightened conditions. The bonus is +1, +2 from the Saint's 12th level, and +3 from their 18th — and the immunity extends to confused from 12th. All four numbers are the caster's , not yours, so they are written in when the wheel turns rather than read off your own sheet. Below 12th level the confused immunity carries a predicate nothing satisfies, which is how it stays switched off.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Shaka's Tenpōrin (wheel of dharma)
icon_brief: A golden eight-spoked dharma wheel turning slowly, a calm aura of light spreading outward over several small figures, frightening shadows fleeing from the edges.

name: Effect: Titan's Stance
description: Granted by Titan's Stance You took the blow meant for an ally. Reduce the damage by 10 plus twice your level.
icon_brief: Two massive golden forearms crossed in a block, a huge blow shattering on them in a spray of light, a small figure sheltered behind.

name: Effect: The Twelve Arms (Nunchaku)

While you hold them you use the Saint's weapon proficiency, the weapons carry the Saint's full Arms Advance — potency and damage dice, whatever tier the Saint has reached, a lit sky included — their Cosmo Strike bonus, and you gain the Arm's Art at whatever tier the Saint has reached — Greater from their 8th level, Perfect from their 14th — Rebound Rhythm. The weapons cannot be dropped involuntarily, and they return to the Cloth when this ends. The Saint's proficiency rank and the Advance's two numbers are written in at the moment the Arm is handed over. The rule element only reaches a player character; an NPC ally is told so in chat instead.
icon_brief: A pair of golden nunchaku descending from a beam of light into an ally's open hands, Libra scales glyph glowing above.

name: Effect: The Twelve Arms (Tridents)
description: Granted by The Twelve Arms. The Libra Saint has put the Tridents in your hands — both of them, one per hand, because an Arm is a matched pair and never arrives as half of one. While you hold them you use the Saint's weapon proficiency, the weapons carry the Saint's full Arms Advance — potency and damage dice, whatever tier the Saint has reached, a lit sky included — their Cosmo Strike bonus, and you gain the Arm's Art at whatever tier the Saint has reached — Greater from their 8th level, Perfect from their 14th — Setting the Tide. The weapons cannot be dropped involuntarily, and they return to the Cloth when this ends. The Saint's proficiency rank and the Advance's two numbers are written in at the moment the Arm is handed over. The rule element only reaches a player character; an NPC ally is told so in chat instead.
icon_brief: A pair of golden tridents descending from a beam of light into an ally's hands, prongs pointing up.

The weapons cannot be dropped involuntarily, and they return to the Cloth when this ends.
