icon_brief: A pair of golden swords descending point-down from a beam of light into an ally's hands.

name: Effect: Aura Tick
description: Content-free by design. This is the item a Saint's Aura rule element points at so pf2e's own aura check has something to grant and take back as a creature crosses the line or ends its turn inside — the mechanism, not the message. The module reads its creation, works out which of the Saint's own effects is carrying the actual tick — the damage, the save, the condition — applies that, and deletes this one so pf2e is free to grant it again next turn. It should never be seen sitting on a sheet for more than an instant.
icon_brief: A thin ring of faint golden cosmo on the ground with one small spark crossing its edge: a plain aura border marker, simple and low-detail, gold line on a dark background.

name: Effect: Bleeding from The Crossing
description: Granted by The Crossing at 14th level. The Twin Swords crossed in this creature, and the wound will not close. It receives only half the Hit Points from any healing while it is bleeding from The Crossing. Automation note: pf2e has no modifier that multiplies healing, so the halving is applied to the Hit Points that actually landed, and said out loud in chat each time.
icon_brief: A deep X-shaped wound glowing red on a creature, the crossing still bleeding light, healing motes bouncing off it and only half sinking in.

name: Effect: Crimson Mirage
description: Applied by Crimson Mirage. For 1 minute this creature is dazzled , treats all other creatures as concealed , and takes mental damage at the end of each of its turns — one die per needle currently in it. The dazzled and the damage are applied for you. The concealment is a note: pf2e resolves concealment from the attacker's side, as a DC 5 flat check the attacker rolls, and there is no rule element that makes every other creature concealed to one particular pair of eyes. Roll the flat check for this creature's attacks.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Milo's Scarlet Needle (crimson haze)
icon_brief: A creature seen through a shimmering crimson haze, its vision blurred into red doubled shapes, small red needle-points pulsing on its body.

name: Effect: Reactions Denied
description: Applied by Tenma Kōfuku on a critical failure. You cannot use reactions. pf2e has no condition for this and no gate on a reaction being taken, so the effect is the enforcement: it sits on the token with its own timer, and it says so on every roll the creature makes. Nothing else in the system can refuse the reaction, which is recorded here rather than quietly dropped.
icon_brief: A creature's raised guard frozen in place, wrapped in pale gold Sanskrit-script bands of light; a small crossed-out lightning-arrow symbol for a reaction that can't fire.

name: Effect: Runes Severed
description: Applied by the fourteenth Scarlet Needle. This creature's Strikes lose all runes. The fundamental runes are taken here — potency and striking both drop to nothing — which is where a weapon's numbers actually live. pf2e has no alteration that clears property runes in one move, only ones that remove a named rune, so a flaming or a ghost touch rune stays until the GM takes it off. An NPC's Strikes have no runes at all: their attack and damage are flat numbers, and nothing in the system can find a rune to strip.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Milo's fourteenth Scarlet Needle
icon_brief: A sword blade whose glowing engraved runes are bursting off it in fragments, each struck through by a crimson needle-point of light; the runes fade to dull grey steel.

name: Effect: Scarlet Needle
description: Applied by Scarlet Needle, by Place a Scarlet Needle, by Crimson Flurry, and by both Scorpio skies. The badge counts the needles currently in this creature . That is the whole tracker: needles are per-creature by definition, and every creature carries its own. The count crosses three thresholds by itself, once each: at 5 the creature is enfeebled 1, at 10 it is blinded, and at 14 it is stunned 2 and its Strikes lose all runes. Scorpio's Techniques read the count too: 5 needles is the requirement for Antares, Crimson Mirage deals its mental damage per needle, and the Ascendant bleed is 1d6 a needle to a maximum of ten. The needles last until the encounter ends, which is what the Cloth says; a full rest clears them too, and outside an encounter the effect can be removed by hand.
icon_brief: A patch of skin with several small crimson puncture points, joined by faint red lines into the hooked tail of the Scorpius constellation; a single drop of blood under the brightest point.

name: Effect: Sense Lost (Smell and Taste)
description: Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Virgo). The creature has lost its sense of smell and taste. It cannot detect creatures or objects by scent, and anything requiring taste automatically fails. Senses lost this way return only through restoration or a full night's rest.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Shaka's Tenbu Hōrin (sense stripped)
icon_brief: A nose and lips shape outlined in pale gold, dissolving into drifting lotus petals; a faint dharma-wheel ring behind them shows a sense being taken away.

name: Effect: Sense Lost (Touch)
description: Applied by Sky: Ascendant (Virgo). The creature has lost its sense of touch: it takes a −4 penalty to attack rolls and cannot Grapple. Senses lost this way return only through restoration or a full night's rest.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Shaka's Tenbu Hōrin (sense stripped)
icon_brief: An open hand turning grey and translucent from the fingertips, its outline crumbling into golden motes; a numb, colourless hand set against a pale gold wheel of light.

name: Sky: Ascendant (Aquarius)
description: ♒ Aquarius is ascendant today. Your Cloth is awake. For the whole day your Techniques heighten as though you were 4 levels higher , and you have your Ascendant Boon. Any cold damage you deal forces a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC; on a failure the creature is slowed 1. This is cumulative — at slowed 4 it is instead petrified in ice , which any critical hit shatters. Your cold damage ignores cold resistance and treats cold immunity as resistance 10. Granted by Ascendant Constellation. Applied and removed by the module's sky tracker; a GM can also drag it on by hand.

name: Cosmo Sense
description: By reading the microcosm of a creature, you gauge the macrocosm it can call on. Cosmo Sense ◆ (single action) Attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about a creature within 60 feet, using your key ability modifier in place of the relevant skill. Success You learn its level relative to yours (higher, equal, or lower) and its single highest and lowest saving throws. Critical Success As success, and you also learn its current focus or spell resources, or that it has none. This is a fortune-free, magic-based sense: it reads the cosmo beneath, so it works through disguise and illusion.
icon_brief: A small glowing sphere (microcosm) held between two fingers, reflecting a vast swirling galaxy (macrocosm) inside it; a faint scanning ring around it.

name: Fists of the Constellation
description: You channel your Signature Technique through your fists, letting its essence bleed into every strike. Choose one damage type dealt by your Cloth's Signature Technique — electricity for Leo, cold for Aquarius, force by default. Your unarmed Strikes deal that damage type instead of bludgeoning, and they count as your Signature Technique's element for your own feats and boons that reference it. Once per round, when you critically hit with an unarmed Strike, the target also takes persistent damage of that type equal to your number of weapon damage dice. Special If your Cloth's Signature Technique deals no damage (Gemini, Virgo), choose force instead. Your unarmed Strikes then gain the effect that best fits your Cloth at the GM's discretion: for Virgo, a critical hit leaves the target dazzled 1 round; for Gemini, a critical hit leaves the target off-guard to you until the end of your next turn.
icon_brief: A clenched gold-gauntleted fist with a small glowing constellation of star points and connecting lines across the knuckles, sparking with the signature element.

name: Pandora Box
description: Your dismissed Cloth is not merely stored — it is sent , and it can find you again across any distance. When you dismiss your Cloth, you may send it to a pocket of folded space instead of collapsing it into a box or onto your body. While there it is beyond the reach of any effect. As an activity taking 10 minutes , you may summon it to your current location from anywhere on the same plane; from another plane it arrives after 24 hours , travelling the dimensional roads on its own. Your Cloth can also act as a courier. You may send it away carrying a single object of 2 Bulk or less, name a destination you have visited, and it will travel there and back over 24 hours. A Saint's Cloth cannot be intercepted, tracked, or compelled while travelling — only destroyed, and only by something that can catch it.
icon_brief: A square metal Cloth box with a constellation emblem embossed on its lid and leather shoulder straps, half-sunk into a fold of starry space as if sent through it.

name: Saint's Vow
description: You swear to protect one person, and the oath sharpens you against whatever threatens them. Choose one ally during your daily preparations; they are the target of your Vow until your next preparations. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against any creature that has damaged the target of your Vow, or attempted to inflict a condition on them, since the end of your last turn. Additionally, once per round when the target of your Vow would be reduced to 0 Hit Points while you are within 30 feet, you may use a reaction to Stride up to your Speed toward them . If this brings them within your reach, they remain at 1 Hit Point instead. A given ally can be saved this way only once per hour. Special You may have only one Vow at a time. Deliberately breaking a Vow — abandoning the person you swore to protect — costs you the use of this feat until you complete a full day of atonement.
icon_brief: Two hands clasped in an oath, a thin golden thread of cosmo linking one wrist to a protected figure's silhouette; a small shield-shaped star between them.

name: Cosmo Legend
description: Your Techniques burn at the full furnace of your cosmo, not half. All your Techniques gain one additional heightening step , as though you were 2 levels higher than you are. This applies to every Technique you know, at every slot. Balance note: this is deliberately a capstone-tier feat — roughly +15% Technique output, and it stacks with Cloth Attunement at 17th for two steps. Watch it in play.
icon_brief: A roaring furnace of golden cosmo shaped like a burning star, with a small technique glyph at its heart and flames climbing past the frame.

name: Cosmo Overflow
description: Your inner cosmo runs over its banks. On the days the sky ignores you, you compensate through sheer output; on the days it favours you, you become a furnace. Cosmo Overflow ◆◆ (two actions) Frequency once per hour You cast a Technique you know of 2 actions or fewer without spending a Focus Point . On any day your Cloth's constellation is ascendant or Exalted, the frequency increases to once per 10 minutes , and the Technique cast this way gains one additional heightening step on top of the sky's.
icon_brief: A golden cosmo aura overflowing its outline like water over a dam, spilling in waves of light from a glowing core.

name: Golden Cosmo
description: Your cosmo answers not only to your own star but to the ones beside it. On any day one of the two constellations adjacent to yours in the zodiac is ascendant, you gain your Ascendant Boon at half effect : halve any bonus, extra damage die, extra action, or emanation radius it grants (minimum 1 where the boon grants a number), and any frequency of once per round becomes once per minute. If an adjacent sign rises Exalted , you gain your Ascendant Boon at full effect instead of your Zenith Boon. Your own sign rising always takes precedence. Design note: this feat is listed in the class guide's feat table but was never written up. The rules here are a first pass from its one-line description and are the most likely thing in this module to want a second look.
icon_brief: A golden constellation in the centre with its two neighbouring zodiac constellations on either side glowing at half brightness, linked to it by thin gold lines.

name: Cloth Resonance
description: Your bond with your Cloth has deepened past armor into a second body. Its runes, its history, and your cosmo have become one thing, and it answers your intent before your mind forms it. Choose two benefits from the list below; you gain both. You may retrain to swap one whenever you gain a level. Reactive Cloth — your Cloth's AC bonus applies even in the brief instants surprise would deny it to you, and you are never off-guard during the first round of combat while wearing it. Runic Echo — the property runes on your Cloth also apply to one Technique of your choice, as Cloth Bond but for property runes. If you have Cloth Bond , it now covers a second Technique as well. Self-Mending — when your Cloth would crack, it does not; instead you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level. Once per encounter. Cosmo Conduit — once per day, when you Refocus, you regain 2 Focus Points instead of 1. Special On any day your Cloth's constellation is ascendant, you gain the benefit of all four options for that day.
icon_brief: A piece of gold armour plate with glowing engraved runes pulsing in time with a heartbeat-shaped line of cosmo running through it.

name: Second Ascension
description: For a moment, by sheer will, you make the sky obey. Frequency three times per week For 1 minute , treat the day as though your Cloth's constellation were ascendant, gaining your Ascendant Boon. If your sign is already ascendant but not Exalted, you may instead spend this to treat the day as Exalted for 1 minute, gaining your Zenith Boon. You cannot use Second Ascension and Seventh Sense's Burn Your Cosmo on the same turn.
icon_brief: A fist raised toward the sky, pulling a single zodiac constellation down so it shines directly above, a burst of will-light around the fist.

name: Rising Cosmo
description: Every Saint learns the same truth on the edge of defeat: the more you are hurt, the brighter you burn. As the fight turns against you, your cosmo climbs — and the wounds that should end you become the fuel that answers back. You gain a rising bonus that starts at 0 and increases by 1 each time you are critically hit, are reduced to half your Hit Points or lower for the first time, or are reduced to 0 Hit Points, to a maximum of +3. It resets at the end of the encounter or after a 10-minute rest. While the rising bonus is at least +1, you gain that value as a status bonus to unarmed Strike damage and to your Technique DCs . At +2 or more you also gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. At +3, once per round you may Step or Stride 5 feet as a free action when you take damage — the cosmo will not let you simply stand and fall. Special On any day your Cloth's constellation is ascendant or Exalted, your rising bonus starts each encounter at +1 rather than 0. Your cosmo is already lit before the first blow lands.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — the Seventh Sense awakening
icon_brief: A cracked, battered gold gauntlet blazing brighter where the cracks are, flames of cosmo climbing out of the damage.

name: Speed of Light
description: You cross the distance between two heartbeats. Frequency once per day You are quickened 1 for 1 minute . You can use the extra action each round only to Strike, Stride, or Step. While quickened this way you also do not trigger reactions based on your movement — you are simply not where the reaction expected you to be.
icon_brief: A golden afterimage streak crossing the frame in an instant, a straight line of light with trailing sparks and a faint heartbeat line beneath.

name: Atomic Dissolution
description: Camus taught it plainly: to freeze a thing, still its atoms; to destroy a thing, part them. Every technique you have ever thrown was this, and now you do it deliberately, with your hands, to anything at all. Your unarmed Strikes ignore an object's Hardness entirely , and you can damage and destroy objects and structures of any material with your bare hands, including those normally immune to nonmagical damage. Your unarmed Strikes and Techniques treat any creature's resistance to your damage as 5 lower . This stacks with, and applies before, Seventh Sense's resistance-ignoring. You can affect a creature or object that is incorporeal, gaseous, liquid, or otherwise diffuse — a swarm, an air elemental, a creature in gaseous form — with your unarmed Strikes at no penalty, and such creatures do not gain their usual resistance to physical attacks against you. Dissolve ◆◆ (two actions, concentrate) Frequency once per 10 minutes Touch one unattended object of up to 10 Bulk, or a 10-foot cube of a structure. It is destroyed , its atoms parted and scattered as a fine glittering dust. This cannot destroy artifacts, Cloths, or objects of similar significance; against a creature's attended object, that creature may attempt a Reflex save against your Cosmo DC to pull it clear. Special On any day your Cloth's constellation is ascendant or Exalted, Dissolve has no frequency limit and its size limit increases to 40 Bulk or a 20-foot cube.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Camus's teaching: Atomic Dissolution
icon_brief: A fist touching a stone block that breaks apart into a cloud of tiny glittering particles, the atoms drifting away as frosty sparkle.

name: Zenith Reach
description: The awakened seventh sense answers you more than once. You may use Seventh Sense's Burn Your Cosmo action twice per day instead of once. Additionally, its duration increases from 1 minute to 1 minute per Focus Point you currently have , up to 3 minutes.
icon_brief: Two overlapping golden suns of cosmo, the second rising out of the first; a small 'VII' glyph in the centre.

name: Entrust Your Cosmo
description: This is the oldest thing a Saint knows how to do. When your own road ends, or when someone else's matters more, you give them what you have left — and they carry it further than you could. Entrust Your Cosmo ◆◆ (two actions) Frequency once per hour Target one willing ally you can touch, or within 30 feet if your Cloth's constellation is ascendant Spend any number of Focus Points. The target gains the following for 1 minute , scaling with the number spent: Focus spent The target gains 1 A +1 status bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks, and temporary Hit Points equal to your level. 2 As above, and their Strikes count as magical and deal an additional 1d6 damage of your Cloth's element. 3 As above, and they become quickened 1 (Strike, Stride, or Step only), and they can see and act normally through any darkness, invisibility, or concealment. While the duration lasts you are enfeebled 1 and cannot Refocus — you gave that away, and it does not come back until the fire returns to you. The Last Gift. If you use Entrust Your Cosmo while you are dying, or as a free action triggered by being reduced to 0 Hit Points, you may spend all remaining Focus Points at once and treat the result as though you had spent 3 , regardless of how many you actually had. The duration becomes 10 minutes , and the target also gains a +2 status bonus to all damage rolls. You immediately become dying 3 — but every Saint who has done this has known exactly what it cost, and done it anyway. Special A creature can benefit from Entrust Your Cosmo only once per hour, no matter how many Saints offer it. Three Saints cannot stack their cosmo into a single champion; the receiving vessel can only hold so much.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Saints entrusting their cosmo
icon_brief: One fading golden hand passing a glowing ball of cosmo into another outstretched hand; the light growing brighter as it changes hands.

name: Not by the Same Attack
description: No technique defeats a Gold Saint a second time. The first strike teaches you; the second finds you ready. Your cosmo reads an attack's structure the instant it lands and rebuilds you against it. The first time each day a given creature deals damage to you with a specific attack, spell, or effect, note it. Every subsequent time that same effect from any source targets you , you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC and saving throw against it, and resistance equal to your level to its damage. You track adaptations for up to five distinct effects at once; if a sixth would be added, the oldest is forgotten. An 'effect' is a specific attack routine, not a damage type — a particular monster's claw Strike, a specific spell, a named technique. The GM adjudicates what counts as the same attack; reskinned or fundamentally altered versions do not. Adapting mid-strike. Once per round, when you would be damaged by an effect you have already adapted to, you may use a reaction to heighten your adaptation: until the start of your next turn, your resistance to that effect increases to twice your level , and if the effect required a save, you improve your degree of success by one step. Special On any day your Cloth's constellation is ascendant or Exalted, your cosmo reads faster than experience: you adapt to an effect the first time it damages you, rather than needing to have suffered it once before.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — 'The same technique never works twice on a Saint'
icon_brief: An attack's energy beam shattering into fragments against a golden constellation shield that has formed in its exact shape; a ghost of the first hit behind.

name: The Thirteenth
description: There is a thirteenth sky, and on the nights it shows there is no constellation in it at all. Every other Saint stands in the dark. You do not. On any day the sky is Starless — no sign ascendant — your own constellation is treated as ascendant instead, and you gain your Ascendant Boon for the whole day. You also always know when a Starless sky is coming, one day in advance. Design note: this feat is listed in the class guide's feat table but was never written up. The rules here are a first pass from its one-line description and are the most likely thing in this module to want a second look.
icon_brief: A totally black night sky with no constellations, and one single golden star burning alone in the middle of the darkness.

name: Two Skies
description: You have learned to read a second sky behind the first, and to stand in both at once. Choose a second Gold Cloth constellation during your daily preparations. Until your next preparations, you are also treated as a Saint of that constellation for the purpose of which days are yours — but not for its Techniques, passive, or Cloth Ability. On a day your chosen second constellation is ascendant, you gain your own Ascendant Boon. If it rises Exalted, you gain your own Ascendant Boon, not your Zenith Boon: the second sky wakes your Cloth but cannot exalt it. This roughly doubles the frequency of your Ascendant days, from 1 in 13 to 2 in 13. Design note: this feat is listed in the class guide's feat table but was never written up. The rules here are a first pass from its one-line description and are the most likely thing in this module to want a second look.
icon_brief: Two layered night skies, one in front of the other, each with a different zodiac constellation glowing gold, both overlapping in the centre.

name: Cloth Bond
description: The runes worked into your Cloth resonate with a technique you have mastered. Choose one Technique you know. The fundamental and property runes on your Cloth also apply to that Technique's spell attack rolls and damage, treating it as though it were a weapon bearing those runes. If the Technique makes a spell attack, it now adds your Cloth's potency bonus to that attack roll, closing the usual gap between Strikes and Techniques for this one Technique. You may retrain this feat to choose a different Technique whenever you gain a level.
icon_brief: A gold armour plate with glowing runes, one rune lifting off and flowing into a technique sigil of cosmo light.

name: Heated-Up Cosmo
description: You stoke your inner cosmo in an instant rather than through long meditation. Once per day you may Refocus as a single action instead of over 10 minutes. You can do this in the middle of an encounter; the burst of raw cosmo is visible as a flare of light around you, and any creature with a sixth sense or equivalent immediately knows your location.
icon_brief: A sudden burst of gold flame erupting from a meditative closed palm, sparks flying outward, a cosmo flash in one beat.

name: Athena Exclamation
description: The forbidden technique. Three cosmos ignited as one tear open a hole where the world used to be. Requirements You are within 30 feet of at least two other creatures who have this feat — Saints, or beings the GM rules can channel cosmo at this tier — and all three of you spend the actions together. Athena Exclamation ◆◆◆ (three actions, and requires two allies to each spend 3 actions) Choose a point within 100 feet . Every creature in a 60-foot burst around that point takes 30d6[force] damage, with a basic Reflex save against the highest Cosmo DC among the three casters. Creatures that critically fail are also knocked prone and deafened for 1 minute. The terrain in the area is permanently obliterated — reduced to a crater of fused glass and silence. Structures without saves are destroyed. The landscape does not recover. Special Using Athena Exclamation is regarded in the Sanctuary as the gravest taboo a Saint can commit: it is the technique that killed gods and drowned continents. Every Saint NPC who learns you have used it will treat you accordingly, and the GM is encouraged to make its use a story event rather than a combat option. Each participant is drained 2 afterward, recoverable only by a full day's rest under an open sky.
icon_brief: Three golden lights joined at a single point in a triangle, collapsing into one blinding white-gold sphere that tears a hole in the world like a miniature Big Bang.

name: Beyond the Eighth
description: Your consciousness has already crossed death once. Now it lingers on the far shore at will. Your Eighth Sense (Arayashiki) improves in three ways: Its duration increases from 1 minute to 10 minutes , or until the encounter ends. While Arayashiki is active you may travel to and from the edge of death as movement : once per round you may Stride through any barrier as though it were not there, stepping briefly into the space between life and death, provided you begin and end in an open space. When Arayashiki ends and you would die, you may instead choose to return changed : you drop to dying 3 rather than dying, and your Cloth shatters, but you are not beyond restoration. You can benefit from this reprieve only once ; the second time your Eighth Sense carries you past death, it keeps you there. This is the ability that lets a Gold Saint walk out of the underworld. Use it as the campaign's punctuation, not its grammar.
icon_brief: A soul-flame of gold standing on the far shore of a dark river of the dead, a small 'VIII' glyph above, with the world of the living behind it.

name: Constellation of One
description: The sky is not finished. It has been added to before — every constellation was drawn by someone, and the ones with the most stars belonged to the ones who did the most. What you have done is enough that the sky has made room for it. A star kindles in your constellation where there was none, and it will still be burning long after your name is a story. Work with your GM to identify the single deed that defines your career as a Saint — a battle survived, a person saved, a god refused, an oath kept at ruinous cost. That deed becomes a star , permanently added to your Cloth's constellation. Name it. For you, immediately: Your Ascendant Boon becomes permanent . It is active every day, regardless of the sky. On days your constellation is genuinely ascendant you gain your Zenith Boon instead; on days it is Exalted, your Zenith Boon and one additional benefit of the GM's choosing drawn from your star's story. For every Saint of your constellation, forever: Any character who wears your Gold Cloth after you — an NPC successor, another player's character, a character in a future campaign at this table — gains the buff of your star. What it grants may vary: a special action, or a permanent passive. Once per day, the wearer may call on your star to gain your Cloth's Ascendant Boon for 1 minute , regardless of the sky. Your name is legible in the sky to anyone with Astronomy Lore. Stargazers reading that constellation see it. NPCs who study the heavens know what you did. Special This is a legacy feat . It is designed to outlive the character who takes it, and the GM should record the star's name somewhere durable — the campaign document, the table's shared notes, a card kept in the game box. The next player to pick up the Cloth inherits it. That is the entire point: a Gold Saint's real capstone is not a technique, it is being remembered by the sky . Balance note: the permanent Ascendant Boon is deliberately enormous — it converts a 7.7%-uptime feature into a 100%-uptime one, roughly a permanent +30% against the tuning curve. At 20th level, with the campaign ending, that is appropriate. It should never be available earlier. Placement note: the guide's appendix lists this feat at 16th level, but its written text is a level-20 capstone and is priced as one. It is placed at 20 here.
icon_brief: A new constellation being drawn in the night sky with lines of gold light, its star points newly lit, the hand-drawn shape of a human figure among old constellations.

name: Rise
description: A Gold Saint does not stay down. Frequency once per day Trigger You are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright. You remain conscious with 1 Hit Point instead of falling. You are wounded 1, or your wounded value increases by 1, and you cannot use this feat again until you have rested. This is a raw refusal to fall, not healing. If the hit would kill you outright — reducing you below the negative of your maximum Hit Points — Rise does not save you.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — A Saint's refusal to fall
icon_brief: A gold gauntlet slamming into the ground and pushing up from it, a burst of golden cosmo exploding around the fist.

name: Second Cloth Technique
description: You have studied a sister Cloth's art. Learn the 1st (Signature) Technique of a Cloth other than your own. It uses your Cosmo DC and focus pool normally, but it heightens one step behind your own Techniques — treat it as gained 2 levels later than you actually gained it. You may retrain which Technique this is when you gain a level. You cannot select another Cloth's 2nd, 3rd, or 4th Technique this way — only its Signature.
icon_brief: A second constellation emblem overlaid on the first, two zodiac glyphs side by side with gold linking lines, one bright and one half-lit.

name: Burning Cosmo
description: You let your cosmo blaze until lesser wills buckle under the sheer weight of it. You do not threaten — you simply are , and it is too much. You can Demoralize using your key ability modifier in place of Intimidation. You are trained in this use even if untrained in Intimidation, and you add your Intimidation proficiency instead if it is higher. When you Demoralize this way you may target any creature within 60 feet that can see you, ignoring the normal 30-foot range and the shared-language requirement — the pressure of an ignited cosmo needs no words. On a critical success the target is frightened 2, and if it is a lower level than you it cannot reduce its frightened value below 1 while it remains within 60 feet of you, until it succeeds against this effect or the encounter ends. Special On any day your Cloth's constellation is ascendant, your cosmo is bright enough to Demoralize every enemy in a 30-foot emanation with a single action, rolling separately against each. A creature that critically succeeds is temporarily immune for 10 minutes as normal.
icon_brief: A blazing golden aura that warps the air, heavy waves of pressure pushing outward; small dark silhouettes shrinking before it.

name: Speed of Sound
description: When the stars align for you, you move faster than the eye can follow. Your Speed increases by 10 feet . On any day your Cloth's constellation is ascendant or Exalted, this bonus increases to +20 feet and you ignore difficult terrain that isn't magical.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Bronze Saints at Mach speed
icon_brief: A sonic-boom cone of pale shockwave rings around a golden streak of movement, dust kicked up behind.

name: Read the Constellation
description: You learn to feel your own constellation approaching over the horizon of days. Frequency once per week During your daily preparations, you learn whether your Cloth's constellation will be ascendant on any of the next three days , and if so which day and whether it will be Exalted. This lets you plan: to press for a confrontation on your day, or to counsel delay until the sky turns. You still learn nothing about the other twelve signs.
icon_brief: A constellation shown on a horizon line with three small dawn-suns ahead of it, one marked by a glowing star: the sign foreseen days in advance.

name: Twin Cosmo
description: You split your focus, unleashing a technique in the same breath as your defense. Frequency once per day Trigger An enemy takes an action that would trigger a reaction you could make, or an ally within 30 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points. You cast one Technique you know with a casting time of 2 actions or fewer as a reaction. If the Technique normally costs a Focus Point, it still does.
icon_brief: A gold arm raised in a guard while a second, ghostly arm of cosmo thrusts a technique forward at the same moment; two layered motions.

name: Set Today's Sky
description: Macro:
icon_brief: A round celestial dial showing the twelve zodiac glyphs, a gold pointer set on one of them, star field behind.

name: Another Dimension
description: Gemini — 1st (Signature) Technique, gained at level 1. You open a seam in space and push someone through it. The target must attempt a Will save. Failure It is banished into folded space for 1 minute, then returns to the square it left. Critical Failure As failure, but for 10 minutes. Heightening (+2 levels) The range increases by 10 feet. At 12th and 16th level, you may target one additional creature. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher. In your Shadow aspect this Technique is instead a single-target confuse effect: Will save, confused for 1 round on a failure.
icon_brief: Space cracking open into a triangular rift outlined in purple light, a swirling void of distorted galaxies inside it, pulling inward.

name: Crystal Wall
description: Aries — 1st (Signature) Technique, gained at level 1. Mu raises the wall, and the thing that was coming stops coming. You create a barrier of solidified cosmo 15 feet long and 10 feet high in an unoccupied space you can see. It has AC 10, Hardness equal to your level, and Hit Points equal to four times your level, and it blocks line of effect. The wall is destroyed when its Hit Points reach 0. Heightening (+2 levels) The wall's length increases by 5 feet. Its Hardness and Hit Points scale with your level automatically. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A flat, nearly invisible pane of crystal light standing upright, faint hexagonal glints across its surface, a projectile bouncing back off it.

name: Diamond Dust
description: Aquarius — 1st (Signature) Technique, gained at level 1. Condensed, icy air launched from the hand; it freezes all it touches. Each creature in the cone takes 1d8[cold] damage with a basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails is slowed 1 for 1 round. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A fist thrust forward releasing a blizzard of sparkling ice crystals and frozen air, white and pale blue diamond glints spreading in a cone.

name: Excalibur
description: Capricorn — 1st (Signature) Technique, gained at level 1. Your arm is the sword. You have simply stopped pretending otherwise. Until the end of your turn, your unarmed Strikes deal slashing damage, gain the deadly d10 trait, and ignore Hardness. Heightening (+2 levels) At 10th level the deadly die becomes d12. At 14th and 18th level, your Strikes deal an additional 1d6 slashing damage. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A forearm held edge-on as a blade, wrapped in a long straight golden light-edge like a holy sword, a clean cut through the air behind it.

name: Golden Arrow
description: Sagittarius — 1st (Signature) Technique, gained at level 1. You draw a bow that is not there and loose an arrow that does not miss for reasons of distance. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC. The arrow ignores cover and concealment. Critical Success Double damage. Success 2d6[force] damage. Golden Arrow has a range increment of 500 feet. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 2d6. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A single golden arrow of light streaking forward from a bow of light, its feathered tail blazing, a long straight trail behind it.

name: Great Horn
description: Taurus — 1st (Signature) Technique, gained at level 1. You lower your shoulder and the air breaks in front of you. Each creature in the cone takes 1d8[bludgeoning] damage with a basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails is pushed 15 feet and knocked prone. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A golden shockwave blasting forward in a cone, shaped like the head and horns of a charging bull, the air rippling.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Leo — 1st (Signature) Technique, gained at level 1. You throw your fist forward and the lightning goes where it is told. Each creature in the line takes 1d12[electricity] damage with a basic Reflex save. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d12. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A fist thrust forward and a single thick bolt of golden-white lightning shooting straight out of it in a line.

name: Piranha Rose
description: Pisces — 1st (Signature) Technique, gained at level 1. Roses go where you point them, and they are hungry. Each target takes 1d8[slashing] damage plus 1d6[persistent,bleed] damage, with a basic Reflex save. A successful save negates the persistent damage. Heightening (+2 levels) The slashing damage increases by 1d8. At 9th, 13th, and 17th level, the persistent bleed damage increases by 1d6. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A swarm of black roses flying forward like teeth, their petals edged sharp, tearing a trail of black and red petals through the air.

name: Rozan Shō Ryū Ha
description: Libra — 1st (Signature) Technique, gained at level 1. Rising Dragon. You strike upward and a column of water and cosmo climbs with your fist. Each creature in the cylinder takes 1d10[bludgeoning] damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature that critically fails is launched 30 feet straight up — and comes down, taking 15 bludgeoning damage from the fall and landing prone. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d10. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Shiryu/Dohko's Rozan Shō Ryū Ha
icon_brief: An uppercut sending a jade-green and gold Chinese dragon spiralling upward in a column of rushing waterfall water.

name: Scarlet Needle
description: Scorpio — 1st (Signature) Technique, gained at level 1. One needle, placed exactly. You will place fourteen more. The target must attempt a Fortitude save. Failure It gains one needle and takes 1d6[persistent,bleed] damage. Critical Failure As failure, and it is off-guard for 1 round. Heightening (+2 levels) The persistent bleed damage increases by 1d6. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A single long crimson fingernail glowing red, firing a thin needle of red light; a tiny red star mark at its tip.

name: Sekishiki Meikai Ha
description: Cancer — 1st (Signature) Technique, gained at level 1. Praesepe Underworld Waves. The target takes 1d8[void] damage with a basic Will save. A creature that fails is also drained 1; one that critically fails is drained 2 and slowed 1. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Deathmask's Sekishiki Meikai Ha
icon_brief: A single index finger pointing upward, a soul being pulled out of a body as a pale blue ghost wisp toward a grey path into darkness.

name: Tenbu Hōrin
description: Virgo — 1st (Signature) Technique, gained at level 1. Treasure of Heaven. You decide what this creature is permitted to perceive. The target must attempt a Will save. Failure It loses one sense of your choice for 1 minute: sight (blinded), hearing (deafened), or smell and taste. Critical Failure Two senses. Heightening (+2 levels) The range increases by 10 feet. At 12th and 16th level, you may target one additional creature. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A huge golden mandala wheel (dharmachakra) spinning, framed by two blossoming sāla trees, lotus petals drifting.

name: Astral Projection
description: Gemini — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6. Saga governed the Sanctuary as two people at once. You project your consciousness into an astral body anywhere within 200 feet that you can see or have visited. For up to 10 minutes you perceive and speak through it. The astral body is invisible to creatures without a sixth sense or see invisibility , cannot be damaged or physically interacted with, and cannot attack — but you may cast mental Techniques through it, using its position as the origin. Your own body is unconscious and off-guard for the duration. Damage to it ends the effect and leaves you stunned 1. Heightening (+2 levels) The range increases by 200 feet and the duration by 5 minutes. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A translucent glowing ghost-double of a figure stepping away from a still body, linked by a thin silver-gold cord.

name: Chiron's Light Impulse
description: Sagittarius — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6. Sagittarius is the centaur Chiron — the teacher. This is his gift: the arrow that guides rather than kills. The target is wreathed in golden light for 1 minute. It gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, its attacks deal an extra 1d6[force] damage, and it gains a fly Speed of 20 feet. Once during the duration, as a free action, the target may treat one attack roll or saving throw as though it had rolled a 10. Heightening (+2 levels) The extra damage increases by 1d6. At 14th level the fly Speed equals the target's Speed. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Aiolos's Chiron's Light Impulse (Episode G)
icon_brief: A soft golden arrow of light wrapping around a target and becoming a gentle golden aura, like a teacher's guiding hand.

name: Crimson Mirage
description: Scorpio — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6. The scarlet haze that comes before Antares. Requirements The target has at least 1 needle. The target must attempt a Will save. Failure For 1 minute it is dazzled, treats all other creatures as concealed, and takes 1d6[mental] damage per needle it currently has at the end of each of its turns. Critical Failure As failure, and it is confused for 1 round as the mirage overtakes it entirely. Heightening (+2 levels) At 10th, 14th, and 18th level, the per-needle damage increases by 1d6. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A red haze clouding the eyes, everything beyond tinted crimson and blurred, with faint red needle points glowing inside the mist.

name: Jumping Stone
description: Capricorn — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6. Shura's leap — he crosses the distance and the blade arrives before he does. Stride up to twice your Speed , ignoring difficult terrain and crossing gaps up to 20 feet as though on solid ground. This movement does not trigger reactions. At any point during the movement, make one unarmed Strike dealing an additional 3d8[slashing] damage. If you moved at least 20 feet before the Strike, treat the target's AC as 2 lower . Heightening (+2 levels) The additional damage increases by 1d8. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher. Automation note: whether you moved 20 feet before the Strike is a fact about the movement, which Foundry cannot read back from a Stride already taken. Toggle it on the Technique before you attack and the +2 circumstance bonus applies to this roll; the difficult-terrain and 20-foot-gap clauses remain the table's to adjudicate.
icon_brief: A blade-arm leaping across a gap in a long arc, a golden slash trailing behind and stone fragments flying where it pushed off.

name: Koliço
description: Aquarius — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6. Ice Rings — rings of cold generated from the fingers, which surround the target and render the captive unable to move. The target must attempt a Reflex save. Success Half damage and slowed 1 for 1 round. Failure 3d8[cold] damage and immobilized for 1 minute (Escape DC equal to your Cosmo DC; the rings have Hardness 8 and 30 Hit Points, and shatter if destroyed). Critical Failure As failure, and it is also restrained . Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8, and the rings gain +2 Hardness and +10 Hit Points. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: Several rings of icy white-blue wind spiralling from a fingertip and locking around a target's body like frozen hoops.

name: Lightning Crown
description: Leo — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6. The Saint sends cosmo into the ground, and it erupts as pillars of electricity. Choose up to three 5-foot squares within 60 feet; a pillar of lightning erupts from each. You aim the 15-foot square each pillar fills — the square it stands in and everything adjacent to it. A creature in or adjacent to a pillar takes 3d8[electricity] damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature caught by two or more pillars rolls once and takes damage once, but suffers a −2 circumstance penalty to that save. A creature that critically fails is knocked prone. The pillars persist for 1 round, shedding bright light and blocking line of sight through their squares. They do not block movement. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8. At 10th, 14th, and 18th level, add one pillar. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Aiolia's Lightning Crown (Episode G)
icon_brief: Three pillars of crackling gold lightning erupting straight up out of the ground in a crown-like ring.

name: Pleiades Nova
description: Taurus — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6. The star cluster on the Bull's shoulder, thrown as points of light. Make five ranged unarmed Strikes against any creatures within 60 feet, each dealing 1d6[force] damage plus your key ability modifier. Your multiple attack penalty does not increase during this activity, but each Strike after the first takes a cumulative −1 penalty as the light scatters. The activity counts as three attacks for your multiple attack penalty afterward. Heightening (+2 levels) Each Strike's damage increases by 1d6. At 12th and 18th level, add one Strike, to a maximum of seven. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A fist sending a cluster of seven bright blue-white stars flying forward, like the Pleiades thrown as glowing points.

name: Royal Demon Rose
description: Pisces — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6. The white roses whose scent alone kills — Aphrodite's first garden. A 20-foot burst fills with drifting white petals for 1 minute. Any creature that starts its turn in the area must attempt a Fortitude save. Failure 3d8[poison] damage and enfeebled 1. Critical Failure As failure, and stupefied 2 for 1 minute — the scent takes the mind before the body. Creatures with no sense of smell are unaffected. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Aphrodite's Royal Demon Rose
icon_brief: A drifting cloud of pale white rose petals hanging in the air, their sweet poisonous scent shown as faint lavender mist.

name: Sekishiki Kisōen
description: Cancer — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6. Demonic Blue Flames — cold fire that burns by feeding on souls. Each creature in the area takes 3d8[void] damage with a basic Will save. The flames feed: for each creature that fails its save, you regain 3 Hit Points , to a maximum equal to your level per casting. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this Technique has its soul consumed and cannot be raised by any effect below resurrect . Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8 and the healing per failure by 2. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: Ghostly cold blue flames (onibi) burning over a field, each flame carrying a tiny screaming face as it feeds on souls.

name: Starlight Extinction
description: Aries — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6. Mu's art: the thing is not broken, it is sent away. The target must attempt a Will save. Failure It is teleported 60 feet in a direction you choose, arriving in the nearest open space. Critical Failure It is teleported 250 feet, lands prone, and takes 3d6[force] damage. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d6 and the failure distance by 30 feet. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A swirling spiral of starlight and galaxy dust wrapping a target and dissolving it away into the cosmos.

name: Tenpōrin'in
description: Virgo — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6. Clarity of Mind — the wheel of dharma turning, clarity offered outward. You and your allies in the emanation gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves and to saves against mental effects, and are immune to the fascinated and frightened conditions, for 1 minute. When you cast this Technique, a card offers every mental effect on a creature in the area; choosing one counteracts it with your Cosmo statistic. Heightening (+2 levels) The emanation increases by 5 feet. At 12th level the bonus becomes +2 and the immunity extends to confused; at 18th level the bonus becomes +3. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A slowly turning golden dharma wheel radiating calm rings of light, a quiet halo spreading over allies.

name: The Twelve Arms
description: Libra — 2nd Technique, gained at level 6. Twelve weapons, six pairs of hands that are not yours. Distribute up to five Arms (matched pairs) to allies within 30 feet; you keep at least one. For 3 rounds , each ally wielding an Arm uses your weapon proficiency with it, receives its full Arms Advance for your level, and gains that Arm's Art (including its Greater and Perfect upgrades). The weapons cannot be dropped involuntarily and return to your Cloth when the duration ends. Heightening (+2 levels) The duration increases by 1 round and the range by 10 feet. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher. Duration ceiling. 3 rounds at 6th, 10 rounds at 20th. A 20th-level Saint on an Exalted day with Cloth Attunement reaches 12 heightening steps — 15 rounds, the hard maximum . The Arms are a burst of largesse, not a party-wide loadout swap. Each ally you target is whispered a card of the six Arms; picking one creates that matched pair in their hands, already equipped, with your proficiency and your Advance written into it.
icon_brief: Six pairs of golden weapons (swords, tridents, staffs, nunchaku, tonfa, shields) flying outward in a fan from a set of balance scales.

name: Crimson Flurry
description: Scorpio — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11. Fifteen needles delivered in a single burst rather than one at a time. Make four unarmed Strikes against any creatures within 30 feet at no increase to your multiple attack penalty. Target whoever you mean to hit before you cast; the Strikes are dealt out among them in turn, so one enemy takes all four. Each Strike that hits applies one needle in addition to its normal effect. On any day your constellation is ascendant, Strikes that miss apply a needle too. The activity counts as three attacks for your multiple attack penalty afterward — pf2e does not count a turn's attacks, so that last clause is yours to honour. Heightening (+2 levels) At 15th and 19th level, add one Strike. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A burst of many crimson needles of light fanning out from one fingertip at once, red streaks hitting multiple points.

name: Crimson Fog
description: Pisces — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11. Bloody Rose Blizzard — a storm of red roses, the garden released all at once. Each creature in the area takes 6d8[piercing] damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature that fails also takes 3d6[persistent,bleed] damage. The area fills with crimson petals for 1 minute: it is difficult terrain , and creatures inside are concealed from anyone outside and vice versa. You and your allies ignore both effects — you know where the roses are. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8 and the persistent bleed damage by 1d6. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Aphrodite's Bloody Rose blizzard
icon_brief: A storm of red roses swirling across the frame in a blizzard of crimson petals.

name: Crystal Net
description: Aries — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11. A net woven by psychokinetic power that traps the adversary and completely inhibits their mobility. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save. Success It is restrained until the end of its next turn. Failure It is immobilized for 1 minute (Escape DC equal to your Cosmo DC). Critical Failure As failure, and it takes 6d8[force] damage. A creature that Escapes shatters its portion of the net. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8 and the burst by 5 feet. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A spiderweb of glittering crystal threads strung in the air, catching and binding a struggling silhouette.

name: Double Excalibur
description: Capricorn — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11. Both arms as blades — the technique that cuts twice in the space of one cut. Make two unarmed Strikes against a single creature within reach. Both are made at your full attack modifier with no multiple attack penalty, both gain deadly d12, and both ignore Hardness, resistance, and immunity to physical damage. If both hit, the target must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC; on a failure it is severed, as The Sharpest Sword. The activity counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty afterward — pf2e does not count a turn's attacks, so that last clause is yours to honour. Heightening (+2 levels) Each Strike deals an additional 1d8 slashing damage. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher. Automation note: in the guide this Technique's bonus damage starts at zero and is purely a heightening rider, but a pf2e spell needs a base formula to scale from. The base here is 1d1 — a flat 1 point, deliberately beneath notice — so that the heightening steps and the sky's bonus dice both apply automatically instead of being tracked by hand.
icon_brief: Two forearms crossed into an X, each edged with a long golden blade of light, two cuts landing as one.

name: Freezing Shield
description: Aquarius — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11. Dégel's defensive art — a wall of absolute cold that stops what is thrown at it. A dome of frozen air with a 20-foot radius forms centred on you and lasts 1 minute. You and your allies inside gain cold resistance 15 and a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against ranged attacks. Any creature hostile to you that enters the dome or ends its turn inside takes 6d8[cold] damage with a basic Fortitude save, and is slowed 1 on a failure. Ranged attacks and spell attacks crossing into the dome from outside take a −4 circumstance penalty. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8, the resistance by 5, and the radius by 5 feet. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Dégel's Freezing Shield (Lost Canvas)
icon_brief: A dome of frozen, misty air surrounding the user, ice crystals forming on its surface as an attack freezes against it.

name: Galaxian Explosion
description: Gemini — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11. A galaxy's birth compressed into a fist. Each creature in the area takes 6d8[force] damage with a basic Reflex save. The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute as space folds in on itself. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: Planets and stars aligned in a row, bursting into a galaxy-scale explosion of purple, blue and white light.

name: Infinity Break
description: Sagittarius — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11. Aiolos's shot travelled fourteen years to reach its target. Choose a direction. The arrow travels in a line of any length up to one mile . Each creature in the line takes 12d6[force] damage with a basic Reflex save. The arrow passes through walls, structures, cover, and any barrier with Hardness less than 20 , destroying a 5-foot section of each as it goes. You do not need line of sight — only a direction, and the conviction that something is there. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 2d6. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A barrage of countless golden arrows of light streaking forward in an endless straight line to the horizon.

name: Lightning Plasma
description: Leo — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11. You are in more places than one, briefly, and each of them is punching. Make three unarmed Strikes against any creatures within 30 feet at no increase to your multiple attack penalty. Target whoever you mean to hit before you cast; the Strikes are dealt out among them in turn, so one enemy takes all three. The activity counts as three attacks for your multiple attack penalty afterward — pf2e does not count a turn's attacks, so that last clause is yours to honour. Heightening (+2 levels) At 17th level, add one Strike. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A dense lattice of hundreds of golden lightning beams criss-crossing in every direction from a single point.

name: Rozan Ryū Hi Shō
description: Libra — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11. Dragon Flight — the Saint punches forward as if flying, and the dragon leaves the ground carrying the strike with it. Fly up to 60 feet in a straight line and make one unarmed Strike or Libra weapon Strike at any point during the movement, dealing +6d8 damage on a hit. This movement doesn't trigger reactions. On a hit you may continue to the end of your movement; on a miss you stop adjacent to the target. On a critical hit, the target is carried with you to the end of your flight and knocked prone. Heightening (+2 levels) The additional damage increases by 1d8 and the flight by 10 feet. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher. Target the creature and cast: the Strike is rolled with whichever Libra weapon is in your hands — or your fist, if none is — and followed through to its damage. The flight itself is your own movement, and the range you may target is the distance you may cover.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Shiryu's Rozan Ryū Hi Shō
icon_brief: A flying punch carried forward by a jade-green dragon soaring horizontally, its body wrapped around the strike.

name: Sekishiki Konsō Ha
description: Cancer — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11. Soul Burial Waves — nearby spirits taken as gunpowder; the explosion is proportional to their strength. Each creature in the area takes 6d8[void] damage with a basic Fortitude save. Add 1d8 for every creature that has died in this area within the last hour , to a maximum of +5d8. Undead and spirits in the area take an additional 2d8 damage and are slowed 1 on a failure. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Manigoldo's Sekishiki Konsō Ha
icon_brief: Many blue ghost-souls gathered into a sphere and detonating in a burst of pale blue spirit-fire.

name: Tenma Kōfuku
description: Virgo — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11. Demon Pacifier — cosmo manifested physically between the palms, then released as light. You compress your cosmo between your hands for the entire casting, then release it. Each creature in the cone takes 6d8[force] damage with a basic Will save — this strikes the spirit, not the body. A creature that fails is stunned 1; one that critically fails is stunned 3 and cannot use reactions for 1 minute. Special If you release this while your eyes are open — the same turn you spent your Om stacks — the cone becomes a 60-foot emanation centred on you. The Technique reads the toggle on Effect: Om and changes shape by itself. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A ball of compressed cosmo between two palms, released as a vast cone of gold light shaped like a demon's face.

name: Titan's Stance
description: Taurus — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11. Aldebaran does not dodge. He stands where the blow was going. Trigger An ally within 15 feet would be hit by an attack or targeted by a damaging effect. You interpose yourself and become the target instead. You take the damage reduced by 10 plus twice your level , and you cannot be moved from your square by that effect. Heightening (+2 levels) The reduction scales with your level automatically. At 15th and 19th level you may use this one additional time per round. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A massive figure standing with arms folded in front of an ally, a golden bull-horn aura taking the blow head-on.

name: Aiolos's Wings
description: Sagittarius — 4th (Ultimate) Technique, gained at level 16. You take on the aspect of the constellation itself. For 10 minutes you gain a fly Speed equal to twice your Speed , you can Fly at full speed while attacking without penalty, and Golden Arrow becomes a 1-action Technique that costs no Focus Point. You may also share flight with up to five allies within 30 feet, each gaining a fly Speed equal to their own Speed for the duration. Heightening (+2 levels) The duration increases by 5 minutes. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A huge pair of golden feathered wings spread wide in the sky, glowing feathers drifting from them.

name: Antares
description: Scorpio — 4th (Ultimate) Technique, gained at level 16. The last needle is the heart. You have been walking toward it for fourteen strikes. Requirements The target has at least 5 needles. The target must attempt a Fortitude save. Failure 16d6[piercing] damage and paralyzed for 1 round. Critical Failure It dies — the scarlet star at the Scorpion's heart has found its own. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 2d6. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A single crimson needle of light piercing a glowing red star at the heart, the star Antares, with fourteen dimmer red points around it.

name: Athena's Arsenal: Overdrive
description: Libra — 4th (Ultimate) Technique, gained at level 16. All twelve weapons released at once — the arsenal Athena entrusted to a single Saint. Every Arm detaches and attacks independently. Make six Strikes distributed as you choose among creatures within 60 feet, one with a weapon from each of the six Arms , each dealing that weapon's damage +2d8 . Each Strike counts as the second weapon of its pair, so the twin bonus always applies, and each applies its Arm's Art wherever that Art's trigger is met. The multiple attack penalty does not apply to any of these Strikes; the activity counts as three attacks for your multiple attack penalty afterward. For 1 minute afterward the twelve weapons circle you: +2 circumstance bonus to AC , and any creature that ends its turn adjacent to you takes 2d8[slashing] damage. Heightening (+2 levels) Each Strike's additional damage increases by 1d8. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher. Target up to six creatures within 60 feet and cast: the six Strikes are rolled in Arm order and followed through to their damage, the twin bonus already in the number. Each Art's own trigger is still yours to use — the free actions and reactions are on your sheet.
icon_brief: All twelve golden weapons flying out at once in a circle, each spinning and attacking on its own around the scales.

name: Excalibur: The Sword That Cuts Everything
description: Capricorn — 4th (Ultimate) Technique, gained at level 16. The blade Athena gave to a mortal, used at its full extension. Each creature in the line takes 16d6[slashing] damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature that critically fails is severed , no save. This damage ignores all Hardness, all resistances, and all immunities to physical damage , and treats force effects such as wall of force and forcecage as objects with Hardness 0. Any structure, wall, or terrain feature in the line is cut cleanly through. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 2d6. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: One enormous golden blade-edge of light extending to the horizon, slicing a mountain cleanly in two.

name: Freezing Coffin
description: Aquarius — 4th (Ultimate) Technique, gained at level 16. Formed at −273°C, at the limit of absolute zero; its solidity is such that not even the strength of a Gold Saint could break it. The target must attempt a Fortitude save. Failure 16d6[cold] damage and slowed 2 for 1 minute. Critical Failure It is entombed in unmelting ice indefinitely: petrified , ageless, and needing no air. The coffin has Hardness 30 and 120 Hit Points. It ends only by being destroyed, by dispel magic (counteract rank 8), by a cold effect exceeding your own, or by your choice. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 2d6. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A target sealed inside a towering, perfectly clear block of ice shaped like a coffin, frost mist pouring from its base.

name: Mavros Eruption Clast
description: Gemini — 4th (Ultimate) Technique, gained at level 16. Defteros's black flame — the volcanic eruption of the shadow twin. Each creature in the area takes 8d8[fire] damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature that critically fails is blinded for 1 minute : Mavros burns black, and what it takes first is sight. The area burns for 1 minute. A creature that enters it or ends its turn there takes 4d6[persistent,fire] damage. Heightening (+2 levels) The initial damage increases by 1d8 and the persistent fire damage by 1d6. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Defteros's black flame (Lost Canvas)
icon_brief: A fist driving into the ground and an eruption of black flame and molten magma bursting upward like a volcano.

name: Photon Burst
description: Leo — 4th (Ultimate) Technique, gained at level 16. The Lion's cosmo released as raw light, at the speed of light. Choose a 120-foot line or a 30-foot burst within 120 feet as you cast. Each creature in the area takes 16d6[force] damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature that critically fails is blinded for 1 minute and dazzled until it receives restoration . This damage is not reduced by cover , and it ignores concealment, resistance to force, and any effect that would slow or intercept it. Light does not wait. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 2d6. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Aiolia's Photon Burst (Episode G)
icon_brief: A blinding sphere of pure golden-white light exploding outward along a straight line at light speed.

name: Rikudō Rinne
description: Virgo — 4th (Ultimate) Technique, gained at level 16. The Six Realms of Samsara — the soul sent to one of the six worlds while the body remains on the field. The target must attempt a Will save. Success It is stunned 1. Failure Its soul is cast into one of the six realms for 1 minute: it is stunned for the duration, its body standing empty on the battlefield. Critical Failure As failure but for 10 minutes, and on its return it is enfeebled 2 and stupefied 2 for an hour. No one comes back from the six worlds unchanged. Heightening (+2 levels) At 20th level, you may target two creatures. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A great turning wheel divided into six realms, souls being flung into each segment, a golden halo around the hub.

name: Royal Funeral
description: Pisces — 4th (Ultimate) Technique, gained at level 16. Aphrodite's last technique. He calls it a funeral because he has already decided how it ends. A single black rose crosses the distance. The target must attempt a Fortitude save. Success Half damage and enfeebled 1. Failure 16d6[poison] damage, enfeebled 2, and drained 2 — the rose is drinking. Critical Failure The rose reaches the heart and the target dies . It turns red with what it has taken. Special From the rose's colour you know the target's exact current Hit Points , from the moment you cast until the end of the encounter. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 2d6. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher. The damage is dealt per creature by its own degree of success, because this is not a basic save and neither the system nor its helpers scale a non-basic one.
icon_brief: A single black rose flying straight forward, a thin trail of dark petals behind it, against a pale funeral background.

name: Sekishiki Tenryū Ha
description: Cancer — 4th (Ultimate) Technique, gained at level 16. Heaven's Dragon Wave — the march of the spirits, the road to Yomotsu Hirasaka fully open. Each creature in the cone must attempt a Fortitude save. Success Half damage. Failure 8d8[void] damage, and it is dragged 30 feet toward the mouth. Critical Failure As failure, and if the creature is at half Hit Points or fewer it dies , its soul carried away. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher. The damage is dealt per creature by its own degree of success, because this is not a basic save and neither the system nor its helpers scale a non-basic one.
canon_source: Saint Seiya — Manigoldo's Sekishiki Tenryū Ha
icon_brief: A great procession of blue souls marching up a road to the open pit of Yomotsu Hirasaka, forming the shape of a dragon in the sky.

name: Stardust Revolution
description: Aries — 4th (Ultimate) Technique, gained at level 16. Meteors called down from the constellation itself. Each creature in the area takes 8d8[force] damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature that critically fails is stunned 1 and knocked prone. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A storm of glittering golden and white meteors streaking down out of a constellation like a meteor shower.

name: Titan's Break: The Golden Horn
description: Taurus — 4th (Ultimate) Technique, gained at level 16. Aldebaran's charge — the one that ends the fight. Each creature in the line takes 8d8[bludgeoning] damage with a basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails is pushed to the end of the line and knocked prone; one that critically fails takes an additional 4d8[bludgeoning] damage and is stunned 2. Any wall, door, or structure in the line with Hardness less than 20 is destroyed. The horn does not go around things. Heightening (+2 levels) The damage increases by 1d8, and the critical-failure damage by 1d8. On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith , 8 levels higher.
icon_brief: A towering golden bull of light charging forward in a straight line, its horns lowered, a shockwave flattening the ground.

name: Soulbound
description: Three peoples fight the same war with the same physics and opposite manners. A Soul Reaper carries their own soul as a sword, and it argues with them. A Hollow ate its own heart and wears the hole; its power is sealed inside it rather than carried. A Quincy owns no soul-weapon at all — they reach into the air, take the spirit particles that are already there, and make a bow out of them. You are a martial focus-user whose pool refills by fighting . Every technique costs 1 Reiatsu Point, and Rising Pressure hands one back the first time each round you deal damage with your spirit weapon or take damage from an enemy — on a hard per-encounter ceiling. Key Attribute Strength or Dexterity Hit Points 10 plus your Constitution modifier Initial Proficiencies Perception Trained Saving Throws Expert in Fortitude, Expert in Reflex, Trained in Will Skills Trained in Religion, trained in Spirit Lore, trained in your Lineage skill, and trained in a number of additional skills equal to 3 plus your Intelligence modifier Attacks Trained in simple weapons, martial weapons, unarmed attacks, and your spirit weapon Defenses Trained in light armor and unarmored defense Class DC Trained in your Reiatsu DC
icon_brief: Three emblems fused into one roundel: a black-hilted katana, a cracked white Hollow mask fragment, and a blue five-pointed Quincy cross, laid over a pale circle of spiritual light, each piece throwing a different-coloured glow (blue-white, red, blue).

name: Blut
description: Frequency once per round Choose Vene or Arterie . The choice lasts until the start of your next turn, and you cannot have both.
icon_brief: A forearm seen close up with glowing blue reishi veins branching under the skin like circuitry, half the pattern pale-blue (vein) and half deep crimson-blue (artery), meeting at the wrist.

name: Cero Metralleta — Sustain
description: Frequency once per round Fire again in a different direction , at no Reiatsu cost . Choose the cone or the line freshly, as you would on the first shot.
icon_brief: A second fan of dozens of small blue-white cero bullets sweeping out from a pistol muzzle in a new direction, motion arc showing the barrage swinging across the frame.

name: Don the Other Face
description: Cost 1 Reiatsu Point · Frequency once per encounter For 1 minute you gain your borrowed Lineage's Aspect . While it is on, you take a −1 status penalty to Will saves — what you are wearing is not yours, and it argues.
icon_brief: A hand pulling a cracked white bone mask with red slash markings down over a face-shaped shadow, black-and-gold Hollow reiatsu bleeding from the eye holes.

name: Kanzen Saimin — Sustain
description: Frequency once per round · Target one creature you have hypnotized Push the lie further. The target attempts a Will save against your Reiatsu DC; on a failure it is confused until the end of its turn. A creature that is not hypnotized is not affected — there is nothing yet for the lie to be built on.
icon_brief: A swirling vortex of mirror shards around a single reflected moon, the fragments warping into a confused spiral; faint purple light, the image doubling and smearing.

name: Manifest or Dismiss Spirit Weapon
