description: Frequency once per round Your spirit weapon appears in your hand, or dissolves. Dismissed, it cannot be taken from you. If it leaves your hands you can Interact to call it back from up to 30 feet away.
icon_brief: A sword half-formed in mid-air: the hilt solid, the blade still condensing from streaming motes of blue-white spirit particles, or the reverse — dissolving back into them.

name: Pressure Crush (Action)
description: Cost 1 Reiatsu Point Enemies in a 20-foot emanation attempt a Fortitude save; on a failure they are clumsy 1 and take a −5-foot status penalty to Speeds for 1 minute.
icon_brief: A ring of heavy, dark-blue reiatsu pressing down like a lid, the ground cracking into a shallow crater and small debris pinned flat beneath it.

name: Pressure Flare (Action)
description: Frequency once per encounter Enemies within 15 feet must succeed at a Will save against your Reiatsu DC or be frightened 1 .
icon_brief: A sudden flare of jagged, flame-like spiritual pressure bursting outward from a central point, tall aura spikes in pale blue and white, enough to make onlookers recoil.

name: Release
description: Requirements Your spirit weapon is manifested. You speak your release command. Your spirit weapon assumes its released form for the rest of the encounter . The first Release each encounter is free. Releasing again after re-sealing costs 1 Reiatsu Point. You can't Release while your spirit weapon is dismissed. Release is not a stance and doesn't conflict with stance actions.
icon_brief: A sealed katana in mid-transformation: the blade cracking open with light pouring out of the seams, a burst of reiatsu radiating from the tsuba as it takes its released shape.

name: Seal the Art
description: Cost 1 Reiatsu Point Range 30 feet, one creature Attempt to counteract one ongoing magical effect, stance, aura, or release state affecting the target. Your counteract check uses your Reiatsu DC's proficiency and key attribute; your counteract rank is half your level, rounded up . A release state — Shikai, Bankai, Resurrección, Segunda Etapa, Vollständig, a Barbarian's Rage, a Magus's Arcane Cascade, or any comparable ongoing self-buff — is not ended outright but suppressed until the end of the target's next turn , and the target can't re-enter it during that time.
icon_brief: A blue Quincy cross pressed against a ring of wild energy, the energy being drawn in and dimmed — like a lid of blue light snapping shut over a flame.

name: Senbonzakura Kageyoshi — Sustain
description: Frequency once per round Move the second emanation up to 30 feet , or switch modes: Gokei (Total Scene) — the second emanation shrinks to a 10-foot burst centred on one enemy; that enemy takes double the damage and cannot benefit from cover or concealment against it. Senkei (Slaughterscape) — the blades condense into a 20-foot cage around you and one enemy. Neither of you can leave; your Strikes against that enemy ignore all resistances, and you may make one extra Strike each round at your current multiple attack penalty. You lose Senbonzakura's reach and cover-ignoring , and enemies outside the cage cannot be targeted by you. Choosing neither returns the blades to their scattered state.
icon_brief: A rushing river of pink cherry-blossom blades turning in mid-air like a school of fish, a second swirl tightening into a ball around a point.

name: Steady the Breath
description: Steady the Breath is the Refocus activity: you meditate, or you argue with your sword, or you eat something. Ten minutes restores 1 Reiatsu Point . With Deep Breath , the first Steady the Breath each day restores 2 instead.
icon_brief: A sheathed katana laid across a meditation mat with a thin curl of incense smoke, a soft blue glow slowly refilling the scabbard from tip to hilt.

name: Unbound Technique
description: While you are in a Full Release , your Release Technique costs no Reiatsu Points — but you can use it only once per round . This entry is the allowance itself: it pays for the Technique, and when it is spent the Technique cannot be used again until your next round.
icon_brief: A released spirit weapon wreathed in a free-flowing aura whose energy loops back into itself in an endless figure-eight, no cost glyph — power flowing unspent.

name: Zanka no Tachi — Sustain
description: Frequency once per round Select one cardinal aspect. It lasts until you select another. Higashi: Kyokujitsujin — your Strikes ignore all resistances and immunities, and a creature damaged by your spirit weapon can't regain Hit Points and has its regeneration and fast healing suppressed until the end of your next turn. Nishi: Zanjitsu Gokui — fire immunity, resistance to all damage equal to half your level, and a creature that damages you with an unarmed attack, a melee weapon or a Grapple takes 4d6 fire. Minami: Kaka Jūmanokushi Daisōjin — a 20-foot emanation of ash. An enemy that ends its turn in it must succeed at a Reflex save or be grabbed . Kita: Tenchi Kaijin — readies the 60-foot line whose damage cannot be reduced by fire resistance, Blut Vene or Hierro.
icon_brief: A compass rose drawn in ash on cracked earth, each of its four points (east, west, south, north) tipped with a different heat: a burning edge, a flame aura, rising skeletal hands, and a cleaving slash.

name: Deepening Reserve (11th)
description: The well goes down further still. Your maximum reiatsu pool increases to 3 Reiatsu Points. How this works in Foundry: Pathfinder derives your focus pool's size from the focus effects you know — one point per non-cantrip focus effect — and then clamps it to a ceiling. This feature sets that ceiling. Until you have chosen a Spirit and gained its Release Technique, you know no focus effects and the pool reads 0, which is correct rather than broken.
icon_brief: A deep stone well viewed from above, three levels of glowing blue water rings descending into darkness, the lowest ring brightest.

name: Deepening Reserve (5th)
description: The well goes down further than it did. Your maximum reiatsu pool increases to 2 Reiatsu Points. How this works in Foundry: Pathfinder derives your focus pool's size from the focus effects you know — one point per non-cantrip focus effect — and then clamps it to a ceiling. This feature sets that ceiling. Until you have chosen a Spirit and gained its Release Technique, you know no focus effects and the pool reads 0, which is correct rather than broken.
icon_brief: A stone well seen from above with two rings of glowing blue spiritual water inside it, the second ring newly lit.

name: Departed Flesh
description: You're immune to disease, you don't need to eat or drink, and when you roll a success on a save against a poison effect you get a critical success instead. You still need to rest.
canon_source: Bleach — souls in Soul Society (gigai-less body)
icon_brief: A translucent, ghostly hand with a broken chain of fate dangling from the wrist, untouched by a cloud of green poison vapour that parts around it.

name: Flash Step
description: Frequency once per round You step between one instant and the next. Stride up to your Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions. Shunpo · Sonido · Hirenkyaku.
icon_brief: A streak of motion across the frame: a faint afterimage at one end, a sharp flicker of displaced air and a single footprint of light at the other, nothing in between.

name: Full Release
description: Frequency once per day Requirements Your spirit weapon is in its released form and you have at least 1 Reiatsu Point Bankai · Segunda Etapa · Vollständig. For 1 minute : Your spirit weapon's damage die increases by one step. You gain your Spirit's Full Release ability. Your Release Technique costs no Reiatsu Points, but you can use it only once per round . You emit a 15-foot emanation of crushing spiritual pressure. An enemy that ends its turn in the emanation must succeed at a Will save against your Reiatsu DC or become frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune for 10 minutes. When it ends you become fatigued until you rest for 10 minutes, and you can't use Full Release again today.
icon_brief: A towering pillar of reiatsu erupting skyward from a sword, black-and-white energy spiralling up with a shockwave ring spreading at its base.

name: Greater Flash Step
description: You leave an afterimage. Until the start of your next turn after you use Flash Step, the first attack made against you each round requires the attacker to succeed at a DC 5 flat check or the attack misses. Automation note: the flat check is rolled and announced when an attack resolves against you. Pathfinder fixes an attack's outcome before this module can see it, so for now the roll is reported for the table to apply rather than silently cancelling the hit.
icon_brief: Two identical translucent silhouettes, one fading, one solid, with an enemy blade passing harmlessly through the ghostly afterimage.

name: Konsō
description: Soul Burial. A 10-minute exploration activity. Choose a haunt, spirit, or incorporeal undead of your level or lower that is not currently hostile (or has been reduced below half Hit Points and is willing, restrained, or bound). Attempt a Religion or Spirit Lore check against its DC. Critical Success The soul departs peacefully. A haunt is permanently neutralized; an undead is destroyed without violence. You learn one significant fact about its unfinished business. Success As critical success, but you learn nothing. Failure The rite fails; retry after 1 hour. Critical Failure The soul recoils, becomes hostile, and gains a +1 status bonus to attacks against you for 1 minute. A Hollow's Konsō is not a burial — it is an offer to eat the soul cleanly rather than let it degrade. A Quincy's is simply annihilation, which is the historical reason Soul Reapers and Quincy went to war. Consider making this a real table conversation rather than a reskin.
icon_brief: The butt of a katana hilt pressing against a glowing forehead, a black kanji seal blooming at the contact point and a soul dissolving into a flutter of black hell butterflies.

name: Lineage
description: Three peoples fight the same war with the same physics and opposite manners. Choose what you are; the choice is permanent. Soul Reaper Hollow Quincy Buys Kidō breadth (six chosen) and the Zanjutsu family Hierro, Regeneración, Sonido Reishi weapon, Blut, Sealing Pays No resistance, no fast healing, baseline Speed Two fixed kidō (Cero, Bala); no Zanjutsu Two fixed kidō (Heizen, Gritz); no Zanjutsu Ladder Shikai → Bankai Resurrección → Segunda Etapa Schrift → Vollständig Plays as The generalist: a duelist with answers The bruiser: walks in and does not leave The controller: denies the enemy their own tricks
icon_brief: Three paths branching from a single point: a black katana, a white bone mask, and a blue reishi bow at the ends of three diverging roads, a choice to be made.

name: Perfected Full Release
description: Your Full Release lasts 2 minutes instead of 1, its emanation increases to 20 feet , and you are no longer fatigued when it ends.
icon_brief: A Bankai-scale pillar of energy, steadier and wider than the first, its aura ring double-banded and calm at the edges — power held without strain.

name: Refined Release
description: Your Release Technique gains its Refined benefit, listed under your Spirit. The base rank of the Refined effect is 5. Where a Refined benefit widens an area, it is applied here rather than authored into the Technique: a focus effect heightens per rank, and "at 9th level" is not a rank step.
icon_brief: A released blade with its special technique engraved along the fuller in glowing kanji, the light sharper and more precise than a raw release.

name: Reiatsu
description: You have a reiatsu pool : maximum 1 Reiatsu Point, increasing to 2 at 5th level and 3 at 11th. Refill it during your daily preparations, or by spending 10 minutes on Steady the Breath — the Refocus activity. You meditate, or you argue with your sword, or you eat something. Techniques and kidō are focus effects with the reiatsu trait. They use your Reiatsu DC and key attribute, have no rank , and are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, exactly like every other focus effect. Every technique and every costed kidō costs 1 Reiatsu Point . There is no 2-point effect anywhere in the class; the throttles are the pool itself, Rising Pressure's per-encounter ceiling, and the frequencies on individual abilities. How this works in Foundry: Pathfinder derives your focus pool's size from the focus effects you know — one point per non-cantrip focus effect — and then clamps it to a ceiling. This feature sets that ceiling. Until you have chosen a Spirit and gained its Release Technique, you know no focus effects and the pool reads 0, which is correct rather than broken.
icon_brief: A single glowing orb of blue-white spiritual pressure cupped in an open palm, wisps of aura rising off it like steam.

name: Reiatsu Expertise
description: Your spiritual pressure has weight others can feel across a room. Your proficiency rank for your Reiatsu DC increases to expert.
icon_brief: A tall column of visible spiritual pressure rising off a silhouette, shaded heavier at the base so the floor seems to sag under its weight.

name: Reiatsu Mastery
description: Standing near you is a decision other people have to make. Your proficiency rank for your Reiatsu DC increases to master.
icon_brief: A room-filling dome of crushing reiatsu, everything under it bowed toward the floor, the central aura dense and nearly opaque.

name: Released Form
description: Your Lineage offers you a Spirit to choose — a zanpakutō, a Resurrección, or a Schrift. It grants a Release action, a Released Form — permanent changes to your weapon's statistics and traits while released — and a Release Technique , a signature effect costing 1 Reiatsu Point and usable only while released. Release is not a stance. It doesn't conflict with stance actions, and it lasts the whole encounter. Release should stay free and permanent-per-encounter. If it cost a point, everyone would Release on round one anyway and feel taxed. The interesting decision is what you do after releasing.
icon_brief: A sealed weapon beside its released form, an arrow of light between them: plain katana to ornate blade, mask fragment to armour, bow-sigil to full bow.

name: Rising Pressure
description: Once per round, the first time you either deal damage to an enemy with your spirit weapon or take damage from an enemy, you regain 1 Reiatsu Point . You can't exceed your maximum pool, and over the course of a single encounter you can't regain more points this way than your maximum pool size. Level Pool Max per encounter Techniques per fight 1–4 1 +1 2 5–10 2 +2 4 11–20 3 +3 6 Every other focus user in Pathfinder spends down a pool that cannot be replenished until they get ten quiet minutes. This one refills by fighting — and none of it on round one.
icon_brief: A blade striking and drawing a thread of blue reiatsu back into itself from the wound, a small refill gauge glowing at the hilt.

name: Spirit (Hollow)
description: Choose your Spirit — your Resurrección. It grants a Released Form , a Release Technique , and, at 13th level, a Full Release . The choice is permanent.
icon_brief: A cracked bone mask fragment on a hilt, energy splitting the mask open to reveal a beast-shaped silhouette of power within.

name: Spirit (Quincy)
description: Choose your Spirit — your Schrift. It grants a Released Form , a Release Technique , and, at 13th level, a Full Release . The choice is permanent.
icon_brief: A single glowing gothic letter (Schrift) blazing in blue-white light inside a Quincy five-pointed cross, ready to be claimed.

name: Spirit (Soul Reaper)
description: Choose your Spirit — your zanpakutō. It grants a Released Form , a Release Technique , and, at 13th level, a Full Release . The choice is permanent.
icon_brief: A katana held upright with the shadowy shape of its spirit rising behind it, an indistinct figure made of the blade's own reiatsu.

name: Spirit Lore
description: Souls, the afterlife, haunts, and hollow-things — where they come from, what they want, and what is owed to them.
icon_brief: An open old tome showing a ghost, a Hollow mask and a chain of fate sketched in ink, a black hell butterfly resting on the page.

name: Spirit Sense
description: You automatically sense the presence and approximate strength of undead, haunts, spirits, and incorporeal creatures within 60 feet , even through thin barriers, without learning their exact location — they are hidden to you rather than undetected. You can see and target incorporeal creatures normally. You are also trained in Spirit Lore : souls, the afterlife, haunts, and hollow-things.
icon_brief: Faint glowing outlines of spirits and a hollow-mask silhouette behind a thin wall, sensed as warm smudges of light rather than seen.

name: Spirit Weapon
description: Your power has a shape. What that shape is depends on your Lineage — a Soul Reaper's zanpakutō is their own soul with an edge on it, a Hollow's is the fragment of mask that sealed their power inside their body, a Quincy's is a bow condensed out of the air — but the rules are identical. Choose one sealed profile. Your spirit weapon is a martial weapon and always counts as one you're proficient with, regardless of its released form. Profile Damage Traits Blade 1d8 slashing versatile P, two-hand d10 Great Blade 1d10 slashing two-handed, sweep Paired Blades 1d6 slashing (each) agile, finesse, twin Spirit Bow (Quincy only) 1d8 piercing propulsive, range increment 60 ft., reload 0 Voice in the Blade. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against effects that would control you, possess you, or force you to release your weapon. Your spirit weapon cannot be Stolen or permanently Disarmed. A Quincy has no spirit inside the bow, so the bonus instead reflects the Quincy discipline of never letting go of your own reishi. Same number, different sentence. Automation note: "effects that would control you" is not a category Pathfinder models. The bonus applies automatically to possession and mental effects, and to anything your GM tags soulbound-control-save .
icon_brief: A katana, a bone mask fragment and a blue reishi bow arranged in a triangle around a glowing soul flame — three shapes of the same power.

name: Spirit Weave
description: Reishi settles into the weave of what you wear. Your proficiency ranks in light armor and unarmored defense increase to expert.
icon_brief: Close-up of black shihakushō cloth whose weave glows with fine threads of blue reishi, a deflected strike sparking off it.

name: Unsealed
description: You can use Full Release twice per day . While in a Full Release you're immune to fear effects, and the first time each round you critically hit with your spirit weapon you regain 1 Reiatsu Point.
icon_brief: Two reiatsu pillars side by side, a broken seal paper fluttering between them, a burning core of fearless white light at the centre.

name: Weapon Expertise
description: Practice has made the blade an extension of the argument. Your proficiency ranks for simple weapons, martial weapons, unarmed attacks, and your spirit weapon increase to expert. You also gain access to the critical specialization effects of all weapons you are at least expert with.
icon_brief: A katana mid-swing leaving a clean crescent of light, the edge sharp and bright as a mirror.

name: Weapon Mastery
description: Your proficiency ranks for simple weapons, martial weapons, unarmed attacks, and your spirit weapon increase to master.
icon_brief: A katana held in perfect stillness with a single drop falling cleanly in two along its edge.

name: Cero and Bala
description: A Hollow's demon arts are not learned, they are anatomy . You know exactly two kidō and they are always these: Bala , your free cantrip, and Cero . You cannot learn others, and no feat grants you more.
icon_brief: An open palm with a red sphere of cero charging between the fingertips and a small red bullet of compressed reiatsu (bala) shooting off a knuckle.

name: Heilig Bogen and Blut
description: Heilig Bogen ("holy bow"). You may choose the Spirit Bow profile for your spirit weapon. Your bow needs no ammunition; you condense arrows out of ambient reishi. In an area with little or no ambient spiritual energy — a dead-magic zone, a sealed vault — your bow's damage die decreases by one step. Blut [free-action] Frequency once per round. Choose Vene or Arterie . The choice lasts until the start of your next turn. You cannot have both — canon is explicit that they run on two different reishi systems. Blut Vene (defensive) — resistance to physical damage equal to half your level (minimum 1). Blut Arterie (offensive) — your Strikes with your spirit weapon ignore resistances to physical and spirit damage, and treat the target's cover as one step less. Arterie grants no bonus to attack, damage, or DC. It is a resistance bypass, which is how a Quincy shoots through Hierro without touching Pathfinder's attack math.
canon_source: Bleach — Quincy Heilig Bogen and Blut
icon_brief: A glowing blue reishi bow drawn back, ambient particles streaming into the arrow, with blue vein-patterns lighting up along the drawing arm.

name: Heizen and Gritz
description: A Quincy's demon arts are Gintō — small silver tubes of liquefied reiryoku, uncorked and spoken over, which is exactly what Kidō is to a Soul Reaper. You know two and they are always these: Heizen , your free cantrip, and Gritz . You cannot learn others, and no feat grants you more. The third canon Gintō, Sprenger, is not a kidō: it needs five Seele Schneider planted in a pentacle, and it appears where canon puts it — at Uryū Ishida's Final Release.
icon_brief: Two small silver tubes uncorked, liquefied silver reiryoku pouring out and forming a cross-shaped pillar of light (Heizen) and a cage of light bars (Gritz).

name: Hierro and Sonido
description: Hierro ("iron skin"). Your compressed reiryoku hardens your skin. You gain resistance to physical damage equal to half your level (minimum 1). Sonido ("sound"). You gain a +5-foot status bonus to all your Speeds. At 11th level this increases to +10 feet. Hierro is broader than Thermal Nimbus — all physical rather than one energy type — at half the rate, and it arrives at 1st level on a class with light armour and 10 Hit Points. Automation note: Sonido is written as a status bonus in the class guide. A status bonus on the Speed selector is listed in Foundry's breakdown but contributes nothing to the total, while an untyped one on the same selector applies — so it is authored untyped and the five feet actually reach the table.
icon_brief: Steel-grey skin with a blade bouncing off it in sparks, and beside it a blur-streak of high-speed movement with a sonic crack.

name: Hollow
description: Arrancar. You ate your own heart and wear the hole; your power is sealed inside you rather than carried. Granted skill Athletics. Release ladder Resurrección → Segunda Etapa. Your demon arts are not learned, they are anatomy: you know Bala and Cero , you cannot learn others, and no feat grants you more.
icon_brief: A cracked white bone mask fragment over a hole torn through a chest, black hollow energy curling from the void.

name: Kidō Adept
description: You learn two kidō of your choice at 1st level, and one additional kidō at 5th, 9th, 13th and 17th level — six chosen kidō in total, on top of your free cantrip Shō . You are the only Lineage that chooses : a Hollow and a Quincy each get exactly two fixed kidō native to what they are. Six known focus effects is the top of the range Pathfinder permits without a spell list, and this is the Lineage that actually reaches it. Each pickup arrives as its own small feature, so its question is asked at the level it belongs to. A ChoiceSet resolves once, when the item carrying it is created; a predicate decides whether it applies at all rather than making it ask again later.
icon_brief: Six glowing kidō glyph circles arranged in a ring around an outstretched hand, each a different colour (red fire, yellow binding, green healing, blue fire, pale lightning, black).

name: Kidō Learned (13th)
description: You learn one kidō of your choice from the Ways of Destruction, Binding and Mending.
icon_brief: A hand tracing the thirteenth stroke of a kidō incantation in mid-air, the glyph circle completing with an orange flare.

name: Kidō Learned (17th)
description: You learn one kidō of your choice from the Ways of Destruction, Binding and Mending.
icon_brief: A dense kidō glyph circle with many rings, its final ring sealing shut with a white flash — a high-number incantation mastered.

name: Kidō Learned (1st)
description: You learn one kidō of your choice from the Ways of Destruction, Binding and Mending.
icon_brief: A single simple kidō glyph circle glowing in an open palm, the first chant learned, thin and bright.

name: Kidō Learned (2nd)
description: You learn one kidō of your choice from the Ways of Destruction, Binding and Mending.
icon_brief: Two small overlapping kidō glyph circles glowing above a palm, red and yellow.

name: Kidō Learned (5th)
description: You learn one kidō of your choice from the Ways of Destruction, Binding and Mending.
icon_brief: A kidō glyph circle with five spokes of light, glowing green-blue, chant text circling its rim.

name: Kidō Learned (9th)
description: You learn one kidō of your choice from the Ways of Destruction, Binding and Mending.
icon_brief: A layered kidō circle with nine segmented arcs of light orbiting it, a crackle of energy at the centre.

name: Quincy
description: You own no soul-weapon at all. You reach into the air, take the spirit particles that are already there, and make a bow out of them. Granted skill Crafting. Release ladder Schrift → Vollständig. Your demon arts are Gintō — silver tubes of liquefied reiryoku, uncorked and spoken over. You know Heizen and Gritz , and you cannot learn others. At 5th level you gain the talent that started a war: you do not out-fight a Soul Reaper, you switch them off .
icon_brief: Floating spirit particles drawn out of the air and condensing into a blue reishi bow, a blue five-pointed Quincy cross dangling below it.

name: Regeneración
description: High-speed regeneration. You gain fast healing 2 . This increases to fast healing 4 at 11th level and fast healing 6 at 17th. It is deactivated while you have the dying condition , and suppressed until the end of your next turn whenever you take spirit damage or damage from a holy or vitality effect. Soul Reapers and Quincy exist to shut this down, and both can, from 1st level. That clause is the point, not a caveat.
icon_brief: A severed limb regrowing from the stump in a burst of white bone and fresh tissue, with a green-white glow along the seam.

name: Sealing
description: The Quincy talent that started a war: they do not out-fight a Soul Reaper, they switch them off . You gain the Seal the Art activity.
icon_brief: A Quincy cross pressed over a zanpakutō, the blade's glow dimming and draining into the cross — a sword switched off.

name: Segunda Piel
description: Hierro's resistance applies to spirit damage as well as physical, and Regeneración is no longer suppressed by damage from holy or vitality effects. Spirit damage still suppresses it.
icon_brief: Skin plated over with a second, harder layer of white bone-like armour, a spirit blade glancing off with sparks.

name: Sklaverei
description: Absolute subordination of reishi. When you successfully counteract with Seal the Art , you regain 1 Reiatsu Point (ignoring Rising Pressure's per-encounter cap), and the target is off-guard until the end of its next turn. On a critical success against a release state, the suppression lasts 1 minute instead.
icon_brief: Ribbons of spirit particles torn out of the surroundings and spiralling into a single glowing Quincy cross, which shines brighter as it eats them.

name: Soul Reaper
description: Shinigami. You carry your own soul as a sword, and it argues with you. Granted skill Society. Release ladder Shikai → Bankai. You are the only Lineage that chooses its demon arts: six kidō of your own selection, on top of your free cantrip Shō . You also drill the sword arts rather than intuiting them, and gain the Zanjutsu family at 5th level.
icon_brief: A katana in a black scabbard tied with a white sash, a black hell butterfly perched on the hilt.

name: Zanjutsu
description: The sword arts, drilled rather than intuited. You gain access to the Zanjutsu feat family and one Zanjutsu technique of your choice for free. Zanjutsu techniques are Strike-based reiatsu effects, each costing 1 Reiatsu Point and requiring your spirit weapon to be Released. More of the family can be taken as class feats at their listed levels.
icon_brief: A katana in a precise iaido draw, its clean silver arc leaving a single thin line of light.

name: Zanjutsu Mastery
description: Your Zanjutsu techniques' damage dice increase by one step (d6→d8, d8→d10). Once per round, when you critically hit with your spirit weapon, you regain 1 Reiatsu Point. This ignores Rising Pressure's per-encounter cap .
icon_brief: A katana cutting a perfect crescent of light, the edge leaving three ghost-trails, each sharper than the last.

name: Antithesis
description: A — Uryū Ishida. The last Quincy of the old line, and the only one who chose his letter's meaning himself. Antithesis reverses two events that have already happened.
icon_brief: Two arrows of blue light flying in opposite directions along a single line, crossing in an X where a wound and its reversal swap places.

name: Antithesis — Schrift
description: Your Heilig Bogen takes its full shape — a broad blue bow of light. Your spirit weapon gains the Spirit Bow profile if it did not have it, its damage die increases by one step, and its range increment increases to 100 feet . You also gain Seele Schneider (Soul Cutter) : your bow may be used as a melee weapon, 1d8 slashing , finesse , whose vibrating reishi edge means its Strikes ignore resistance to slashing damage .
icon_brief: A broad, winged blue bow of light, its wide arms built like spread wings, a crackling arrow of reishi nocked at the centre.

name: Arrogante
description: Arrogance — Baraggan Louisenbairn. Release: "Rot." The God-King of Hueco Mundo. His aspect of death is aging, and he is in no hurry, because nothing that lives can outlast him.
icon_brief: A sealed zanpakutō: a huge ornate battle axe with an ornamented crown motif on the head, wrapped in a faint purple-black haze of decay.

name: Arrogante — Resurrección
description: Your flesh sloughs away and you stand as a crowned skeleton in a dark cloak. Your spirit weapon becomes Gran Caída (Great Fall) : 1d12 slashing , two-handed, sweep , forceful . You become immune to disease , poison , and the doomed condition's worsening — you can still gain doomed, but it never increases past 1.
icon_brief: A jeweled golden crown floating above a skull in a dark hooded cloak, a massive black double-bladed axe (Gran Caída) planted beside it.

name: Bailar de Valquiria
description: The Miracle Made Flesh. Golden wings, a mane of light, and a body that reassembles itself. You gain fast healing equal to your current Miracle points . When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points while you have at least 5 Miracle points, you instead remain at 1 Hit Point , lose 5 Miracle points, and your spirit weapon's damage die increases by one step for the rest of the encounter. This can occur any number of times as long as you have the points to pay for it. Miracle points are no longer capped , but you still gain only 2 per round. This is the class's only true "does not die" ability, and it is paid for in a resource the enemy controls: it only accrues while you are being hit, and each save costs half your maximum pool.
canon_source: Homebrew (Soulbound class) — based on Gerard Valkyrie's Vollständig
icon_brief: Huge golden wings framing a heart of blazing white light, shattered pieces of armour flying back together around it as the body reassembles.

name: Colmillo
description: Canon gives Starrk no Segunda Etapa. The wolves themselves are canon — Starrk divides his soul and the fragments attack and detonate. You divide your soul. Eight spirit wolves appear in unoccupied squares within 30 feet. They are not creatures : they have no statistics, take no actions, cannot be attacked, and do not flank. They are a resource you spend. At the start of each of your turns, you regain 1 wolf, to a maximum of eight. This is the closest the class comes to minions and it deliberately stops short, so it never touches the Summoner's or Necromancer's design space.
icon_brief: A pack of eight translucent blue-white wolves made of reiatsu fanning out in a ring, eyes glowing, ready to lunge and detonate.

name: Daiguren Hyōrinmaru
description: Grand Crimson Lotus Ice Ring. Ice sheathes you as wings, claws, and a tail. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed and cold resistance equal to your level . Three four-petaled ice flowers hang in the air behind you. They are not a timer — canon is explicit that they mark how long until Daiguren Hyōrinmaru matures . Each is a charge. Once per round you may spend one petal-flower to use Sennen Hyōrō, Hyōryū Senbi, or Zanhyō Ningyō. Perfected (17th) restores one spent petal-flower at the start of each of your turns. This Bankai has no passive per-round damage where Senbonzakura Kageyoshi does: it front-loads into three big, chosen moments instead.
icon_brief: Massive crystalline ice dragon wings spread wide behind a clawed ice arm holding a katana, three four-petaled ice flowers floating in an arc overhead.

name: Deus Ex Machina
description: The Heat at full output. Wings and a halo of blue reishi. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed and fire immunity , and: Burner Finger's Five option becomes a 60-foot cone . Once per round, when you damage a creature with fire, it takes 2d6 persistent fire damage; the flat check to end it is DC 20 rather than DC 15.
canon_source: Homebrew (Soulbound class) — based on Bazz-B's Vollständig
icon_brief: A blazing Quincy pentagram halo of blue reishi hovering over rod-shaped wings of fire, flames licking off every edge.

name: Hirviendo
description: Canon gives Harribel no Segunda Etapa. Hirviendo itself is canon — she boils away all water around her, including ice. Water rises around you in a 20-foot emanation , difficult terrain for enemies. Once per round when you hit with your spirit weapon you may push the target 5 feet. La Gota may be used as a 60-foot line instead of a cone. You also gain Trident and Hirviendo .
icon_brief: A shark-tooth broad blade pointing forward with the water around it boiling into roiling steam, bubbles and hot vapour rising in a ring.

name: Hyōrinmaru
description: Ice Ring — Tōshirō Hitsugaya. Release: "Reign over the frosted heavens." The strongest ice zanpakutō. A patient dragon that thinks in centuries and is annoyed by your hurry.
icon_brief: A sealed katana with a four-pointed star-shaped guard, a faint coil of frost wrapping the blade and an icy dragon eye glinting in its reflection.

name: Hyōrinmaru — Shikai
description: A crescent blade on a chain, trailing an ice dragon. Your spirit weapon's damage type becomes cold (you may still choose spirit). On a critical hit, the target takes a −5-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the end of your next turn.
icon_brief: A crescent-moon blade on a long chain swinging from a katana's hilt, a coiling ice dragon roaring off the blade's tip in blue-white mist.

name: Kanzen Saimin
description: Complete Hypnosis. Canon's condition is precise and this implements it literally: the target must have seen your Shikai release , and thereafter they are in your hypnosis every time you release. The blind are immune. When you Release, and when a creature that can see first observes you while released, that creature must succeed at a Will save against your Reiatsu DC or be hypnotized for 1 minute. While hypnotized: It perceives you 5 feet from where you actually stand . Attacks against you from it require a DC 5 flat check . You are hidden from it whenever you are not adjacent to it, without needing to Hide. A creature that critically succeeds is immune for 24 hours. One that succeeds is immune for 10 minutes. One that critically fails is hypnotized for 1 hour and, once per encounter thereafter, is automatically hypnotized when you Release — the "seen it once, falls to it forever" clause. A creature that cannot see is unaffected entirely. Refined (9th) The flat check increases to DC 6 , and Shikake's failure effect also makes the target off-guard to the misidentified creature. Automation note: the module remembers, per creature, whether it has seen your release, what it rolled, and which immunity window it is inside. That memory travels with you between scenes and outlives the encounter, because canon's clause is about what a creature has seen, not about a fight.
icon_brief: A full moon reflected on a still lake, the reflection slightly offset from the real moon above — a double image warning of illusion.

name: Kanzen Saimin: Sōten Kisshun
description: Canon gives Aizen no Bankai. He never releases one, never names one, and the story treats Kyōka Suigetsu's Shikai as already being the strongest ability in the setting — that is the point of the character. This entry is therefore invented , and it is built as an extension of the Shikai rather than a new form, which is the only honest way to do it. All enemies within 60 feet who can see you must attempt the Shikai save, including those who previously succeeded or became immune . Hitting you no longer ends the effect; only a critical hit does. Once per round you may Sustain to force one hypnotized creature to attempt a Will save; on a failure it is confused until the end of its turn. This Full Release grants no damage, no resistance, no Speed and no die step beyond the base. The re-save clause is the whole of its power.
canon_source: Homebrew (Soulbound class) — invented Bankai for Kyōka Suigetsu
icon_brief: A shattered mirror whose every shard reflects a different false world, all of them showing the same moon; violet light, the surrounding scene splitting apart like glass.

name: Kyōka Suigetsu
description: Mirror Flower, Water Moon — Sōsuke Aizen. Release: "Shatter." A spirit of perfect deception. It does not lie to your enemies. It lies to their senses, and it lies constantly.
icon_brief: A katana held over still water, its reflection rippling into a blooming flower; a full moon mirrored perfectly beside it.

name: Los Lobos
description: The Wolves — Coyote Starrk. Release: "Kick about." The loneliest Espada. His power was never sealed in a sword — it was sealed in another person, because he could not bear to be alone with it.
icon_brief: A sealed katana resting against a howling grey wolf silhouette under the moon, the wolf's shape made of drifting blue reiatsu.

name: Los Lobos — Resurrección
description: Your spirit weapon splits into two ornate pistols . Each is a ranged weapon: 1d6 piercing , agile , range increment 60 feet, reload 0, and they need no ammunition. You may wield and fire both. You also gain a grey wolf-pelt coat and bandolier; your Speed increases by 5 feet. On the second voice: canon's Los Lobos is two beings sharing one power, and the pistols speak. That is a roleplaying fact, not a familiar and not a minion — the second voice takes no actions and has no statistics.
icon_brief: Two ornate, engraved pistols crossed over a wolf-fur pelt, a puff of blue cero smoke at each muzzle.

name: Murciélago
description: Bat — Ulquiorra Cifer. Release: "Enclose." Emptiness given form. Cold, precise, and genuinely curious about what a heart is.
icon_brief: A sealed katana with a dark guard, a single black bat wing unfurling from its hilt in green-tinged shadow.

name: Murciélago — Resurrección
description: Black membranous wings, a tattered coat of energy, and green tear-tracks. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed. Your spirit weapon becomes Luz de la Luna (Light of the Moon) , a javelin of hardened green energy: 1d10 piercing , versatile S, reach , and it re-forms in your hand instantly if thrown or dropped.
icon_brief: A pair of black membranous bat wings spread wide around a bright green javelin of hardened light (Luz de la Luna).

name: Murciélago — Segunda Etapa
description: The only canon Segunda Etapa in the series. Your remaining humanity sheds: black fur, a long whip-like tail, horns, and the mask gone entirely. Your fly Speed increases by 20 feet . You gain resistance to all damage except spirit equal to half your level . High-Speed Regeneration. Your Regeneración fast healing doubles , and it now restores lost limbs. You gain Lanza del Relámpago .
icon_brief: A demonic black silhouette with a long whip-like tail and curved horns, black fur shedding green light, green tear-lines glowing where the face should be.

name: Pantera
description: Panther — Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez. Release: "Grind." A predator that has never once been bored. Speed, claws, and appetite.
icon_brief: A sealed katana with a panther's claw-mark slash across it, blue light seeping from the scratches.

name: Pantera — Resurrección
description: Your mask-fragment dissolves into white armour, claws, and a whip of a tail. You gain two claw unarmed attacks: 1d8 slashing , agile , finesse , in the brawling group. Your Speed increases by 10 feet (this stacks with Sonido).
icon_brief: White armoured claws mid-swipe with a whip-like tail curling behind, blue energy flaring off the claw tips.

name: Pantera — Segunda Etapa
description: Canon gives Grimmjow no Segunda Etapa — Ulquiorra is explicitly the only Espada who reached one. The technique Desgarrón is canon and appears where canon puts it, at his Final Release. This second released form is invented , and is deliberately the least transformative of the five Hollow entries for that reason. Your Speed increases by another 10 feet , and your claws gain deadly d10 . Once per round when you critically hit with a claw, you may immediately make an additional claw Strike against the same target at your current multiple attack penalty. Additionally, Garra de la Pantera 's cone increases to 60 feet , and creatures that critically fail against it take 2d6 persistent bleed from embedded shards.
canon_source: Homebrew (Soulbound class) — invented second form for Grimmjow
icon_brief: Ten long blue energy claws (Desgarrón) arcing out from a pair of white armoured paws, fiercer and longer than before.

name: Quincy: Letzt Stil
description: Last Form. Unlike every other Vollständig, Letzt Stil is not a wings-and-halo transformation — it is the old Quincy technique of removing the limiter on your own bow. A blue quiver of pure reiryoku forms at your right shoulder and drinks the ambient reishi. Your spirit weapon's damage die increases by two steps instead of one. Your Strikes ignore all resistances to physical and spirit damage, and treat cover as one step less — as Blut Arterie, and it stacks with choosing Vene . This is the one exception in the class to Blut's exclusivity. Licht Regen becomes a 60-foot cone , and once per round you may use it without spending a Reiatsu Point. The cost is canon and it is real. When Letzt Stil ends, you lose access to your Schrift Form , your Release Technique , Licht Regen , Vollständig , and your entire reiatsu pool until you complete 24 hours of rest . You keep your weapon, your proficiencies, and your feats. That drawback is the reason this Vollständig grants two die steps where every other grants one.
icon_brief: A blue quiver of pure reiryoku forming at a shoulder, drawing ambient particles in, beside a huge limiter-free bow crackling with uncontrolled power.

name: Respira Absoluta
description: Canon gives Baraggan no Segunda Etapa ; his Resurrección is already treated as the end state. This form extrapolates from what canon does establish: Respira ages everything it touches, including attacks aimed at him and the ground he stands on, and Baraggan can control its speed. Respira becomes permanent and free . You emit a 20-foot emanation of aging miasma for as long as the Segunda Etapa lasts. Enemies that end their turn in it take 3d6[void] damage (basic Fortitude) and are enfeebled 1 for 1 round on a failure. Your decay consumes what is aimed at you. When a creature within the emanation targets you with an attack or a spell, it must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or the attack or spell ages to nothing before it lands and has no effect. A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to this flat check for 1 minute.
canon_source: Homebrew (Soulbound class) — extrapolated from Barragan's Respira
icon_brief: A wide ring of dark purple aging miasma spreading over cracked, crumbling ground, everything it touches withering into dust and bones.

name: Ryūjin Jakka
description: Flowing Blade-like Flame — Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto. Release: "Reduce all creation to ash." The oldest and strongest fire zanpakutō in Soul Society. It does not burn things down so much as decide they are finished.
icon_brief: A sealed katana emerging from a wooden walking cane, the first lick of flame curling from the blade's edge.

name: Ryūjin Jakka — Shikai
description: The blade sheathes itself in flame. Your spirit weapon's damage type becomes fire (you may still choose spirit) and it gains deadly d8 . You gain fire resistance equal to half your level .
icon_brief: A katana fully engulfed in roaring orange flame, the fire streaming off it like a banner.

name: Senbonzakura
description: Thousand Cherry Blossoms — Byakuya Kuchiki. Release: "Scatter." A blade that refuses to be one blade. Aristocratic, precise, and utterly without mercy.
icon_brief: A sealed katana with a single pink cherry blossom petal resting on the blade's edge, already sliced cleanly in two.

name: Senbonzakura — Shikai
description: Your blade disintegrates into a slow cloud of petal-fine blades. Your Strikes gain reach 15 feet and lose the two-hand and twin traits; your hands are empty. Your Strikes are not affected by cover between you and the target — the blades simply go around it.
icon_brief: A katana hilt with no blade, the blade drifting off it as a slow pink cloud of glinting petal-shaped blades.

name: Senbonzakura Kageyoshi
description: Vibrant Display of a Thousand Cherry Blossoms. Two rows of a thousand blades rise from the ground and scatter. You gain a second 20-foot emanation centred on a point within 60 feet. At the start of each of your turns, each enemy in either emanation takes 5d6[slashing] damage with a basic Reflex save. You can Sustain once per round to move the second emanation up to 30 feet, or to switch between these modes: Gokei (Total Scene) — the blades amass into a sphere around one creature and implode. The second emanation shrinks to a 10-foot burst centred on one enemy; that enemy takes double the damage and cannot benefit from cover or concealment against it. Senkei (Slaughterscape) — you abandon defence entirely. The blades condense into a thousand swords forming a 20-foot cage around you and one enemy. Neither of you can leave; your Strikes against that enemy ignore all resistances , and you may make one extra Strike each round at your current multiple attack penalty. You lose Senbonzakura's reach and cover-ignoring , and enemies outside the cage cannot be targeted by you. Canon: Senkei "abandons the defensive attributes to focus entirely on offense."
icon_brief: Two long rows of giant, gleaming swords rising out of darkness, their tops already scattering into a pink torrent of cherry-blossom blades.

name: Tensa Zangetsu
description: Heaven Chain Slaying Moon. Canon compresses rather than expands: everything Ichigo has is forced into a smaller, blacker blade. Your spirit weapon's damage die does not increase, overriding Full Release's normal die step. Instead: You gain a +10-foot status bonus to all Speeds, and Flash Step's frequency becomes twice per round . Getsuga Tenshō becomes 1 action , and its line is 60 feet (90 with Refined). The first time each round you hit with your spirit weapon, you may Step as a free action. This is the speed Bankai, not the damage one, and it gives up its damage-die step to pay for the action compression.
icon_brief: A slim, all-black daitō with a manji (卍)-shaped guard and a short broken chain at the pommel, black reiatsu with a red outline coiling around it.

name: The Balance
description: B — Jugram Haschwalth. Yhwach's second, and the coldest ability in the series: he does not stop misfortune, he moves it onto someone else.
icon_brief: A golden balance scale, one pan holding a bright star of good fortune, the other a dark cloud of misfortune tipping toward a distant figure.

name: The Balance — Schrift
description: Your spirit weapon becomes Freund Schild (Substitute Shield) , canon's name for Haschwalth's spirit weapon — he fights with a blade, not a bow: 1d8 slashing , versatile P, parry . You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC while you have at least 1 Reiatsu Point remaining. This is the one flat numeric bonus in the class. It is a circumstance bonus, so it collides with cover and with Raise a Shield, and it switches off the moment you spend your pool — which, given Rising Pressure, is most of the fight.
icon_brief: A tall ornate kite-shield with a Quincy cross emblem paired with a straight sword, the shield glowing pale blue.

name: The Balance, at Night
description: Canon's Haschwalth holds Yhwach's power while his king sleeps. Wings of white light, a halo, and a sword in each hand. Your Release Technique's damage reduction increases to three times your level . Once per round, when an ally within 60 feet would take damage, you may redirect that damage to yourself; you then apply your Release Technique's reduction to it as a free action without spending your reaction . You may do this even while your reaction is spent. Sight of the Balance: at the start of each of your turns, choose one enemy within 60 feet. Until the start of your next turn, that creature takes a −2 status penalty to its next saving throw, and the next ally who attacks it gains a +1 status bonus to that attack roll.
icon_brief: Wings of white light and a glowing halo behind a sword in each hand, a balance scale glyph shining between them.

name: The Heat
description: H — Bazz-B. Loud, disloyal, and the best pure offensive Schrift in the Wandenreich. He controls heat by counting on his fingers.
icon_brief: Five fingers splayed, each tip burning a different intensity of flame from orange to white-blue, heat haze shimmering around the hand.

name: The Heat — Schrift
description: Your reishi runs hot. Your spirit weapon's damage type becomes fire (you may still choose spirit), it gains deadly d8 , and you gain fire resistance equal to half your level . Canon's escalation is literal — Burner Finger One through Five .
icon_brief: A hand with one finger raised and glowing white-hot, a thin pillar of flame like a laser shooting from its tip.

name: The Miracle
description: M — Gerard Valkyrie. The Heart of the Soul King. Break him and he does not weaken — he gets bigger. The only way to beat The Miracle is to stop hitting it.
icon_brief: A cracked golden heart with light pouring out of the cracks, growing bigger with every crack.

name: The Miracle — Schrift
description: You take up an enormous sword and shield of white reishi. Your spirit weapon becomes 1d12 slashing , two-handed, forceful , shove . Your maximum Hit Points increase by your level, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against effects that would reduce your Hit Points to 0.
icon_brief: An enormous sword and shield made of white reishi, the shield's face bearing a Quincy cross, a golden aura pulsing from them.

name: The Thunderbolt
description: T — Candice Catnipp. The most aggressive Schrift in the Sternritter. She does not aim; she becomes the lightning and arrives.
icon_brief: A jagged lightning bolt slamming down from a dark sky into the ground with a starburst of green-white sparks.

name: The Thunderbolt — Schrift
description: Your spirit weapon becomes a sword of arcing electricity : 1d8 slashing , versatile P, and its damage type becomes electricity (you may still choose spirit). You gain electricity resistance equal to half your level , and your Flash Step becomes an electricity-flavoured teleport — it ignores difficult terrain and you may pass through creatures' spaces, though you can't end there.
icon_brief: A straight sword made entirely of arcing yellow-green electricity, branching sparks jumping off its edges.

name: Thunderbolt Form
description: Your hair becomes lightning and your wings arc white. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed and electricity immunity , and: You emit a 10-foot emanation of live current. A creature that ends its turn in it takes 3d6[electricity] damage (basic Reflex). Once per round when you hit with your spirit weapon, arcs jump: one other creature within 15 feet of the target takes 3d6 electricity (basic Reflex).
icon_brief: Six jagged lightning-bolt-shaped wings arcing white around a crackling halo, a field of live current spitting sparks below.

name: Tiburón
description: Shark — Tier Harribel. Release: "Destroy." A spirit that measures everything against the ocean and finds it wanting. Sacrifice, not slaughter.
icon_brief: A sealed zanpakutō: a broad short blade with a hollow centre and a shark-fin guard, droplets of water beading on its edge.

name: Tiburón — Resurrección
description: Water erupts around you and you step out of it. Your spirit weapon becomes a broad hollow-edged blade shaped like a shark's tooth: 1d12 slashing , two-handed, sweep . You gain a swim Speed equal to your Speed, you can breathe water, and you can create water freely from the gill-slits along the blade.
icon_brief: A broad, hollow-centred blade shaped like a shark's tooth rising from an erupting column of seawater.

name: Zangetsu
description: Slaying Moon — Ichigo Kurosaki. Release: none. Zangetsu is never sealed — canon Ichigo carries a released blade at all times.
icon_brief: A huge cleaver blade planted in the ground beneath a crescent moon, a faint black-and-blue aura leaking from it.

name: Zangetsu — Shikai
description: An oversized cleaver with no guard and no proper hilt. Your spirit weapon's damage die increases by one step and it gains two-handed d12 if it did not already have a two-handed trait. Your first Release each encounter is free and requires no action — you begin every encounter already released.
icon_brief: A giant guardless cleaver-shaped blade, black on the spine and silver on the edge, its hilt wrapped in white cloth that trails off in a long ribbon.

name: Zanka no Tachi
description: Longsword of the Remnant Flame. Canon inverts every expectation: the Bankai does not release more fire, it pulls all of it into the blade . The sword blackens and looks burnt out. Everything around you dries and cracks. Your spirit weapon's damage die increases by two steps instead of one. You lose your fire resistance while it is active. At the start of each of your turns, each creature other than you within 30 feet — allies included — takes 1d6[fire] damage from ambient heat, with no save. Once per round you may Sustain to select one cardinal aspect, which lasts until you select another: Higashi: Kyokujitsujin (East, Rising Sun Blade) — your Strikes ignore all resistances and immunities, and a creature damaged by your spirit weapon can't regain Hit Points and has its regeneration and fast healing suppressed until the end of your next turn. Nishi: Zanjitsu Gokui (West, Setting Sun Ultimate Form) — you gain fire immunity and resistance to all damage equal to half your level ; a creature that damages you with an unarmed attack, a melee weapon, or a Grapple takes 4d6 fire damage. Minami: Kaka Jūmanokushi Daisōjin (South, Great Funeral Pyre of 1,500,000) — the ash of everything your flames have killed rises in a 20-foot emanation. Enemies that end their turn in it must succeed at a Reflex save or be grabbed by ash-figures (Escape against your Reiatsu DC). The figures take no actions and are not creatures. Kita: Tenchi Kaijin (North, Heaven and Earth End in Ashes) — [two-actions, once per round] a 60-foot line of flame, basic Reflex, 5d6 fire. This damage cannot be reduced by resistance to fire, by Blut Vene, or by Hierro . Heightened (+1) +1d6. Design note. This is the only thing in the class that damages your own party, and that is deliberate and canon — Yamamoto's Bankai is a liability to everyone standing near it. If your table dislikes friendly fire, the cleanest fix is to exempt allies and reduce the die steps from two to one. That variant is a table decision, not the default.
canon_source: Bleach — Yamamoto's Bankai, Zanka no Tachi
icon_brief: A charred, burnt-out black katana with no flame at all, heat haze warping the air around it and the ground cracked and dried in a ring.

name: Effect: Allotted Fortune
description: The Quincy has handed you the other half. You gain a +1 status bonus to your next attack roll against the creature they marked.
icon_brief: A small golden star of good fortune floating into an outstretched hand from one pan of a tipped scale.

name: Effect: Antithesis — Reversed
description: The harm was sent back where it came from. You have resistance equal to the Quincy's level against the triggering damage.
icon_brief: A wound closing as its blood streams back out and away, flowing up to its source in a reversed blue arrow.

name: Effect: Antithesis — Schrift
description: A broad blue bow of light, and a blade of vibrating reishi beside it.
canon_source: Bleach — Uryū's Heilig Bogen & Seele Schneider
icon_brief: A broad blue bow of light crossed with a slender vibrating reishi blade (Seele Schneider), the blade's edge buzzing with visible vibration lines.

name: Effect: Apotheosis
description: You gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level . At the start of your next turn the light detonates again, for half the Waning dice.
canon_source: Homebrew (Soulbound class) — based on Gerard's Miracle
icon_brief: A bright golden shield of temporary light wrapped around a body, a ring of light already swelling outward for a second detonation.

name: Effect: Arrogante — Resurrección
description: A crowned skeleton with a vast double axe. Immune to disease and poison, and doomed never rises above 1.
icon_brief: A crowned skull with a vast black double axe, a ghostly ring of rot around it where disease and poison simply wither.

name: Effect: Bailar de Valquiria
description: Golden wings and a body that reassembles itself. Fast healing equal to your Miracle points, and five of them will buy your life.
canon_source: Homebrew (Soulbound class) — based on Gerard Valkyrie
icon_brief: Golden wings folding around shattered fragments that pull themselves back into a glowing whole, five bright points counting the lives it can buy.

name: Effect: Blut Arterie
description: Reishi runs through your arteries. Your Strikes with your spirit weapon ignore resistances to physical and spirit damage , and treat the target's cover as one step less.
icon_brief: Glowing red-blue arterial lines pulsing along a striking arm, the blade's edge punching cleanly through a cracked shield.

name: Effect: Blut Vene
description: Reishi runs through your veins. You have resistance to physical damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).
icon_brief: Pale-blue vein patterns lit up like armour under the skin, an incoming blade cracking against them.

name: Effect: Cero Metralleta — Sustained
description: The barrage is still firing. Your next Cero Metralleta this turn costs no Reiatsu Point, and you may shape it freshly as the cone or the line. Guide §7B, Refined: "You may Sustain Cero Metralleta at the start of your next turn to fire it again in a different direction without spending a Reiatsu Point." The free shot is what the Sustain buys — without this marker the very first Cero Metralleta of an encounter was free, once every round, which is not a Sustain and quietly removed the Technique's cost.
icon_brief: A spent pistol barrel still glowing blue, a stream of cero bullets flowing off it as the barrage continues.

name: Effect: Chain Anchor
description: Anchored. You can't Step away from the creature that struck you until the end of your next turn.
icon_brief: A chain of spiritual light anchored to a creature's ankle and staked into the ground beside the one who struck it.

name: Effect: Colmillo
description: Eight spirit wolves stand in the squares around you. The badge counts them; you regain one at the start of each of your turns.
icon_brief: A circle of eight small blue reiatsu wolves sitting around a central point, one freshly forming from wisps.

name: Effect: Cover Pierced
description: The attacker treats this creature's cover as one step less : greater becomes standard, standard becomes lesser, and lesser becomes none.
icon_brief: A shield of stone cover cracking apart, an arrow of light already slipping through the gap.

name: Effect: Crawling Rope
description: A rope of yellow energy is wound around your legs. You take a −10-foot status penalty to your Speeds and you can't Step.
icon_brief: A coil of glowing yellow spiritual rope wound tightly around a pair of legs, binding them together.

name: Effect: Daiguren Hyōrinmaru
description: Wings, claws and a tail of ice. You have a fly Speed equal to your Speed and cold resistance equal to your level . The badge counts your petal-flowers : one may be spent per round.
icon_brief: Ice wings, claws and a tail glittering blue-white, with three floating ice flowers counting down petal by petal.

name: Effect: Deus Ex Machina
description: Wings and a halo of blue reishi. Fire immunity, a fly Speed, and fire that does not go out easily.
icon_brief: Wings and a halo of blue reishi rimmed in fire, flame that clings and refuses to go out.

name: Effect: Frosted Stride
description: Ice has taken your feet. You have a −5-foot status penalty to your Speeds.
icon_brief: A pair of feet frozen to the ground in a creeping crust of blue ice, frost spreading up the ankles.

name: Effect: Full Release
description: Your spirit weapon's damage die increases by one step, your Release Technique costs no Reiatsu Points but works only once per round, and you emit a 15-foot emanation of crushing spiritual pressure — an enemy that ends its turn in it must succeed at a Will save against your Reiatsu DC or become frightened 1 , or frightened 2 on a critical failure. A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune for 10 minutes. When this ends you are fatigued until you rest for 10 minutes.
icon_brief: A creature at the centre of a crushing ring of spiritual pressure, the ground buckling into a crater around it and the air distorted.

name: Effect: Gintō Reserve
description: Three silver tubes on your belt. The badge counts them; each is a free Gritz.
icon_brief: Three small silver Gintō tubes clipped to a belt, each glowing faintly blue with liquefied reiryoku.

name: Effect: Gokei
description: Total Scene. The blades amass into a sphere around one creature and implode. Your second emanation is a 10-foot burst on one enemy; that enemy takes double damage from it and cannot benefit from cover or concealment against it.
icon_brief: A dense sphere of countless pink petal-blades closing around a single point and imploding in a pink flash.

name: Effect: Greater Flash Step
description: An afterimage stands where you were. The first attack made against you each round requires the attacker to succeed at a DC 5 flat check or the attack misses. When an attack resolves against you, a card offers the flat check. Pathfinder has already settled the attack roll by then, so a failed check is announced for the table to apply rather than silently rewriting the hit — but the check itself is rolled, and it is offered before you have to remember it.
icon_brief: A fading afterimage silhouette with an attack passing harmlessly through it, the real figure a blur beside it.

name: Effect: Guard Opened
description: This creature's AC is 2 lower against the Strike that opened its guard.
icon_brief: A guard broken open, a crossed pair of blocking swords knocked apart with a gap of light between them.

name: Effect: Guard the Threshold
description: Something stands between you and the dead. Reduce the triggering damage by 2 + the Soulbound's level .
icon_brief: A torii gate with a black-robed figure standing in it, a ghostly hand reaching through from the darkness behind and stopping short.

name: Effect: Higashi
description: Rising Sun Blade. Your Strikes ignore all resistances and immunities. A creature damaged by your spirit weapon can't regain Hit Points, and its regeneration and fast healing are suppressed, until the end of your next turn.
icon_brief: A katana whose edge alone burns with a thin white-gold line of fire, like a rising sun cresting a blade.

name: Effect: Hirviendo
description: Water stands around you in a 20-foot emanation, difficult terrain for enemies. La Gota may be thrown as a 60-foot line.
icon_brief: A ring of standing, rising seawater encircling a point, waves curling outward as a barrier.

name: Effect: Hollow's Mask
description: A mask you did not grow. Temporary Hit Points equal to your level, resistance to physical damage equal to a quarter of your level (minimum 1), and a +5-foot bonus to all your Speeds.
icon_brief: A white bone mask with red stripes worn over a shadowed face, a short-lived halo of dark Hollow reiatsu around it.

name: Effect: Hyōrinmaru — Shikai
description: Your spirit weapon's damage type is cold . A critical hit slows what it touches.
icon_brief: A crescent blade on a chain coated in frost, a frozen spray of ice crystals trailing off the arc of a cut.

name: Effect: Hypnotized
description: You perceive this Soulbound 5 feet from where they actually stand . Attacks you make against them require a DC 5 flat check (DC 6 if they have Refined Release), and they are hidden from you whenever they are not adjacent to you.
icon_brief: A figure seen through a warped, rippling mirror, the image displaced to one side of where its shadow actually falls.

name: Effect: Kanzen Saimin
description: Everything anyone sees of you is a lie you are telling. A creature that has seen your release and failed its Will save perceives you 5 feet from where you stand. Landing a blow on where you actually are breaks the hypnosis. Under Kanzen Saimin: Sōten Kisshun only a critical hit does.
icon_brief: A reflected silhouette standing in a pool of still water beside empty ground — the image is real, the figure is not.

name: Effect: Kanzen Saimin: Sōten Kisshun
description: The hypnosis stops being a lie about your position and becomes a lie about everything. Every enemy within 60 feet who can see you must attempt the Shikai save, including those already immune . Only a critical hit breaks it. Sustain once per round to force one hypnotized creature to attempt a Will save or be confused until the end of its turn.
canon_source: Homebrew (Soulbound class) — invented Bankai for Kyōka Suigetsu
icon_brief: An entire field of view breaking apart into mirror shards, every shard showing a different false world, a single crack running through the centre.

name: Effect: Kendō — Opened Guard
description: Your next Strike with your spirit weapon treats the target's AC as 2 lower .
icon_brief: A swordsman's blade sliding past a raised guard, the guard knocked aside and the target's open centre lit.

name: Effect: Kendō — Piercing
description: Your next Zanjutsu: Kendō Strike treats the target's AC as 2 lower .
icon_brief: A katana point lancing forward through a gap in a breastplate, a narrow line of light showing the opening.

name: Effect: Kendō — Severing
description: Your next Zanjutsu: Kendō Strike ignores all resistances and immunities to its damage type.
icon_brief: A katana edge slicing through a glowing protective rune, the rune splitting in half.

name: Effect: Kendō — Unresisted
description: Your next Strike with your spirit weapon ignores all resistances and immunities to its damage type.
icon_brief: A blade cutting cleanly through a shimmering barrier and its rune circle, nothing slowing it.

name: Effect: Kidō Combination — Opening
description: A Way of Destruction has just been spoken. Until the end of your turn a binding kidō costs you 1 Reiatsu Point fewer — once per encounter.
icon_brief: A red fiery kidō glyph fading out and, from its embers, a yellow binding-rope glyph spinning up — one art leading straight into the next.

name: Effect: Kidō Focus
description: A second beat of concentration went into the art that caught you: −1 circumstance penalty to this save.
icon_brief: A kidō glyph circle with an extra outer ring of concentration, the light tightening and pressing down on its target.

name: Effect: Kita
description: Heaven and Earth End in Ashes. You may use Kita: Tenchi Kaijin once per round.
icon_brief: A single vast slash carving a burning line through heaven and earth, the sky and ground on either side split and crumbling into ash.

name: Effect: Letzt Stil — Spent
description: You removed the limiter, and the bow has taken its price. You have lost your Schrift Form , your Release Technique , Licht Regen , Vollständig , and your entire reiatsu pool . They return when you complete 24 hours of rest . You keep your weapon, your proficiencies, and your feats.
icon_brief: A shattered Quincy bow lying on the ground, its pieces dark and drained, the last flickers of blue fading out of it.

name: Effect: Los Lobos — Resurrección
description: Two ornate pistols that never run dry, and five more feet of Speed.
icon_brief: Two ornate pistols glinting, ammunition endlessly reforming in blue light within their chambers.

name: Effect: Minami
description: Great Funeral Pyre of 1,500,000. The ash of everything your flames have killed rises in a 20-foot emanation. Enemies that end their turn in it must succeed at a Reflex save or be grabbed by ash-figures (Escape against your Reiatsu DC). The figures take no actions and are not creatures — this class has no minions.
icon_brief: Charred skeletons and ash-figures clawing up out of a field of grey ash, hands reaching to grab.

name: Effect: Miracle Points
description: Every wound has been counted and kept. The badge is your Miracle points : you have resistance to all damage equal to the number you hold , and you may spend any number at the start of your turn for +1d6 damage each until the end of it.
icon_brief: A tally of glowing golden scars on a growing body, each counted wound shining like a gem of stored power.

name: Effect: Murciélago — Resurrección
description: Wings, and a javelin of hardened green energy.
icon_brief: Black bat wings framing a bright green javelin of hardened energy, held point-down.

name: Effect: Murciélago — Segunda Etapa
description: Black fur, a whip-like tail, horns, and no mask at all. +20 feet of fly Speed, resistance to all damage except spirit equal to half your level , and Regeneración at double rate.
icon_brief: A demonic black silhouette with a whip-like tail and horns, green light pouring off it as it regenerates.

name: Effect: Nishi
description: Setting Sun Ultimate Form. You are wreathed in heat: fire immunity and resistance to all damage equal to half your level . A creature that damages you with an unarmed attack, a melee weapon, or a Grapple takes 4d6 fire .
icon_brief: A body wrapped in a shimmering mantle of white-hot flame, a striking fist recoiling burnt as it touches.

name: Effect: Pantera — Resurrección
description: White armour, claws, and a whip of a tail. Two claw attacks, and +10 feet of Speed.
icon_brief: White armour plates, curved claws and a whip-like tail, blue light streaking behind them with speed.

name: Effect: Pantera — Segunda Etapa
description: Another +10 feet of Speed, claws that are deadly d10 , and a 60-foot Garra de la Pantera whose critical failures bleed.
canon_source: Homebrew (Soulbound class) — invented second form for Grimmjow
icon_brief: Long, lethal blue energy claws raking forward in a 60-foot sweep, blood spray at their ends.

name: Effect: Pressure Crush
description: The air itself is leaning on you. You take a −5-foot status penalty to your Speeds.
icon_brief: A creature hunched as though the air were made of lead, a heavy blue haze pushing down and slowing its stride.

name: Effect: Quincy: Letzt Stil
description: The limiter is off. Two die steps, resistance-piercing Strikes that stack with Blut Vene, and Licht Regen as a 60-foot cone once per round for free. When this ends you lose your Schrift Form, your Release Technique, Licht Regen, Vollständig and your entire reiatsu pool until 24 hours of rest.
icon_brief: A limiter-free bow crackling with overwhelming blue power, a volley of arrows fanning out in a cone.

name: Effect: Quincy's Discipline
description: You are wearing a Quincy's discipline. You gain Blut as a free action once per round, except that Blut Vene grants resistance equal to a quarter of your level rather than half. Your ranged Strikes ignore the target's cover.
icon_brief: A borrowed blue Quincy cross glowing beside a katana guard, faint blue vein-light running from it, an arrow sailing past a broken wall of cover.

name: Effect: Regeneración Suppressed
description: Spirit — or, before Segunda Piel , a holy or vitality effect — has closed the wound the wrong way. Your Regeneración does nothing until the end of your next turn.
icon_brief: A torn wound with flickers of regrowing tissue held back by a thin ring of holy light, the healing stalled.

name: Effect: Reiatsu Barrier
description: Pressure hardened into a wall. You have resistance equal to your level against the triggering damage.
icon_brief: A wall of hardened blue reiatsu taking a blow full on, the impact rippling through it like struck glass.

name: Effect: Released
description: Your spirit weapon is in its released form for the rest of the encounter. Release is not a stance: this does not conflict with stance actions, and nothing but the end of the encounter, or re-sealing on purpose, takes it away.
icon_brief: A released spirit weapon held aloft, its released form glowing steady — a sword in its true shape, aura settled around it.

name: Effect: Remnant Ice Doll
description: A doll of ice stands where the blow landed. The damage is reduced by twice your level , and the doll shatters.
icon_brief: A life-sized doll of ice shattering into shards where a blow landed, the real target untouched behind it.

name: Effect: Respira — Cannot Heal
description: The miasma has stopped this creature knitting itself back together. It cannot regain Hit Points until the end of its next turn.
icon_brief: A wound edged in grey decay that refuses to close, ash flaking off its edges.

name: Effect: Respira — In the Miasma
description: You are standing inside an Arrogante's Respira Absoluta . Content-free by design: this is how "a creature within the emanation " becomes something a predicate can test. pf2e's own Aura rule grants it on entering and takes it back on leaving, so the decay that consumes what is aimed at the Arrogante reaches the creatures actually standing in the miasma and nobody else.
icon_brief: A figure-less square filled with drifting purple-black miasma; inside it a small hourglass whose sand has turned to ash and a withered leaf crumbling at the edges. Muted violet and bone-grey.

name: Effect: Respira Absoluta
description: A permanent 20-foot emanation of aging miasma. Enemies that end their turn in it take 3d6 void with a basic Fortitude save, and what is aimed at you may simply age to nothing.
canon_source: Homebrew (Soulbound class) — extrapolated from Barragan's Respira
icon_brief: A permanent dark purple fog of aging miasma, an incoming arrow crumbling to rust and dust mid-flight within it.

name: Effect: Ryūjin Jakka — Shikai
description: A blade sheathed in flame. Its damage type is fire , it is deadly d8 , and you have fire resistance equal to half your level .
icon_brief: A katana blade fully sheathed in roaring orange-red flame, the fire licking upward from the edge like a torch; a faint heat shimmer around it and a small ember-shield glyph at the hilt.

name: Effect: Segunda Piel (Early)
description: Your Hierro closes over the wound. Its resistance applies to spirit damage as well as physical until the end of your next turn.
icon_brief: A wound on grey skin closing over with a seam of dull steel plating, rivet-like, a faint white spirit-glow catching on the metal. Close crop, cold grey and white.

name: Effect: Senbonzakura — Shikai
description: A slow cloud of petal-fine blades. Your Strikes have reach 15 feet and ignore cover between you and the target.
icon_brief: A slow, loose cloud of pink petal-blades streaming outward from a bare hilt toward the far corner, reaching around a stone wall. Soft pink glints on dusk-blue.

name: Effect: Senbonzakura Kageyoshi
description: Two emanations of petal-blades. At the start of each of your turns every enemy in either takes 5d6 slashing damage with a basic Reflex save. Sustain once per round to move the second emanation, or to enter Gokei or Senkei .
icon_brief: Two swirling rings of pink cherry-blossom blades circling a central point, each petal a glinting razor; one ring drifting off to the side, trailing petals. Dark background, hot pink light.

name: Effect: Senkei
description: Slaughterscape. A thousand swords form a 20-foot cage around you and one enemy. Neither of you can leave. Your Strikes against that enemy ignore all resistances , and you may make one extra Strike each round at your current multiple attack penalty. You lose Senbonzakura's reach and cover-ignoring, and you cannot target enemies outside the cage.
icon_brief: Top-down view: a ring of a thousand tall gleaming swords standing point-down in the ground, forming a closed circular arena; pink light falling between the blades onto the floor.

name: Effect: Severance
description: You have stopped carrying your power and become it. For 10 rounds : Your spirit weapon's Strikes deal an additional 4d6 spirit damage. You are immune to fear and death effects , and to the frightened and doomed conditions. Reiatsu stops mattering. Your Release Technique and every kidō you know cost nothing and have no frequency limit . You gain your Spirit's Full Release ability and its 20-foot pressure emanation, without spending your daily Full Release and without the fatigue. Your Speed increases by 20 feet , and Flash Step's frequency becomes twice per round . Waning. Your Severing Art is strongest the instant you enter Severance and decays every round: 20d6 in the first round, 18d6 in the second, and so on down to 8d6 in the seventh. After the seventh round it cannot be used at all . The longer you survive, the more this state has given you, and the less your ending is worth. There is no dominant line, which is what makes it a decision instead of a script.
icon_brief: A body-sized silhouette dissolving into pure black reiatsu that rises like smoke, rimmed by a thin crimson edge; ten small tally marks ticking down around it. Black, red, white.

name: Effect: Severed
description: You severed the bond that named you, and it is gone. You have lost your Released Form , your Release Technique , your Full Release , and your entire reiatsu pool . They return when you complete a week of downtime rebuilding what you severed. You keep your Hit Points, your proficiencies, your skills, your Lineage features, and every other feat.
