icon_brief: A snapped silver chain whose broken end fades into empty air, beside a sword hilt with no blade; the glow drained from both. Desaturated grey, a faint cut line through the centre.

name: Effect: Shikake
description: You have been shown the wrong person. You treat one creature within your reach as though it were the Soulbound, and you treat the Soulbound as an ally .
icon_brief: A creature's view through a cracked hand-mirror: the reflection shows the wrong figure, while a pale moon floats on water below. Teal and silver, with a hairline fracture.

name: Effect: Shitonegaeshi
description: The ground has been taken from under you. You can't Step .
icon_brief: A floor tile flipping up like an overturned cushion under a stumbling foot, a sword-slash arc above it. Wooden dojo floor, motion lines, an ink-brush feel.

name: Effect: Sight of the Balance
description: Your fortune and misfortune are the Quincy's to allot. You take a −2 status penalty to your next saving throw .
icon_brief: A pair of golden scales hovering over a crouched shadow; the pan on the shadow's side sinks under a dark weight. Gold on deep blue, a white Quincy star at the pivot.

name: Effect: Silenced Chain
description: The seal sits on your voice. You can't cast spells or use kidō.
icon_brief: A mouth wrapped shut with black cloth strips pinned by iron bolts; small kanji seals glowing faintly on the bindings. Black, iron grey and pale gold.

name: Effect: Six Rods
description: Six rods of light hold you at the midsection. You can't use manipulate actions. The immobilized condition is applied alongside this effect.
icon_brief: Six thin bars of yellow-white light converging from six directions into a glowing ring around a waist-height point, pinning it in place. Bright gold against dark.

name: Effect: Soul Reaper's Discipline
description: You are wearing a reaper's discipline. Every kidō you know costs no Reiatsu Point while the Face is on.
canon_source: Homebrew (Soulbound class) — borrowed Soul Reaper aspect
icon_brief: A black-lacquered mask of a stern shinigami face held up in front of a white Hollow skull, kanji glyphs circling it like a kidō incantation. Black, white, blue glyph-light.

name: Effect: Splitting Void
description: A wall of pure nothing stands between you and what was coming. You have resistance equal to your level against the triggering damage.
icon_brief: A tall, perfectly flat translucent pane of pale light standing upright; a fireball splashing against it and scattering into sparks. Clean geometric edges, cool white-blue.

name: Effect: Steeled Against Pressure
description: You have already stood in this Soulbound's spiritual pressure and kept your feet. You are temporarily immune to that emanation for 10 minutes.
icon_brief: A small figure standing braced, feet planted, against a heavy downward wave of coloured reiatsu pressing on it like weather; a calm blue ward around the figure's chest.

name: Effect: Steeled Against Respira
description: Something you aimed at an Arrogante reached them through the miasma. You are temporarily immune to Respira Absoluta 's flat check for 1 minute. Guide §7B: "A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to this flat check for 1 minute." Without it the decay could hold one attacker off for a whole encounter, which is the clause the temporary immunity exists to prevent.
icon_brief: A gloved hand that has pushed through a wall of purple-black miasma unharmed, the miasma parting around it; a small white sigil of resistance glowing on the palm.

name: Effect: Tensa Zangetsu
description: A smaller, blacker blade. +10 feet to all Speeds, Flash Step twice per round, and Getsuga Tenshō at one action.
icon_brief: A slim all-black daitō with a manji (卍)-shaped guard and a short broken chain dangling from the pommel, crackling with black-and-red reiatsu and afterimage speed streaks.

name: Effect: The Balance — Fortune Held
description: How much misfortune you have taken off other people this encounter. A tally, and nothing else — The Reckoning reads it to know whether the debt is doomed 1 or doomed 2 .
icon_brief: A golden ledger page with tally marks being drawn in light, a small balance scale emblem stamped in the corner; one pan heaped with dark coins of misfortune.

name: Effect: The Balance — Held
description: Misfortune has been handed to you. You take a −1 status penalty to saving throws (and to AC if the Quincy has Refined Release).
icon_brief: A single tilted golden scale with a black stone of misfortune sinking one pan, dark vapour rising from it onto a silhouette below.

name: Effect: The Balance — Held (Refined)
description: Misfortune has been handed to you. You take a −1 status penalty to AC and saving throws .
icon_brief: A dark shadow weight dropped onto a shield and a pair of feet, cracking the ground slightly; a tilted golden scale above. Grey-blue with a sour green tint.

name: Effect: The Balance — Redistributed
description: The harm was moved onto somebody else. You have resistance equal to twice the Quincy's level against the triggering damage — three times at the Vollständig.
icon_brief: A wound of red light leaving one silhouette and flowing along a golden thread into another figure across the frame, a balance scale at the midpoint of the thread.

name: Effect: The Balance — Schrift
description: Freund Schild in your hands, and fortune on your side while the pool holds.
icon_brief: A tall white heater shield with a blue Quincy star (Freund Schild) and a golden balance scale floating above it. White, gold and Quincy blue.

name: Effect: The Balance, at Night
description: Wings of white light and a sword in each hand. Your reduction is three times your level, an ally's harm can be taken onto yourself once a round, and you allot one enemy's fortune each turn.
icon_brief: Broad wings of white light spreading behind two crossed swords, a golden balance scale floating between the blades under a dark night sky with a pale moon.

name: Effect: The Heat — Schrift
description: Reishi that runs hot: a fire-typed spirit weapon with deadly d8 , and fire resistance equal to half your level.
icon_brief: A glowing blue reishi blade whose edge has turned into white-hot fire, flames rolling off it; a stylised letter H branded in flame on the crossguard.

name: Effect: The Miracle — Grown
description: The body reassembled itself larger. Your spirit weapon's damage die is one step larger per tally here , for the rest of the encounter.
icon_brief: A broken shard of a golden statue reassembling itself larger than before, pieces flying inward with light streaming from the cracks; small stacked tally pips beneath.

name: Effect: The Miracle — Schrift
description: A sword and shield too large for you, and a body that treats being broken as an instruction.
icon_brief: An enormous white sword and a vast round shield crossed, both oversized and glowing gold at the rims, a stylised M radiating from the shield's boss.

name: Effect: The Miracle — Spent
description: Points spent into the swing. Your spirit weapon's Strikes deal +1d6 per point until the end of your turn — and with Blitz of the Hero , +5 feet to your Speeds per point, to a maximum of +20.
icon_brief: A sword swing trailing golden stars that are being burned up like fuel, each star leaving a spark; motion streaks behind the arc. Gold and white on deep blue.

name: Effect: The Thunderbolt — Schrift
description: A sword of arcing electricity, resistance to the same, and a Flash Step that is really a teleport.
icon_brief: A sword made of forking green-yellow electricity that never holds one shape, sparks spitting off it; a lightning-bolt letter T at the hilt.

name: Effect: Thunderbolt Form
description: Lightning for hair and white arcs for wings. A 10-foot emanation of live current, and arcs that jump from whatever you hit.
icon_brief: Six white-yellow lightning-bolt-shaped wings fanning out from a central halo of crackling electricity, arcs jumping outward to the frame's edges.

name: Effect: Tiburón — Resurrección
description: A shark's tooth in your hands, a swim Speed, and water whenever you want it. You can breathe water , and you can create water freely from the gill-slits along the blade. pf2e automates no drowning and has no "breathes water" field, so the nearest thing it does have is said instead: the amphibious creature trait, which its own glossary defines as breathing in water and in air. It shows on the sheet and a predicate can read it. Whether the water is there at all remains the GM's to say.
icon_brief: A huge broad blade shaped like a shark's tooth with a hollow centre and gill-slits along its spine, water pouring from the slits and swirling around it. Aqua and bone-white.

name: Effect: Wound That Will Not Close
description: The cut went through something that does not grow back. For 1 minute this creature cannot regain Hit Points , and any regeneration or fast healing it has is suppressed.
icon_brief: A clean diagonal cut on grey skin glowing faintly white at the edges, a green healing spark breaking apart against it before it can touch. Red, white and dead green.

name: Effect: Zangetsu — Shikai
description: A blade that is never sealed. Your spirit weapon's damage die is one step larger, and it gains two-hand d12 unless it was already two-handed.
icon_brief: A massive cleaver-shaped blade with no guard, its hilt wrapped in white cloth that trails off in a long ribbon; blue-white reiatsu flaring along the edge.

name: Effect: Zanka no Tachi
description: Every flame pulled into one blackened blade. Your damage die is two steps larger, your fire resistance is gone, and everything within 30 feet of you — allies included — burns for 1d6 at the start of each of your turns. Sustain once per round to select a cardinal aspect.
canon_source: Bleach — Yamamoto's Bankai, Zanka no Tachi
icon_brief: A charred, ash-black katana that looks burnt out, the air around it warping with heat; the ground beneath dried and cracked in a radiating spiderweb. Black, ember-orange cracks.

name: Freund Schild
description: Substitute Shield — Haschwalth fights with a blade, not a bow.
icon_brief: A tall white heater shield with a pointed base, a blue five-pointed Quincy star at its centre and thin silver trim, faint reishi glow at the edges.

name: Gran Caída
description: Great Fall — a vast double axe carried by a crowned skeleton.
icon_brief: A huge black double-bladed battle axe with ornate gold fittings, a small skull crown motif at the head, wisps of purple decay coming off the blades.

name: Los Lobos — Pistols
description: Two ornate pistols that need no ammunition and speak when they feel like it.
icon_brief: Two ornate long-barrelled pistols crossed, wolf-head motifs on the grips, blue cero light glowing in both muzzles. Silver, black and blue.

name: Luz de la Luna
description: Light of the Moon — a javelin of hardened green energy that re-forms in your hand the instant it leaves it.
canon_source: Bleach — Ulquiorra's Luz de la Luna
icon_brief: A long javelin of hardened, glowing green energy with a crescent-shaped tip, faint green after-images showing it re-forming in a reaching hand.

name: Pantera — Claws
description: Ten blades of condensed reishi where your hands were.
icon_brief: A hand where the fingers have become ten long blades of condensed blue reishi, curved like a panther's claws, glowing cyan at the tips.

name: Seele Schneider

name: The Soulbound: Handbook
description: Three peoples fight the same war with the same physics and opposite manners. A Soul Reaper carries their own soul as a sword, and it argues with them. A Hollow ate its own heart and wears the hole. A Quincy owns no soul-weapon at all — they reach into the air and make a bow out of what is already there. Mechanically they are one chassis: 10 Hit Points, light armour, a Reiatsu DC , and a focus pool that refills by fighting . The three things a new player should know The pool is the spike; the Lineage is the floor. Every Lineage has a free, repeatable ranged option from 1st level with an empty pool — Shō, Bala, or Heizen. Release is not a stance. It lasts the whole encounter, doesn't conflict with stance actions, and the first one each encounter is free. Every technique costs exactly one Reiatsu Point. There is no 2-point effect anywhere in the class. Your reiatsu pool is Pathfinder's focus pool: 1 point, 2 at 5th level, 3 at 11th . Steady the Breath is Refocus — you meditate, or you argue with your sword, or you eat something. Rising Pressure Once per round, the first time you either deal damage to an enemy with your spirit weapon or take damage from an enemy, you regain 1 Reiatsu Point. You can't exceed your maximum, and over a single encounter you can't regain more points this way than your maximum pool size . That last clause is the one that matters. Without it a long fight is an infinite pool. The module enforces it and will say so in chat when a point is granted. Level Pool Per encounter Techniques per fight 1–4 1 +1 2 5–10 2 +2 4 11–20 3 +3 6 A note for the GM The pool's size is set from your level, not from how many techniques you happen to know. Pathfinder normally derives a focus pool from the effects you know, which would leave a Hollow — who knows exactly one costed kidō, forever — on a pool of one at 11th level. If someone "fixes" that, the Hollow and the Quincy quietly lose two thirds of their resource. Four rungs, and each is a state rather than a stance. Rung Level Lasts Release (Shikai / Resurrección / Schrift) 1 the encounter Refined Release 9 — Full Release (Bankai / Segunda Etapa / Vollständig) 13 1 minute, 2 from 17th Final Release — Severance 20 10 rounds, once per week What the module does for you Releasing applies the state and its effects; the encounter ending takes them away. A released form that replaces your weapon — Luz de la Luna, Gran Caída, Starrk's pistols — stows the sealed profile and hands it back when the form ends. Your runes stay on it. At 20th level, Final Release puts you into Severance for ten rounds. Somewhere inside those ten rounds you get exactly one irreversible attack — your Severing Art — and it is worth less the longer you wait. Round of Severance Dice Average 1st 20d6 70.0 2nd 18d6 63.0 3rd 16d6 56.0 4th 14d6 49.0 5th 12d6 42.0 6th 10d6 35.0 7th 8d6 28.0 8th, 9th, 10th cannot be used Dice = 22 − 2 × the round number . The tension is the point. Round one is 70 damage and none of the buff. Round seven is 28 damage and six rounds of a 4d6 rider, doubled Flash Step and free kidō. There is no dominant line. Using the Art ends Severance whether you want it to or not, and when Severance ends by either route you lose your Released Form, your Release Technique, your Full Release and your entire pool until a week of downtime . If your table finds everyone fires on round one, flatten the table — start at 16d6 and drop 1d6 a round — rather than cutting the ceiling. The module keeps this arithmetic in one function for exactly that reason. Kidō are not spells . They use your Reiatsu DC, can't be counteracted as spells, and can't be heightened with slots. They auto-heighten to half your level, rounded up. Lineage Free cantrip Costed Chosen? Soul Reaper Shō six , at 1st (×2), 5th, 9th, 13th, 17th chosen Hollow Bala one — Cero fixed Quincy Heizen one — Gritz fixed The ceilings are load-bearing. Additional Kidō is Soul Reaper only and takeable three times, so the hard ceiling is nine at 20th for a Soul Reaper who spends three class feats on it — and that character has given up three Zanjutsu techniques to do it. A Hollow or Quincy can never exceed two. There is no utility kidō in the list. No flight, no invisibility, no teleport, no divination. Every entry is damage, control, a shield, or a small heal. The moment a Soul Reaper can solve arbitrary problems with magic, the class is a Magus with better hit points. Ryūjin Jakka burns your own party Zanka no Tachi deals 1d6 fire at the start of each of its user's turns to every creature within 30 feet including allies . That is deliberate and canon — Yamamoto's Bankai is a liability to everyone standing near it — and the module makes it actually happen rather than leaving it in prose. If your table dislikes friendly fire, the cleanest fix is to exempt allies and reduce the die steps from two to one . That is a table decision; the default content does not make it for you. Kyōka Suigetsu remembers The hypnosis is keyed to what a creature has seen , not to the current fight. The module keeps a register per creature: whether it has seen a Shikai release, what it rolled, and which immunity window it is in. That memory outlives the encounter and travels between scenes, because canon's clause does. The blind are immune entirely. That is Aizen's only blind spot and it is worth remembering when you build encounters against one. What is invented Nine of the fifteen Severing Arts are the character's actual canon technique. The other six are extrapolations built on a principle canon does establish, and each says so at the top of its own description. Several Segunda Etapas and Kyōka Suigetsu's Bankai are likewise invented — Ulquiorra is explicitly the only Espada who reached a Segunda Etapa, and Aizen has no Bankai. Nothing is presented as something the manga contains. Reactions Eight abilities trigger on someone else's action. When one is available the module whispers the owner a card with a single button. Ignoring the card declines the reaction — nothing is spent, and nobody's turn is held up waiting.

description: Bakudō #61. Six thin rods of light slam into the midsection from six directions and hold it there. One creature within 30 feet attempts a Fortitude save. Failure It is immobilized and can't use manipulate actions for 1 round. Critical Failure As failure, for 2 rounds. Deliberately without the incapacitation trait, which is why it stops at "no manipulate actions" rather than at paralysed.
icon_brief: Six thin rectangular blades of yellow light slamming in from six directions into a figure's midsection, freezing it in mid-motion.

name: Sai — Restrain
description: Bakudō #1. The arms lock behind the back and stay there. One creature within 30 feet attempts a Reflex save. Failure It is immobilized for 1 round (Escape against your Reiatsu DC). Critical Failure It is immobilized for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns.
icon_brief: Two arms suddenly locked behind a back by an invisible force, faint white kidō lines around the wrists.

name: Byakurai — Pale Lightning
description: Hadō #4. A single white bolt from one finger. Precise, quiet, and faster than the eye. Make a spell attack roll against one creature within 60 feet. On a hit it takes 2d6[electricity] damage, doubled on a critical hit. This ignores lesser cover . Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
icon_brief: A single, thin, perfectly straight bolt of pale white lightning shooting from an extended index finger, piercing through a target.

name: Kurohitsugi — Black Coffin
description: Hadō #90. A box of black reiatsu closes over the target, and what is inside it is pierced from every direction at once. Each creature in a 10-foot burst within 60 feet takes 9d6[void] damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature that critically fails is immobilized until the end of its next turn (Escape against your Reiatsu DC). Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
icon_brief: A tall black box of dark reiatsu closing around a target, dozens of black spears piercing it from every side; purple-black edges.

name: Shakkahō — Crimson Bloom
description: Hadō #31. A sphere of red fire gathered in the palm and thrown. The workhorse of the destructive arts. Each creature in a 10-foot burst within 60 feet takes 2d6[fire] damage with a basic Reflex save. Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
icon_brief: A sphere of red fire gathered in an open palm, ready to be thrown, sparks spiralling around it.

name: Shō — Thrust
description: Hadō #1. A blunt shove of pure pressure — the first thing anyone learns, and the one a reaper never stops using. One creature within 30 feet takes 1d4[force] damage plus your key attribute modifier, with a basic Reflex save. On a critical failure it is also pushed 5 feet. Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d4.
icon_brief: An index finger flicked forward with an invisible shockwave ring pushing outward, a shove of pressure lifting dust.

name: Sōkatsui — Sundering Wave
description: Hadō #33. Blue fire poured along the ground in a widening wave. Each creature in a 30-foot line takes 2d4[spirit] damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature that fails is pushed 10 feet away from you. Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4. The push is the reason the die is a d4 rather than a d6.
icon_brief: A wide wave of blue fire pouring from an open palm and spreading along the ground in a cone.

name: Sōren Sōkatsui — Twin Wave
description: Hadō #73. Both hands, side by side. Canon calls it twice the power of the basic variant, and it is. Each creature in a 60-foot line takes 7d6[spirit] damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature that fails also takes 1d6 persistent fire damage. Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
icon_brief: Two hands held side by side unleashing a massive, twin-cored torrent of blue fire, far larger and brighter than the single version.

name: Kaidō — Mend the Weave
description: The Way of Mending. Hands over the wound, and the weave pulled back together. You restore 5 Hit Points per half your level, rounded up (minimum 5) to one willing creature you touch. At 9th level you also remove one of clumsy , enfeebled or stupefied . This is meant to be mediocre. You are not the party's healer, and the class does not pretend otherwise: Kaidō exists so a lone Soul Reaper can stabilize a dying ally, not so the party can skip a Cleric.
icon_brief: Two hands held over a wound with a soft green-gold glow pouring from the palms, the wound's edges weaving back together.

name: Soulbound: Test Rig
description: Macro:
icon_brief: A glass vial of clear blue reiatsu in a lab clamp, a small gear and measuring scale engraved on the glass.

name: Antithesis
description: Trigger You or an ally within 30 feet takes damage from a creature you can see. You reverse the two events. The triggering creature takes 2d6[spirit] damage, and the target of the trigger gains resistance equal to your level against the triggering damage. Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6. Refined (9th) You additionally gain Licht Regen . This is Bakudō #81 with the damage reflected instead of absorbed, which is exactly what Antithesis does in canon.
icon_brief: Two arrows of light reversing direction mid-flight, swapping places in a loop; a stylised letter A at the loop's centre. Blue and white.

name: Apotheosis
description: Cost nothing · Requirements You are in Severance Every wound taken all fight arrives at once as growth. 30-foot emanation , basic Fortitude, force damage. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level . At the start of your next turn the emanation detonates a second time for half the Waning dice. ⚠ Extrapolated — growing stronger from damage is Gerard's canon Schrift. Waning. The damage is 20d6 if used in the first round of Severance, and two dice fewer each round after — 18d6, 16d6, 14d6, 12d6, 10d6, and 8d6 in the seventh. After the seventh round this cannot be used at all. Using this ends Severance , whether you want it to or not.
canon_source: Bleach — Gerard Valkyrie's The Miracle (homebrew finisher)
icon_brief: A body-sized burst of golden light erupting outward in a ring, every old wound line glowing gold before exploding into growth.

name: Aullido
description: Cost nothing · Requirements You are in Severance Howl. Every wolf you have left converges on one point and goes off together. Requirements At least one wolf remains. 40-foot burst within 120 feet, basic Reflex, force damage. You expend all remaining wolves and regain none for the rest of the encounter. If you had five or more , creatures that critically fail are also knocked prone and stunned 1 . ⚠ Extrapolated — the soul-splitting wolves are canon. Waning. The damage is 20d6 if used in the first round of Severance, and two dice fewer each round after — 18d6, 16d6, 14d6, 12d6, 10d6, and 8d6 in the seventh. After the seventh round this cannot be used at all. Using this ends Severance , whether you want it to or not.
icon_brief: A pack of blue spirit wolves converging from all sides onto one point and detonating together in a massive blue explosion.

name: Burner Finger
description: Choose a number of fingers from one to five. Each choice is a different effect, and each costs the same single Reiatsu Point. Fingers Effect One Range 60 ft., one creature. Ranged spell attack, 3d6 fire, doubled on a crit. Two Range 60 ft., two creatures. As One, but 2d6 each. Three 30-foot line , basic Reflex, 2d6 fire. Four A blade of fire with an elongated crossguard forms around your hand and you slash. 15-foot emanation , basic Reflex, 2d6 fire; creatures that fail take 1d4 persistent fire. Five 30-foot cone , basic Reflex, 2d6 fire; the ground becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn. Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6. Refined (9th) — Deeper Burn. All five options gain their next increment early (treat your rank as one higher for Burner Finger only), and Five additionally leaves the difficult terrain burning until the end of your next turn, dealing 2d6 fire to a creature that enters or ends its turn there. No option is better than another at every moment, which is the whole design.
icon_brief: A hand with one index finger extended, a laser-thin pillar of white-hot fire shooting from the fingertip, the other fingers ready.

name: Burning Full Fingers
description: Cost nothing · Requirements You are in Severance Fire on all five fingertips at once, released as a spiralling torrent. 60-foot cone , basic Reflex, fire damage. Creatures that fail take 4d6 persistent fire whose flat check to end is DC 20 rather than DC 15. Canon's own name for Bazz-B's strongest technique. Waning. The damage is 20d6 if used in the first round of Severance, and two dice fewer each round after — 18d6, 16d6, 14d6, 12d6, 10d6, and 8d6 in the seventh. After the seventh round this cannot be used at all. Using this ends Severance , whether you want it to or not.
icon_brief: All five fingertips of a hand ablaze, the flames merging into a single spiralling torrent of fire that fills the frame.

name: Cero Metralleta
description: Machine-Gun Hollow Flash. You fire an uncountable barrage from both pistols. Canon has Starrk claim he can fire a thousand at once. Each creature in a 60-foot cone takes 2d6[force] damage with a basic Reflex save. You may instead shape it as a 120-foot line . Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6. Refined (9th) You may Sustain Cero Metralleta at the start of your next turn to fire it again in a different direction without spending a Reiatsu Point. The largest technique area in the class, paid for by the smallest basic Strike.
icon_brief: A machine-gun barrage of hundreds of small blue ceros streaking forward in a dense cone from two pistols.

name: Cero Oscuras
description: Dark Hollow Flash. A cero so black it takes the light with it. Make a spell attack roll against one creature within 90 feet. On a hit it takes 3d6[spirit] damage, doubled on a critical hit. Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6. Refined (9th) On a critical hit the target is off-guard until the start of your next turn, and Cero Oscuras gains a 5-foot burst at the target's location dealing half damage to other creatures in it (basic Reflex). A spell attack roll rather than a save is what buys the higher die count.
icon_brief: A sphere of pure black energy rimmed in vivid green, swallowing the light around it, ready to fire.

name: Cero Oscuras: Ceniza
description: Cost nothing · Requirements You are in Severance Dark Hollow Flash: Ash. A black cero fired point-blank down a corridor of nothing. 120-foot line , basic Reflex, spirit damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this crumbles to ash ; returning it to life requires a 10th-rank effect. ⚠ Extrapolated name — the ash is canon: it is how Ulquiorra himself ends. Waning. The damage is 20d6 if used in the first round of Severance, and two dice fewer each round after — 18d6, 16d6, 14d6, 12d6, 10d6, and 8d6 in the seventh. After the seventh round this cannot be used at all. Using this ends Severance , whether you want it to or not.
icon_brief: A black cero with a green outline fired straight down a long empty corridor, a figure in its path crumbling to ash.

name: Colmillo — Fang
description: Requirements at least one wolf remains Expend any number of wolves. Each wolf you expend moves to a point within 60 feet and detonates in a 10-foot burst : 3d6[force] damage, basic Reflex. A creature in more than one burst takes damage only from the highest . Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
icon_brief: A single blue spirit wolf lunging forward and bursting into a ring of blue light on impact.

name: Desgarrón
description: Cost nothing · Requirements You are in Severance Panther King's Claw. Your claws extend into ten blades of condensed reishi and you throw all of them. 60-foot cone , basic Reflex, slashing damage. Creatures that fail take 4d6 persistent bleed . Canon has Grimmjow name this his strongest attack, which is why it sits here rather than in his Segunda Etapa. Waning. The damage is 20d6 if used in the first round of Severance, and two dice fewer each round after — 18d6, 16d6, 14d6, 12d6, 10d6, and 8d6 in the seventh. After the seventh round this cannot be used at all. Using this ends Severance , whether you want it to or not.
icon_brief: Ten huge blue energy claws raking forward from outstretched fingers, five on each side, forming a cone of slashing light.

name: Electrocution
description: Cost nothing · Requirements You are in Severance You stop directing the lightning and simply become the storm. 30-foot emanation , basic Reflex, electricity damage. Creatures that fail are stunned 2 . Canon's name for Candice's strongest technique. Carries the incapacitation trait. Waning. The damage is 20d6 if used in the first round of Severance, and two dice fewer each round after — 18d6, 16d6, 14d6, 12d6, 10d6, and 8d6 in the seventh. After the seventh round this cannot be used at all. Using this ends Severance , whether you want it to or not.
icon_brief: A storm of crackling green-yellow lightning radiating outward from a central point in a full circle, everything caught in it lit white.

name: Ennetsu Jigoku
description: Scorching Heat Hell. Each creature in the emanation takes 2d6[fire] damage with a basic Reflex save. Creatures that fail also take 1d4 persistent fire damage. Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage by 1d4 at every other increment. Refined (9th) The emanation increases to 20 feet , and the ground within it becomes difficult terrain from burning debris until the end of your next turn.
icon_brief: A ring of tall fire pillars rising from the ground, enclosing a dark centre, the flames rising like a burning prison.

name: Galvano Blast
description: Each creature in a 60-foot line takes 2d6[electricity] damage with a basic Reflex save. Creatures that fail are stunned 1 ; creatures that critically fail are stunned 2 . Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6. Refined (9th) You may instead throw Galvano Javelin . This carries the incapacitation trait. Stunned on a failed basic save at rank 1 is above the curve without it; against a creature of higher level than you it will usually do nothing but damage, and that is the intended shape.
icon_brief: A thick, straight beam of green-yellow lightning tearing across the frame, crackling arcs spitting off its edges.

name: Galvano Javelin
description: You throw a javelin of lightning. Make a ranged spell attack against one creature within 90 feet; on a hit it takes 6d6[electricity] damage, doubled on a critical hit, and is stunned 1 . Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6. Carries the incapacitation trait.
icon_brief: A javelin of crackling green-yellow lightning in mid-flight, sparks trailing behind it.

name: Garra de la Pantera
description: Claw of the Panther. You fire crystalline darts from your elbow. Each creature in a 30-foot cone takes 2d6[piercing] damage with a basic Reflex save. The area is littered with shards and becomes difficult terrain for enemies until the start of your next turn. Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6. Refined (9th) Your claws' damage die increases to 1d10 , and after using Garra de la Pantera you may Step as a free action. Canon fires "up to five" darts; the cone abstracts them.
canon_source: Bleach — Grimmjow's Garra de la Pantera
icon_brief: A cone of crystalline blue darts fired from an elbow-blade, the shards scattering across the ground.

name: Getsuga Tenshō
description: Moon Fang Heaven-Piercer. Each creature in the line takes 2d6[spirit] damage with a basic Reflex save. Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6. Refined (9th) — Kuroi Getsuga (Black Moon Fang) . The line increases to 60 feet , the damage ignores resistance to spirit damage , and creatures that critically fail take 1d6 persistent spirit damage.
icon_brief: A huge crescent-moon wave of blue-white energy flying off a blade's edge, cutting a trench in the ground beneath it.

name: Hirviendo — Boil
description: Frequency once per round You boil the water around you. All water and ice within your emanation — including that created by other creatures, and including effects with the water or cold trait that create terrain — is destroyed, and each enemy in the emanation takes 2d6[fire] damage. Terrain denial with a small damage rider: the counterpart to the Quincy's Seal the Art, aimed at battlefield control effects rather than at buffs.
icon_brief: Water swirling around a central blade boiling into thick white steam, the ice crystals evaporating instantly.

name: Hitotsume: Nadegiri
description: Requirements Your spirit weapon is Released · Cost 1 Reiatsu Point First: Clean Sweep. Stride up to your Speed, then make one Strike dealing an additional 1d6[untyped] damage; if the Strike hits, the target is off-guard until the end of your turn. Heightened (+2) +1d6.
icon_brief: A dash forward followed by a single clean sword sweep, the cut drawn as one bold brush stroke with dust trailing the dash.

name: Hyōryū Senbi
description: Ice Dragon Whirling Tail. Cost one petal-flower. Swinging the blade in a line, you throw a crescent of overflowing ice. Each creature in a 60-foot line takes 5d6[cold] damage with a basic Reflex save; creatures that fail are slowed 1 until the end of their next turn. Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
icon_brief: A crescent of overflowing ice thrown from a sword swing, ice crystals spreading out behind it in a line.

name: Hyōten Hyakkasō
description: Cost nothing · Requirements You are in Severance Frozen Heavens Hundred Flower Funeral. Snow falls and ice flowers bloom on everything it touches. 30-foot emanation , basic Fortitude, cold damage. Creatures that fail are restrained in a pillar of ice (Escape against your Reiatsu DC) and take 4d6 persistent cold that allows no flat check to end while restrained. Canon: the target's life ends when the hundredth petal falls. Waning. The damage is 20d6 if used in the first round of Severance, and two dice fewer each round after — 18d6, 16d6, 14d6, 12d6, 10d6, and 8d6 in the seventh. After the seventh round this cannot be used at all. Using this ends Severance , whether you want it to or not.
icon_brief: Snowflakes falling from a hole in dark clouds and blooming into delicate ice flowers wherever they touch.

name: Ikkotsu
description: Requirements Your spirit weapon is Released · Cost 1 Reiatsu Point Single Bone. Make one Strike dealing an additional 4d6[untyped] damage; on a critical hit the target is stunned 1 . Heightened (+1) +1d6. Carries the incapacitation trait.
icon_brief: A single massive punch with a bone-white shockwave ring and cracks spiderwebbing out from the point of impact.

name: Ittō Kasō
description: Cost nothing · Requirements You are in Severance Single Blade Cremation. A pillar of red fire in the shape of a katana's tip erupts from the ground. 20-foot burst within 60 feet, basic Reflex, fire damage — and it deals the Waning dice +2d6 , the only Art in the class that beats the table. The fire ignores resistance and immunity to fire . Creatures that fail can't regain Hit Points for 1 minute , and their regeneration and fast healing are suppressed for that minute. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by Ittō Kasō is cremated — returning it to life requires a 10th-rank effect. This Art costs you. When you use Ittō Kasō, you take damage equal to half your current Hit Points . This damage cannot be prevented, reduced, resisted, or redirected, and it is applied after the Art resolves. Canon insists: it is a forbidden technique that uses the caster's own body as the catalyst, Aizen calls it the spell of sacrifice, and Yamamoto loses his left arm casting it. That self-cost is why it is the biggest number in the section and carries the hardest rider — a cost that bought nothing would just make Ryūjin Jakka the worst Spirit to take to 20th. Waning. The damage is 20d6 if used in the first round of Severance, and two dice fewer each round after — 18d6, 16d6, 14d6, 12d6, 10d6, and 8d6 in the seventh. After the seventh round this cannot be used at all. Using this ends Severance , whether you want it to or not.
icon_brief: A single towering pillar of red fire erupting from the ground in the shape of a katana's tip.

name: Kanzen Saimin: Owari
description: Cost nothing · Requirements You are in Severance Complete Hypnosis: The End. The hypnosis stops being a lie about your position and becomes a lie about everything. 60-foot emanation , basic Will, mental damage. Creatures that fail are confused for 1 minute. On a critical failure the creature perceives its own allies as you for that minute and cannot be shaken loose by damage. ⚠ Extrapolated. Aizen has no canon Final Release, for the same reason he has no canon Bankai. Waning. The damage is 20d6 if used in the first round of Severance, and two dice fewer each round after — 18d6, 16d6, 14d6, 12d6, 10d6, and 8d6 in the seventh. After the seventh round this cannot be used at all. Using this ends Severance , whether you want it to or not.
icon_brief: A shattering mirror reflecting a distorted world, the cracks spreading across a moon reflected on dark water.

name: Kita: Tenchi Kaijin
description: North, Heaven and Earth End in Ashes. Frequency once per round · Requirements you are in the Kita aspect. Each creature in a 60-foot line takes 5d6[fire] damage with a basic Reflex save. This damage cannot be reduced by resistance to fire, by Blut Vene, or by Hierro . Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6. Canon's note that "not even Blut Vene can block this attack" is the only unresistable damage in the class. The friendly-fire clause of the Bankai is the price.
icon_brief: A single vertical slash cleaving through the sky and the earth beneath, a line of ash and fire splitting the frame.

name: La Gota
description: The Drop. A blade of compressed water thrown from the edge. Each creature in the cone takes 2d6[slashing] damage with a basic Reflex save; creatures that fail are pushed 10 feet away from you. Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6. Refined (9th) — Cascada (Waterfall) . The cone increases to 40 feet , creatures that critically fail fall prone , and the area becomes difficult terrain from standing water until the start of your next turn.
icon_brief: A blade of compressed water thrown from a sword's edge, a spray of droplets trailing behind it.

name: La Hora Final
description: Cost nothing · Requirements You are in Severance The Final Hour. Respira stops being a breath and becomes a verdict. 30-foot emanation , basic Fortitude, void damage. Creatures that fail are enfeebled 3 for 1 minute and drained 1 for 24 hours as decades leave them. ⚠ Extrapolated — the aging is Baraggan's canon aspect of death. Waning. The damage is 20d6 if used in the first round of Severance, and two dice fewer each round after — 18d6, 16d6, 14d6, 12d6, 10d6, and 8d6 in the seventh. icon_brief: A purple-black miasma expanding outward, a clock face at its centre whose hands are withering.

name: Lanza del Relámpago
description: Lance of the Lightning. Frequency once per round You forge a javelin of crackling green lightning and throw it. Make a ranged spell attack against one creature within 120 feet; on a hit it takes 5d6[electricity] damage, doubled on a critical hit. Whether or not you hit, the lance detonates in a 15-foot burst at that point: 5d6 fire damage, basic Reflex. Heightened (+1) +1d6 to both.
icon_brief: A javelin of crackling green lightning thrown forward, the energy pulsing along its length.

name: Licht Regen
description: Light Rain. A volley of arrows blackens the sky. Each creature in a 30-foot cone takes 6d6[piercing] damage with a basic Reflex save. Creatures that critically fail are off-guard until the start of your next turn. Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6. It enters at 6d6 and reaches 9d6 at rank 10 — under the standard area ladder's 11d6, because it comes as an addition to an existing Release Technique rather than replacing it.
icon_brief: A volley of blue arrows of light filling the sky, raining down in a cone.

description: Cost nothing · Requirements You are in Severance Moonless Sky. A blade of black reiatsu pours from your arm. 60-foot cone , basic Reflex, spirit damage. The damage is 20d6 if used in the first round of Severance, and two dice fewer each round after — 18d6, 16d6, 14d6, 12d6, 10d6, and 8d6 in the seventh. After the seventh round this cannot be used at all. Using this ends Severance , whether you want it to or not.
icon_brief: All the cherry-blossom petals condensing into a single brilliant white sword, wings and a vertical halo of light spreading behind it.

name: Sōkotsu
description: Requirements Your spirit weapon is Released · Cost 1 Reiatsu Point Double Bone. Make two Strikes against one creature; the second doesn't increase your multiple attack penalty. On a hit each deals an additional 1d6[untyped] damage. Heightened (+2) +1d6.
icon_brief: Two fists striking side by side, two overlapping bone-white shockwave rings bursting from one point.

name: Sprenger
description: Cost nothing · Requirements You are in Severance Five Seele Schneider planted in a pentacle, and the Gintō poured over them. 20-foot burst within 60 feet, basic Reflex, force damage. Creatures that critically fail are restrained by lines of light for 1 minute (Escape against your Reiatsu DC). Canon's fifth and largest Gintō, and the reason Uryū's Vollständig does not carry it. Waning. The damage is 20d6 if used in the first round of Severance, and two dice fewer each round after — 18d6, 16d6, 14d6, 12d6, 10d6, and 8d6 in the seventh. After the seventh round this cannot be used at all. Using this ends Severance , whether you want it to or not.
icon_brief: Five Seele Schneider blades planted in the ground in a pentacle, glowing lines of light connecting them as the Gintō is poured.

name: The Balance — Reaction
description: Trigger You take damage from a creature or effect you can perceive. You redistribute the harm. Reduce the damage you take by twice your level , then choose one enemy within 60 feet: it takes 2d6[spirit] damage, and until the end of its next turn it takes a −1 status penalty to saving throws . Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6. Refined (9th) The status penalty applies to AC and saving throws , and if the triggering damage would have reduced you to 0 Hit Points, you instead remain at 1 Hit Point. That last clause functions once per day . Canon: damage he takes is negated, and the one who dealt it suffers for having landed it.
icon_brief: A golden scale tipping as damage is redistributed, a glowing thread of light flowing from one pan into a distant enemy.

name: The Miracle — Growth
description: Trigger You take damage from an enemy · Frequency once per round Damage is a promise of growth. Gain 2 Miracle points (to a maximum of 10). While you have 1 or more Miracle points you gain resistance to all damage equal to the number of Miracle points you have . You may spend any number of Miracle points as a free action at the start of your turn; for each point spent, until the end of your turn your spirit weapon's Strikes deal +1d6 damage of its type. Miracle points are lost when the encounter ends. Refined (9th) — Blitz of the Hero. Your maximum Miracle points increase to 15 . When you spend Miracle points, you also gain a +5-foot status bonus to Speeds per point spent, to a maximum of +20 feet, until the end of your turn. This is the one Release Technique in the class that is a free action, and it costs a Reiatsu Point only the first time each encounter — because a Schrift that charges you to be hit is not The Miracle.
icon_brief: A golden aura flaring brighter as damage is taken, glowing points of light counting upward.

name: The Reckoning
description: Cost nothing · Requirements You are in Severance Every misfortune you have held back for other people, handed to one person at once. One creature within 60 feet , basic Fortitude, spirit damage. This ignores all resistances and immunities . The target is doomed 1 . If you have used your Release Technique at least three times this encounter, it is doomed 2 instead. ⚠ Extrapolated — the redistribution of fortune is Haschwalth's canon Schrift. Waning. The damage is 20d6 if used in the first round of Severance, and two dice fewer each round after — 18d6, 16d6, 14d6, 12d6, 10d6, and 8d6 in the seventh. After the seventh round this cannot be used at all. Using this ends Severance , whether you want it to or not.
icon_brief: A heavy dark weight of every held misfortune falling onto a single target, a golden scale cracking under the strain.

name: Trident
description: Frequency once per round You infuse the blade and fire a high-force slash in a series of three. Make three ranged Strikes with your spirit weapon against one creature within 60 feet, each at your current multiple attack penalty; the penalty does not increase until all three are made .
icon_brief: Three high-pressure water slashes fired in quick succession from a sword's edge, forming a trident shape.

name: Zanhyō Ningyō
description: Remnant Ice Doll. Cost one petal-flower. Trigger You are hit by an attack. A doll of ice takes the blow. Reduce the damage by an amount equal to twice your level ; the doll shatters.
icon_brief: A translucent ice doll shattering into fragments as a strike hits it, sparing the real figure.

name: Zanjutsu: Kendō
description: Requirements Your spirit weapon is Released · Cost 1 Reiatsu Point Make one Strike. Before rolling , choose: it ignores all resistances and immunities to its damage type, or it treats the target's AC as 2 lower . On a hit, it deals an additional 5d6[untyped] damage. Heightened (+1) +1d6. The AC clause is capped at −2 so it cannot combine with flanking and a status penalty to erase a boss's defence. The choice is made before the roll, so it is a stance you enter for one Strike rather than a result you pick afterwards — the two modes below are that choice.
icon_brief: A precise katana thrust passing straight through a glowing armour glyph that shatters, the blade's edge brilliant white.

name: Adamant Shell
description: Diamond + Steel. Your Hardness bonuses stack fully rather than taking the higher, and you cannot be off-guard from flanking. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A carapace plate of clear diamond facets fused over grey steel scales, the two layers interlocking like a vault door; faint white sparkle where they bond, a blade glancing off.

name: Ascension
description: Platinum + Aluminium. Your fly Speed increases by 20 feet and you may hover. Falling is something that happens to other people. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A pale platinum-and-silver membrane wing unfurling from a ridged chitin back, hovering weightless above a drop, tiny motes drifting downward beneath while the wing stays still.

name: Blackfire
description: Ruby + Onyx. Your fire damage becomes void and fire , and sheds darkness rather than light. When it kills a creature, you regain Hit Points equal to your level. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A clawed carapace hand wreathed in black flame that drinks light instead of shedding it, a ruby glowing red at its core inside an onyx shell, dark smoke curling.

name: Blind Hunter
description: Tin + Onyx. Inside your own magical darkness, your tremorsense becomes precise and enemies within it are off-guard to you. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A pool of inky darkness with ripples spreading across the ground like tremors, a tin-grey chitin limb pressed to the floor, a faint outline of hidden prey picked out in pale lines.

name: Chimera
description: Electrum + Nickel. You hold one additional Aberration, and it may be drawn from the Depth-4 rider list of either of your Instincts. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A lump of mismatched growths — a claw, an eye, a fin — budding from one electrum-and-nickel streaked chitin mass, iridescent and unsettling.

name: Chitin Bloom
description: Emerald + Chromium. Your fast healing also repairs your Carapace, and your Hardness increases by your fast healing value. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: Cracked chitin plates knitting themselves shut as green emerald tissue blooms through the seams like flowers, chrome-bright edges hardening behind the growth.

name: Cleansing Light
description: Pearl + Magnesium. Your Flare Core also ends one condition of value 1 on every ally inside the emanation. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A pearl-white sphere of light bursting from a ribbed organ, its soft glow washing over several figures and lifting dark wisps of affliction off them.

name: Cold Reading
description: Sapphire + Lapis Lazuli. Your Studied creature is also slowed 1 the first time you damage it each round, with no save. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A deep-blue sapphire eye set in chitin, lapis veins radiating from it, frost spreading across a targeted silhouette whose motion has slowed into blurred afterimages.

name: Conduction
description: Ruby + Copper. Your fire damage counts as fire and electricity , using whichever resistance is lower. Creatures in metal armour take +2 per damage die from it. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A copper-veined fist striking a breastplate, fire and electricity braided around the knuckles, sparks crawling over the metal armour.

name: Crowned Fortune
description: Topaz + Citrine. Once per encounter, declare a Strike imperial before rolling. On a success it counts as a critical success. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A carapace fist topped with a small crown of topaz and citrine spikes, a golden coin-flash bursting at the moment of impact.

name: Exsanguinary
description: Garnet + Jet. Persistent bleed you inflict also heals you for the same amount each time it ticks. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: Ribbons of blood flowing from a bleeding wound back along a jet-black tendril into a garnet-red pulsing gland.

name: Hammerform
description: Bronze + Iron. Your unarmed Strikes gain the fatal d10 trait when you have Stridden at least 10 feet this turn. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A carapace arm swelling into a massive bronze-and-iron hammerhead, motion streaks trailing behind it as it charges forward to strike.

name: Immune System
description: Jade + Zinc. Shifting Tissue may name poison, disease or a single spell school as well as an energy type. Ruled (#95): disease is a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against disease ; a spell school is one tradition — arcane, divine, occult or primal. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A jade-green chitin cell wall with zinc-grey antibody-like spines, engulfing and dissolving floating green spores and a faint spell glyph.

name: Impossible Body
description: Diamond + Mercury. You are simultaneously rigid and fluid: keep your Hardness while amorphous, and Liquid Form's reaction has no per-round limit. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A diamond-faceted plate that ripples like liquid mercury, half rigid crystal and half flowing silver in one shape.

name: Lightning Lash
description: Copper + Cobalt. Your ranged Arcane Channel Strike conducts: it chains to a second creature within 15 feet of the first for half damage. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A blue cobalt bolt fired from a copper-veined palm, striking one target and arcing on to a second, the jump drawn as a forked branch of lightning.

name: Living Armour
description: Hematite + Moonstone. Reactive Evolution triggers off damage taken by an ally within 15 feet as well as yourself. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: Hematite-red plates sprouting from a carapace and reaching outward to shield an ally standing nearby, moonstone sheen rippling across them as they adapt.

name: Living Flame
description: Ruby + Emerald. While you are taking persistent fire damage, or dealing it to anyone, your fast healing increases by 5. You burn what you are, and it grows back. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A burning chitin limb whose charred tissue is regrowing red-and-green at the same rate it chars, flames and new buds side by side.

name: Mindstorm
description: Amethyst + Quartz. A creature that fails a save against one of your Mutations is stupefied 1 and its next spell requires a DC 5 flat check. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A purple amethyst nodule cracking open into a whirl of quartz shards circling a skull-like silhouette, sparks of broken spell-light scattering.

name: Molten Carapace
description: Ruby + Iron. Your Carapace's Hardness increases by 5, and a creature that hits you with a melee unarmed or reach attack takes fire damage equal to half your level. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A thick iron-black carapace with lines of glowing molten ruby-red running through its cracks, a striking fist recoiling in a burst of embers.

name: Null Shroud
description: Onyx + Lead. Your magical darkness suppresses magical effects inside it (counteract rank = half your level) and cannot itself be counteracted below 6th rank. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A dense dome of lead-grey darkness swallowing floating spell glyphs, the runes dimming and breaking apart as they cross into it.

name: Quicksilver Gait
description: Carnelian + Mercury. You may Stride through creatures' spaces as though they were difficult terrain, and cannot be caught flat-footed by movement-triggered reactions. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A silvery liquid leg flowing between two silhouettes as though they were water, carnelian-orange streaks marking the path.

name: Reaper's Edge
description: Silver + Jet. Your void damage ignores the resistances and immunities of incorporeal undead entirely. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A silver-and-jet chitin blade cutting cleanly through a translucent ghost, the spectre splitting where it should have passed through.

name: Rime Flow
description: Sapphire + Mercury. Your Liquid Form damage reduction also freezes the attacker: it takes cold damage equal to the amount reduced. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A blow sinking into liquid-mercury flesh that turns to sapphire ice around the attacker's fist, frost climbing up the striking arm.

name: Rot
description: Jet + Manganese. Persistent acid you inflict also reduces the target's resistances by an additional 5 while it lasts. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: Dark acid seeping from jet-black claws into a creature's hide, the surface pitting and flaking, manganese-purple corrosion spreading outward.

name: Runaway Growth
description: Nickel + Emerald. Your Aberrations re-roll automatically whenever you drop below half Hit Points, and doing so restores Hit Points equal to twice your level. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: Chaotic tumour-like growths erupting across a wounded carapace, nickel-grey and emerald-green, a heart-red glow of healing at the centre.

name: Second Heart
description: Garnet + Emerald. Once per day, when you would die, you don't — you drop to 1 Hit Point and are stunned 1 as the second heart takes over. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: Two hearts side by side inside a translucent ribcage of chitin, one stopped and grey, the other garnet-red and just starting to beat.

name: Siege Frame
description: Iron + Steel. You ignore an object's Hardness up to 10, and forced movement you cause increases by an additional 10 feet. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: An oversized iron-and-steel chitin ram punching through a stone wall, bricks flying back far further than a normal blow would throw them.

name: Solar Core
description: Ruby + Gold. Once per encounter as a two-action activity, ignite: for 1 minute your fire damage increases by one die size and you shed bright light 60 feet. You take 1d6 fire at the start of each of your turns. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A ruby sphere ringed in gold set into a chitin chest, igniting into a small blazing sun with a corona of flame.

name: Storm Battery
description: Amber + Cobalt. Your Reservoir stores charges from your own ranged Strikes, and spending 3 charges lets Arcane Channel target every creature in a 15-foot cone. Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: An amber cell-sac filled with crackling cobalt lightning, three charge-sparks orbiting it, ready to discharge.

name: Transmutation
description: Gold + Electrum. Gilded Core may name a Substrate of your second Instinct, and Alloyed Instinct's half-value clause becomes three-quarters (round up). Suppressed while either Substrate is below Depth 2; it is not lost.
icon_brief: A gold nugget flowing into a pale electrum ingot on a living organic lattice, the metals blending where they touch, alchemical swirl of yellow-white light.

name: Assimilator
description: Something alive is wearing you, and it grows by eating. Not by levelling — by eating . Feed it a ruby and it learns to burn. Feed it iron and the limbs get heavier and longer. Feed it nickel and you do not know what you will have on Tuesday, and neither does it. Your build is not a list of choices made at character creation. It is a stomach , and its contents are visible on you. Key attribute Strength or Dexterity · Hit Points 10 + Constitution modifier per level · Class DC the Assimilator DC
icon_brief: A human arm overgrown by a living black-green carapace: ridged chitin plates, fine tendrils, glowing veins, a cut ruby and an iron shard being drawn into the flesh at the wrist.

name: Carapace Block
description: Trigger You take physical damage. Reduce the damage by your Carapace's Hardness. The Carapace takes that much damage. Use it when the damage is rolled, before it is applied: it arms the plate for the next physical damage you take this round, and the block is taken off that damage as it lands.
icon_brief: A raised chitin forearm-plate taking a sword blow head-on, cracks spidering across the plate while the arm behind stays whole.

name: Feed
description: Activity (10 minutes) Consume one Substrate you are holding. If you already hold it, its Depth increases by 1 ; otherwise it enters your Lattice at Depth 1 . Either way it costs Mass equal to its new Depth, and the physical Substrate is destroyed. Using it opens the Gullet, where the Substrate and the specimen are chosen and the Mass is checked.
icon_brief: A gaping toothed maw opening in a carapace palm, swallowing a glittering gemstone, veins lighting up as it is absorbed.

name: Manifest the Apotheosis
description: Frequency once per day Every bound Substrate manifests at your Depth cap for 1 minute, regardless of the Mass you actually paid.
icon_brief: Every gem and metal fused into the carapace blazing at once, a crown of crystal and metal spikes erupting outward in a single brilliant flare.

name: Purify
description: White Instinct. End one condition on yourself or an ally. A number of times per day equal to your highest Depth. Target the ally first; with no target it is you.
icon_brief: A white-glowing chitin hand drawing black tendrils of a condition out of an ally's chest, the dark strands burning away to light.

name: Shed
description: During your daily preparations only. Remove any Substrate, or reduce any Substrate's Depth, freeing that Mass. What you shed is destroyed, not recovered. Using it opens the Gullet, where the Substrate and the specimen are chosen and the Mass is checked.
icon_brief: A husk of old chitin peeling away from a limb like a snake's moulted skin, a crumbling gem falling from it as dust.

name: Study
description: Blue Instinct. You Study a creature. Until the encounter ends, your Mutations treat its resistances as lower by twice your highest Depth, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against it. One creature at a time: Studying another ends the first.
icon_brief: A blue compound eye opening in carapace, scanning lines tracing a creature's outline and highlighting its weak points.

name: Ignite the Solar Core
description: Solar Core (Ruby + Gold). Once per encounter, ignite: for 1 minute your fire damage increases by one die size and you shed bright light 60 feet. You take 1d6 fire at the start of each of your turns.
icon_brief: The moment of ignition: a ruby-and-gold chest core bursting into white-hot light, flames licking back over the carapace that holds it.

name: Imperial Strike
description: Crowned Fortune (Topaz + Citrine). Once per encounter, declare your next Strike imperial before rolling. On a success it counts as a critical success.
icon_brief: A carapace fist striking with a golden crown-shaped flare at the point of impact, the hit landing as a starburst of topaz light.

name: Storm Channel
description: Storm Battery (Amber + Cobalt). Spend 3 charges from your Reservoir: make your Arcane Channel Strike against every creature in a 15-foot cone.
icon_brief: A cone of cobalt lightning fanning out from an outstretched chitin palm, three spent charge-sparks fading at the wrist.

name: Alien Physiology
description: You are no longer entirely a person. You need neither food, drink nor air, and you are immune to disease . You are immune to the drained condition , and to any effect that would alter your physical form against your will (petrification, polymorph, and the like) — the symbiont is already using that space. To accept a polymorph willingly, switch on Accept a transformation before it lands; switching it off does not end one already on you. You can be healed by Repair as well as by anything that heals a creature. You no longer have a discernible anatomy: you are immune to precision damage and to critical specialization effects of the knife and pick groups.
icon_brief: A closed chitin chrysalis-like body with no mouth or nostrils, gills sealed shut, indifferent veins glowing faintly — a thing that needs nothing.

name: Apotheosis
description: The host and the thing stop being two things. Your Mass increases by 3 in each track. Once per day, as a free action , every bound Substrate manifests at your Depth cap for 1 minute, regardless of the Mass you actually paid. Your Carapace can no longer be broken by physical damage alone; only an effect that would destroy an object outright can do it.
icon_brief: Host and symbiont merged into one shape: a carapace silhouette with no seam left between flesh and plate, gems and metals studded across it glowing in unison.

name: Assimilation
description: You gain Mass in two separate pools — 1 Gem Mass and 1 Metal Mass at 1st level — and the two activities that manage them, Feed and Shed . A Substrate at Depth N costs N Mass , and your Depth cap is 1. Depth 1–2 takes an ordinary specimen — a looted ruby, a copper ingot, a pearl off a necklace. Depth 3–4 takes a quickened specimen , one that grew somewhere the mundane world doesn't reach; those are never shop inventory. The Vein provides. Every time your Mass increases, you gain one free Substrate of any kind you qualify for. Everything you have eaten is kept in the Gullet, which Feed and Shed open.
icon_brief: Two glowing reservoirs inside a carapace — one faceted red-violet for gems, one ridged grey for metals — with a small gem and a metal shard dropping into each.

name: Assimilation Expertise
description: Your proficiency rank for your Assimilator DC increases to expert.
icon_brief: A gem half-sunk into living chitin, three tendrils wrapping it with practised precision, a single bronze-coloured ring of light around it.

name: Assimilation Mastery
description: Your proficiency rank for your Assimilator DC increases to master.
icon_brief: A gem almost fully absorbed into living chitin, intricate tendrils threaded through every facet, a silver-gold double ring of light around it.

name: Carapace Expertise
description: The plate has learned where to hit. Your proficiency rank for unarmed attacks increases to expert.
icon_brief: A chitin fist striking a precise point on a target, a crosshair of veins on the knuckle, one ring of bronze light.

name: Carapace Mastery
description: Your proficiency rank for unarmed attacks increases to master.
icon_brief: A chitin fist with blade-like ridges, its blow landing in a perfect radial crack, a double ring of gold light around it.

name: Fifth Bond
description: You gain a fifth Bond slot, and your Gem Mass and Metal Mass each increase by 2.
icon_brief: Five interlocking rings of fused gem and metal set in a pentagon on a carapace back, all five glowing.

name: First Bond
description: You gain your first Bond slot . A Bond requires both its Substrates at Depth 2 or higher; you choose it when you gain the slot and may change it at daily preparations.
icon_brief: One gem and one metal shard joined by a living tendril knot into a single glowing ring on chitin.

name: Fourth Bond
description: You gain a fourth Bond slot.
icon_brief: Four interlocking gem-and-metal rings set in a square on chitin, the fourth newly formed and brightest.

name: Fourth Skin
description: Your Depth cap becomes 4. Your Gem Mass increases by 2 and your Metal Mass by 1.
icon_brief: Four nested layers of chitin peeled back in a cross-section like tree rings, the deepest layer glowing hottest.

name: Growth (14th)
description: Your Gem Mass and Metal Mass each increase by 2.
icon_brief: Both Mass reservoirs, gem and metal, swelling and overflowing with new crystal and ore, veins bulging around them.

name: Growth (3rd)
description: Your Gem Mass increases by 1.
icon_brief: A single faceted gem reservoir inside the carapace swelling larger, a new crystal budding off its side.

name: Instinct
description: Your Instinct is the colour you have invested the most total Mass in, counting both tracks. It grants that colour's Instinct clause , which applies to every Mutation you have , including Mutations of other colours. Ties are broken by you, freely, at daily preparations. Instinct is recalculated at daily preparations and costs nothing to change. It also sets your Instinct's damage type : Red fire, Gold force, Orange electricity, Blue cold, Purple mental, Green poison, Black void, White vitality, Gray bludgeoning.
icon_brief: A colour wheel of gem hues set into chitin, one wedge glowing brightest and its colour spreading out through the veins.

name: Living Weapon
description: You gain the critical specialization effect of the brawling group for your unarmed attacks.
icon_brief: A carapace fist whose knuckles sprout thorns, a target knocked prone and dazed by the blow, stars of impact around it.

name: Second Bond
description: You gain a second Bond slot, and your Gem Mass and Metal Mass each increase by 2.
icon_brief: Two interlocking gem-and-metal rings bound together on a chitin plate, a living tendril weaving between them.

name: Second Skin
description: Your Depth cap becomes 2, and your Gem Mass and Metal Mass each increase by 1.
icon_brief: Two nested layers of chitin shown in cross-section, the inner one glowing, a new harder shell forming over the old.

name: Shell Mastery
description: Your proficiency rank for unarmored defense increases to master.
icon_brief: A domed chitin shell curling around a body like an armadillo, arrows and blades bouncing off its overlapping plates.

name: Symbiotic Reflex
description: Frequency once per round; Trigger A creature you can see damages you. Choose one — (a) gain resistance equal to twice your highest Depth against that damage, or (b) if the triggering creature is within your reach, make a Carapace Strike against it. It does not stack with Carapace Block against the same damage. Target the creature that damaged you and use it as the damage is rolled. It asks which: (a) arms the plate for the next damage you take this round and is taken off it as it lands — with Carapace Block also armed, only the larger of the two applies; (b) makes the Carapace Strike, offered only while the creature is within your reach. While the symbiont is suppressed there is no Depth, so only (b) is offered.
icon_brief: A carapace that reacts on its own: a tendril-tipped spike lashing out from the shoulder to strike back at an attacker, or plates flaring to absorb the hit.

name: The Carapace
description: Something alive is wearing you. It is your weapon, your armour, and the thing that breaks. Carapace Strike. Your unarmed attack is the class. It deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage, is in the brawling group, and has only the unarmed trait — it is not agile and it is not finesse. Handwraps of mighty blows work normally; the class grants no free fundamental runes. Living Plate. The symbiont is your armour and cannot be removed: explorer's clothing that is alive (AC item bonus +0, Dex cap +5, no check or Speed penalty, no Bulk). It accepts armour potency, resilient and property runes on the normal schedule. It has Hardness 2 plus the highest Hardness bonus among your bound Substrates, 10 + 5 per level Hit Points, and a Broken Threshold of half its Hit Points. Carapace Block is how the plate takes a blow for you. While the Carapace is broken, you lose Living Plate's rune benefits, and every Mutation at Depth 3 or higher switches off until it is repaired.
icon_brief: A heavy, living chitin gauntlet-arm: ridged black-green plates, glowing veins, a cracked edge — weapon, armour and the thing that breaks.

name: Third Bond
description: You gain a third Bond slot.
icon_brief: Three interlocking gem-and-metal rings in a triangle on a chitin plate, the third newly fused and glowing.

name: Third Skin
description: Your Depth cap becomes 3. Your Gem Mass increases by 2 and your Metal Mass by 1.
icon_brief: Three nested chitin layers in cross-section, rings like geological strata, the innermest layer pulsing with gem-light.

name: Aberrant Gland
description: Frequency once per encounter A 15-foot cone dealing 2d6 damage of your Instinct's type, basic Reflex save against your class DC.
icon_brief: A bulbous gland swelling on a chitin shoulder, spraying a wide cone of glowing energy in the Instinct's colour.

name: Amorphous
description: You become amorphous for 1 minute: immune to precision damage, and critical hits against you deal normal damage.
icon_brief: A body slumping into a shapeless, rubbery chitin mass, a dagger point sinking in harmlessly with no vital spot to find.

name: Ascendant Flight
description: Gain a fly Speed equal to half your land Speed for 1 minute.
icon_brief: A pair of translucent insect-like wings bursting from a chitin back mid-beat, lifting the body off the ground.

name: Carrion Harvest
description: A creature within 30 feet at or below half its Hit Points must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or take void damage equal to twice your level .
icon_brief: Black tendrils reaching from a carapace hand across the ground to a wounded, half-bloodied creature, drawing a dark void-mist out of it.

name: Cleansing Tide
description: Frequency once per encounter (twice at Pearl Depth 4) End one condition of value 1 on yourself or an adjacent ally. At Depth 3 the range is 30 feet and it may instead reduce one affliction's stage by 1; at Depth 4 it may instead counteract one spell effect of 4th rank or lower.
icon_brief: A gentle wave of pearl-white water rolling off a chitin palm over an ally, washing a grey affliction-stain from their skin.

name: Clear Tide
description: Reduce the value of one of your conditions by 1.
icon_brief: A small clear ripple spreading across one's own carapace, a dark condition-mark fading by a notch.

name: Discharge
description: Cost 3 Reservoir charges A 30-foot line of 6d6 damage of the stored type, basic Reflex save against your class DC.
icon_brief: A straight 30-foot line of stored energy blasting from a chitin palm, three charge-sparks emptying into the beam.

name: Draw on the Reservoir
description: Spend 1 Reservoir charge: your next Strike deals +1d4 of the stored type. At Amber Depth 2, if you have 2 charges, spend 2 instead for +1d6 + 2 .
icon_brief: A single charge-spark flowing from an amber sac down the arm into a chitin fist, crackling around the knuckles before the punch.

name: Exsanguinate
description: Drain a dying creature within 30 feet: it dies, and you regain Hit Points equal to your level.
icon_brief: A dying creature's last red life-thread pulled across the air into an open chitin maw in the palm.

name: Flare
description: Frequency once per encounter Creatures in a 15-foot emanation must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be dazzled for 1 round. At Magnesium Depth 3 a failure is blinded instead, and the flare deals fire damage equal to your level to creatures with light sensitivity or light blindness. At Depth 4 the emanation is 30 feet and counteracts magical darkness; once per day it may instead heal each ally within it for your level.
icon_brief: A burst of blinding white-magnesium light erupting from a ribbed chest organ, rays spreading in a ring.

name: Forked Channel
description: Cobalt, Depth 4. Arcane Channel targets two creatures within 120 feet: one Strike at each. Choose up to two targets and use it; the Channel is rolled at each, at the same multiple attack penalty.
icon_brief: A blue cobalt bolt splitting in two mid-flight from a chitin palm, each fork reaching a different distant target.

name: Frame Rush
description: Bronze, Depth 3. Make a Strike and then a Shove, Trip or Grapple, as a single action. Target a creature and use it: the Carapace Strike is rolled against it, then a card asks which of the three follows, at the next step of your multiple attack penalty.
icon_brief: A bronze-heavy chitin arm landing a punch and then hooking the target in the same motion, two motion arcs flowing into one.

name: Gilded Apotheosis
description: One Substrate chosen for your Gilded Core manifests at Depth 4 for 1 minute, regardless of its real Depth.
icon_brief: One embedded gem in a carapace blazing gold, ringed by four concentric depth-circles all lit at once.

name: Gilded Chance
description: Trigger You fail a check. Reroll the check and take the second result. At Citrine Depth 2 you may do this twice per day, and the reroll gains a +2 circumstance bonus . Using it rerolls your most recent failed check for you, keeping the new result, with the +2 added at Depth 2.
icon_brief: A golden d20 tumbling back up into the air for a second roll, citrine sparkles trailing behind it.

name: Healing Flare
description: Magnesium Depth 4. Once per day your Flare instead heals each ally in a 30-foot emanation for Hit Points equal to your level.
icon_brief: A warm white-and-green flare bursting from a chest organ, petals of light falling onto allies' wounds and closing them.

name: Hollow Flight
description: Fly 30 feet.
icon_brief: A light, hollow-boned chitin frame leaping into the air on short stubby wings, a quick flight arc behind it.

name: Lay Bare
description: Lapis Lazuli, Depth 4. Once per encounter, name a creature's strongest save ; for 1 minute your Mutations target its weakest instead. Target the creature and use it: its saves are read off its sheet, and your Mutations' saves that call for the strongest roll the weakest.
icon_brief: A deep-blue lapis eye peeling back a creature's armoured shell to reveal a soft glowing weak spot beneath.

name: Null Field
description: Frequency once per encounter Suppress magical effects in a 15-foot emanation for 1 round: attempt to counteract each, counteract rank equal to half your level.
icon_brief: A ring of dull grey energy spreading out from a carapace, spell glyphs inside it flickering and going dark.

name: Pass Through
description: Trigger You are hit. Reduce the damage by your level as the blow passes through you. Use it as the damage is rolled; it is taken off that damage as it lands. With Carapace Block or Symbiotic Reflex also armed, only the largest applies.
icon_brief: A sword blade passing through a body that ripples like water, the edge emerging on the other side with only a trace of harm.

name: Prism Counteract
description: Counteract one magical effect: counteract rank equal to half your level, counteract modifier equal to your class DC − 10. Twice per day at Quartz Depth 4.
icon_brief: A crystal prism grown from a chitin palm splitting an incoming spell beam into harmless rainbow strands.

name: Prism Reflection
description: Quartz, Depth 4. Trigger A spell targets only you. Reflect it back at its caster; a Will save against your class DC negates. Target the caster and use it: the caster rolls Will against your class DC and the card says reflected or negated. Carrying the spell to the caster — its damage card, its conditions — is the table's.
icon_brief: A faceted quartz shield on a carapace bouncing a spell bolt straight back the way it came, the reflected beam tinted rainbow.

name: Reactive Evolution
description: Trigger You take damage of a type. Gain resistance to that type — 2 for 1 minute at Moonstone Depth 1 (once per encounter), 5 at Depth 2 (twice per encounter), 8 until the encounter ends at Depth 3 (two types at once), 12 at Depth 4 (unlimited, three types at once).
