icon_brief: Moonstone-sheened plates rapidly reshaping where a fire burst struck them, new heat-resistant scales growing in that blast's colour.

name: Reading Eye
description: Recall Knowledge about a creature you can see.
icon_brief: A single slit-pupilled eye opening in the back of a chitin hand, studying a creature's outline with faint knowledge-runes around it.

name: Shadow Mantle
description: Create a 20-foot emanation of magical darkness for 1 minute. You see through it normally.
icon_brief: A cloak of living darkness pouring off a carapace and spreading in a circle, a pair of faint glowing eyes visible within.

name: Shadow Step
description: Teleport from an area of darkness to another area of darkness within 60 feet. Use it, then click the destination: both squares must be in darkness — a dark scene, or inside a darkness such as Shadow Mantle's — and within 60 feet.
icon_brief: A body sinking into one pool of shadow and rising from another across the ground, a dark trail linking the two.

name: Shift Tissue
description: Change the energy type Shifting Tissue resists. Using this opens the Gullet with the change allowed.
icon_brief: A patch of chitin flowing from red to blue to green like a chameleon, swapping which energy it resists.

name: Turn of Fortune
description: Trigger A d20 roll is made within 30 feet, and you see the result. Change that roll by 5 in either direction — yours, an ally's, or an enemy's.
icon_brief: A tumbling d20 nudged mid-roll by a thin chitin tendril, its face turning to show a different number.

name: Living Plate
description: The symbiont is your armour and cannot be removed. It functions as explorer's clothing that is alive : AC item bonus +0, Dex cap +5, no check penalty, no Speed penalty, no Bulk. It accepts armour potency, resilient and property runes, etched by feeding rather than by a smith. You cannot wear other armour. Attempting it suppresses Living Plate, every Mutation, and your Instinct until you take it off. This is also the Carapace : its Hardness, Hit Points and Broken Threshold are the plate's. Repair it with the Repair activity.
icon_brief: A suit of thin, supple living chitin hugging the body like clothes, plates breathing slightly, rune-etchings grown into the surface rather than carved.

name: Aberration: A Gland
description: Once per encounter, a 15-foot cone dealing 2d6 of your Instinct's type, basic Reflex.
icon_brief: A swollen, throbbing gland bulging on the neck or shoulder, glowing faintly in the Instinct's colour, ready to spray.

name: Aberration: A Limb
description: An additional unarmed Strike, agile, 1d6 of a physical type.
icon_brief: An extra thin chitin arm sprouting from the ribs, quick and clawed, poised to strike.

name: Aberration: A Maw
description: Your jaws gain the deadly d8 trait.
icon_brief: A wide jaw lined with long hooked teeth grown into a carapace, gums glistening.

name: Aberration: A Mode
description: A climb Speed equal to half your land Speed.
icon_brief: Hooked climbing claws and suction pads growing from chitin hands and feet, clinging to a sheer wall.

name: Aberration: A Plate
description: Hardness +3 and a −5-foot Speed penalty.
icon_brief: A heavy, thick slab of chitin plate grown over a shoulder, dragging the body down with its weight.

name: Aberration: An Organ
description: One sense: darkvision.
icon_brief: A glowing extra eye with a dark-adapted pupil growing on a carapace brow, seeing clearly through gloom.

name: Effect: Amorphous
description: Immune to precision damage; critical hits against you deal normal damage.
icon_brief: A soft, blobby outline with no clear joints or vital spots, a pointed weapon slipping off harmlessly.

name: Effect: Apotheosis
description: Every bound Substrate manifests at your Depth cap, regardless of the Mass you actually paid.
icon_brief: A carapace studded with every gem and metal, all blazing at full intensity, a crown of crystal spikes radiating light.

name: Effect: Argent-Bound
description: Silver, Depth 4. Critically hit by an Assimilator's Argent Edge: this creature cannot use reactions or innate spells until the end of its next turn.
icon_brief: A creature's limbs bound in shimmering silver threads, frozen mid-reaction, its innate magic sputtering out.

name: Effect: Ascendant Flight
description: A fly Speed equal to half your land Speed.
icon_brief: Translucent insect wings buzzing on a carapace back, the body hovering a little above the ground.

name: Effect: Carapace Block
description: The plate is set. The next physical damage you take is reduced by your Carapace's Hardness, and the Carapace takes that much damage. Spent when it lands.
icon_brief: A chitin plate set forward and braced, a faint shield-glow on its surface, waiting for the next blow.

name: Effect: Carapace Broken
description: The Carapace is broken. You lose Living Plate's rune benefits, and every Mutation at Depth 3 or higher is switched off until the Carapace is repaired — with the Repair activity against its own Hardness, or one hour of Feeding it any Substrate you don't bind. Put on and taken off by the module as the plate's Hit Points cross its Broken Threshold.
icon_brief: A shattered chitin plate split down the middle, fragments falling away, dim veins underneath with their glow switched off.

name: Effect: Carrion-Marked
description: Jet, Depth 3. Killed by an Assimilator's Carrion Bloom: this creature cannot be returned to life by magic below 6th rank .
icon_brief: A corpse marked with a black fungal bloom, jet tendrils rooting it to the ground, a broken halo above refusing resurrection.

name: Effect: Cold Reading
description: Slowed 1 by Cold Reading until the end of its next turn.
icon_brief: A creature dusted in blue frost, its movements leaving slow, smeared afterimages.

name: Effect: Conductive Charge (Electricity)
description: Your next Strike before the end of your next turn deals +1d4 electricity .
icon_brief: A carapace fist crackling with blue-white sparks, an electric charge coiled around the knuckles.

name: Effect: Conductive Charge (Fire)
description: Your next Strike before the end of your next turn deals +1d4 fire .
icon_brief: A carapace fist with small orange flames licking around the knuckles, ready to land a burning punch.

name: Effect: Corroded
description: Rot Touch has pitted this creature: all its resistances are lower by the amount named, against anyone's damage, until the end of its next turn.
icon_brief: A creature's hide pitted and bubbling with acid, armour flaking off in green-brown patches.

name: Effect: Depth 4 for This Strike
description: A critical hit. The Substrates named here count as Depth 4 for this Strike — its damage and whatever answers it landing — whether or not they are at Depth 4. Gold's Instinct, Topaz at Depth 4 and Apex Predator make it. It ends when your next attack is rolled, or at the end of your turn. Not while the Carapace is broken, which switches every Mutation at Depth 3 or higher off.
icon_brief: A critical-hit starburst where a carapace fist lands, four concentric depth-rings flashing around the impact.

name: Effect: Devour
description: Temporary Hit Points from what you ate, for 1 minute.
icon_brief: A full, swollen gut-sac glowing in a carapace belly, a translucent shimmer of borrowed temporary life around the body.

name: Effect: Gilded Apotheosis
description: The first Substrate chosen for your Gilded Core manifests at Depth 4.
icon_brief: A single gem in the carapace shining like molten gold, its glow far brighter than its size.

name: Effect: Glacial Chill
description: This creature's Speeds are reduced by 5 feet until the end of its next turn.
icon_brief: Frost creeping over a creature's legs and feet, ice crystals clinging to them, its stride shortened.

name: Effect: Hunted in Darkness
description: Inside a Blind Hunter's magical darkness: off-guard to that Assimilator.
icon_brief: A creature lost in pitch darkness looking the wrong way, a faint shape of a hunter's claw looming behind it.

name: Effect: Imperial
description: Your next Strike is imperial: on a success it counts as a critical success.
icon_brief: A small golden crown hovering over a carapace fist, a glint of guaranteed triumph on the knuckles.

name: Effect: Instinctive Surge
description: Until the end of your turn, your Instinct clause treats every Substrate as one Depth higher.
icon_brief: Every gem set in the carapace flaring one step brighter at once, the dominant colour surging through the veins.

name: Effect: Integrated Plating
description: Gray Instinct. You used a Mutation: resistance equal to its Depth to all physical damage until the start of your next turn.
icon_brief: Grey interlocking plates sliding together over a carapace after a Mutation fires, a dull iron sheen of resistance.

name: Effect: Kinetic Surge
description: Orange Instinct. You moved or reacted: your next Mutation this round deals +1d4 of its own damage type.
icon_brief: Orange motion-streaks trailing off a moving carapace, kinetic energy pooling as a bright ember in the palm.

name: Effect: Knitting Surge
description: Knitting Flesh refused to let you fall: fast healing 15 for 1 minute.
icon_brief: Torn flesh pulling itself shut in a rush: pale green seams zipping closed across a wound, glowing green threads stitching faster than the eye can follow, droplets of light rising.

name: Effect: Laid Bare
description: Lapis Lazuli, Depth 4. An Assimilator named this creature's strongest save: for 1 minute, that Assimilator's Mutations target its weakest instead.
icon_brief: A creature's silhouette with a deep-blue lapis lens over it; its brightest shield-sigil cracked and dimmed, while a small weak point glows exposed, targeted by thin blue lines.

name: Effect: Lapis Insight
description: Lapis Lazuli, Depth 2. An allied Assimilator has read this creature: +1 circumstance to attacks against it, for 1 round.
icon_brief: A ring of small dark lenses all focused on one target, a blue crosshair of light settling over it, lapis-blue sparks marking where to strike.

name: Effect: Mindstorm
description: Stupefied 1 by Mindstorm until the end of its next turn. Its next spell requires a DC 5 flat check.
icon_brief: A head-shaped silhouette wrapped in a swirling violet thundercloud, little psychic lightning forks crackling inside, a spell glyph fizzling and breaking apart at the edge.

name: Effect: Null Weight
description: A −1 status penalty to this creature's next save.
icon_brief: A single heavy grey lead weight hanging from a creature's shoulders, a protective rune beneath it pressed flat and dim.

name: Effect: Null Weight Aura
description: Lead, Depth 3. Within 10 feet of an Assimilator's Null Weight: −1 status to spell attack rolls and spell DCs .
icon_brief: A dull lead-grey ring spreading on the ground around a carapaced figure, floating spell runes inside it sagging and dimming as if pulled down by weight.

name: Effect: Pass Through
description: The next damage from a creature is reduced by your level. Spent when it lands.
icon_brief: A blade passing through a section of translucent, jelly-like carapace that parts around it and closes behind, the blow's force fading into ripples.

name: Effect: Plated Guard
description: +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. You cannot use Carapace Block.
icon_brief: Chitin plates swelling and overlapping into a thick bulging shield over a forearm, ridged and dark, a blow sparking off the surface.

name: Effect: Quartz Charge
description: Quartz, Depth 3. You counteracted an effect, or a spell failed against you: your next Strike deals +2d6 force .
icon_brief: A clear quartz prism growing from a knuckle, crackling with stored white-violet force, light refracting into a sharp beam ready to discharge.

name: Effect: Reach of the Thing
description: Your next Carapace Strike this turn has reach 10 feet (the reach trait).
icon_brief: A carapaced arm with a sudden extra length of jointed chitin unfolding from the elbow, the fist now reaching twice as far, segments still sliding into place.

name: Effect: Reactive Evolution
description: Resistance to the damage type you chose, by your Moonstone's Depth.
icon_brief: A pale moonstone sheen sliding across armoured plates to the side just struck, the plating there hardening in that element's colour.

name: Effect: Reservoir Primed
description: Your next Strike carries the Reservoir's stored energy.
icon_brief: A translucent amber sac at the sternum full to bursting, the stored energy pouring down a vein into a clenched fist that glows orange.

name: Effect: Second Hunger
description: Two borrowed Mass deepen a bound Substrate for 1 minute; then it returns to its real Depth.
icon_brief: A glowing gem embedded in flesh swelling larger, borrowed light flowing into it from two small floating orbs, an hourglass faint behind it.

name: Effect: Shadow Mantle
description: A 20-foot emanation of magical darkness surrounds you for 1 minute. You see through it normally.
icon_brief: An expanding sphere of inky black darkness with a carapaced silhouette at its core, edges impossible to locate, one pair of faint eyes seeing through.

name: Effect: Siphoned
description: A Black Instinct Mutation drank from this creature: a status penalty to one check or DC until the end of its next turn.
icon_brief: A creature's glowing aura being drawn out in a thin black stream toward a dark mouth-like orifice, its colour fading where the stream leaves.

name: Effect: Siphoning
description: You took what the Black Instinct drank: a status bonus to the same check or DC.
icon_brief: A dark onyx-black carapace node swollen with stolen light, a thin stream flowing in, the plate glowing faintly with the borrowed strength.

name: Effect: Solar Core
description: Your fire damage increases by one die size and you shed bright light 60 feet. You take 1d6 fire at the start of each of your turns.
icon_brief: A blazing miniature sun burning in the chest of a carapace, cracks of white-orange fire spreading outward, light pouring off in rays and scorching the plates.

name: Effect: Studied
description: An Assimilator has Studied this creature: its Mutations treat this creature's resistances as lower, and it has a circumstance bonus to AC against this creature, until the encounter ends.
icon_brief: A creature marked by a blue lens and annotated with faint glowing lines over its armour seams, its resistance-shield sigil thinning.

name: Effect: Studied Guard
description: +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the creature you Studied (Blue Instinct).
icon_brief: A blue lens-eye over a raised chitin forearm guard, the guard angled exactly into the path of one enemy's strike.

name: Effect: Symbiotic Reflex
description: The thing that is wearing you has opinions about being hit. The next damage you take is reduced by twice your highest Depth. Spent when it lands.
icon_brief: Carapace plates snapping shut over a body on their own as a blow arrives, small reflexive spikes bristling, a hit absorbed into the plating.

name: Effect: Taste for It
description: Your next Recall Knowledge about the creature you damaged is a free action with a +2 circumstance bonus.
icon_brief: A forked tendril-tongue tasting a drop of an enemy's blood, a glowing question-mark glyph of knowledge rising from the taste.

name: Effect: Wall of Me
description: Your wall of Carapace stands for 1 minute or until destroyed; your own Carapace's Hardness is 2 lower while it does.
icon_brief: A ridged wall of living chitin standing in a line, veined and breathing, a trail of carapace still connecting it to a thinned-out armoured figure.

name: Effect: Worn No Longer
description: The Carapace is away for 1 minute. You are unarmoured, unmutated, and a person again.
icon_brief: An empty carapace shell standing apart and walking away, a pale unarmoured human silhouette left behind, a severed tendril between them.

name: Instinct: Black
description: Consume / Corrupt. When a Mutation damages a creature, it takes a −1 status penalty to one check or DC of your choice until the end of its next turn, and you gain +1 status to the same thing . At Depth 3+ the penalty and bonus become −2 / +2 . Your Instinct's damage type is void. Under Electrum Depth 3 this clause may be a second one, at half value.
icon_brief: A black symbiont maw draining a ribbon of colour from one target into itself, a downward and upward arrow pair, void-black and dull violet.

name: Instinct: Blue
description: Adapt / Understand. Study a creature (one action). Until the encounter ends, your Mutations treat its resistances as lower by twice your highest Depth , and you gain +1 circumstance to AC against it. One creature at a time. Your Instinct's damage type is cold. Under Electrum Depth 3 this clause may be a second one, at half value.
icon_brief: A single huge blue compound eye set in chitin, scanning a target through concentric rings of light, cold-blue and thoughtful.

name: Instinct: Gold
description: Amplify / Dominate. At daily preparations choose one bound Substrate; it counts as one Depth higher , never above your Depth cap. When you critically hit, that Substrate counts as Depth 4 for that Strike even if it isn't at Depth 4. Your Instinct's damage type is force. Under Electrum Depth 3 this clause may be a second one, at half value.
icon_brief: A carapace crowned with a glowing golden gem, smaller gems around it brightening one step at a time, gilded light.

name: Instinct: Gray
description: Harden / Integrate. Your Carapace's Hardness increases by the total Depth of your bound metals . When you use a Mutation, gain resistance equal to its Depth to all physical damage until the start of your next turn. Your Instinct's damage type is bludgeoning. Under Electrum Depth 3 this clause may be a second one, at half value.
icon_brief: Iron-grey carapace plates bolting themselves together in heavy layers, metal veins merging into the shell, rivet-like nodes.

name: Instinct: Green
description: Grow / Reproduce. When a Mutation deals damage, gain temporary Hit Points equal to its Depth . Fast healing equal to the number of bound Green Substrates. Your Instinct's damage type is poison. Under Electrum Depth 3 this clause may be a second one, at half value.
icon_brief: Green chitin sprouting new buds of living tissue, poison-green droplets on the tips, a spiral of growth unfolding outward.

name: Instinct: Orange
description: Move / React. The first time each round you Stride, Step or use a reaction, your next Mutation this round deals +1d4 of its own damage type. +5 feet Speed per bound Orange Substrate. Your Instinct's damage type is electricity. Under Electrum Depth 3 this clause may be a second one, at half value.
icon_brief: A carapaced leg mid-stride trailing orange sparks of electricity, the motion charging a crackling node in the next limb.

name: Instinct: Purple
description: Mutate / Transcend. Your Mutations count as magical . At daily preparations one Substrate of your choice manifests one Depth higher , and one other, randomly determined, manifests one Depth lower . Your Instinct's damage type is mental. Under Electrum Depth 3 this clause may be a second one, at half value.
icon_brief: Violet carapace mutating mid-change: spines, eyes and fins shimmering in and out, iridescent purple-magenta light.

name: Instinct: Red
description: Consume / Destroy. When a Mutation deals damage, it deals +1 damage per Depth of its Substrate. Against a creature that has already lost Hit Points this encounter, double that bonus. Your Instinct's damage type is fire. Under Electrum Depth 3 this clause may be a second one, at half value.
icon_brief: A red chitin claw tearing into a wound, flames bursting from the cut, a hungry red glow pulsing from the veins.

name: Instinct: White
description: Preserve / Purify. When a Mutation deals damage, one ally within 30 feet gains temporary Hit Points equal to its Depth . A number of times per day equal to your highest Depth , end one condition on yourself or an ally as a free action. Your Instinct's damage type is vitality. Under Electrum Depth 3 this clause may be a second one, at half value.
icon_brief: A pale white carapace hand radiating clean light to a nearby ally, small chains of a condition snapping apart in the glow.

name: Additional Bond
description: Prerequisite: at least one Bond. You gain one additional Bond slot .
icon_brief: Three Substrate gems linked by glowing veins in a triangle, a fourth socket opening in the flesh beside them.

name: Apex Growth
description: Your Carapace Strike and Talons each gain one additional damage die .
icon_brief: A carapace fist and a talon hand both growing an extra row of serrated ridges, damage glyphs doubling on each.

name: Apex Predator
description: When you critically hit with a Mutation, that Substrate counts as Depth 4 for that Strike , whether or not it is at Depth 4. Does not stack with Gold's Instinct clause — take the better.
icon_brief: A predatory chitin jaw closing on prey at the moment of a critical hit, a gem in its brow flaring to maximum brightness.

name: Assimilate
description: Once per day, ◆◆◆ (10 minutes, over the remains of a creature of your level or lower) : gain one of its resistances, senses, or movement modes until your next daily preparations. Not its spells and not its Strikes.
icon_brief: A carapaced hand pressed onto the remains of a slain creature, a ribbon of the creature's essence — scales, eyes or wings — drawn up the arm into the plating.

name: Barbed Growth
description: A creature that critically fails a melee Strike against you takes damage equal to twice your highest Depth , of your Instinct's damage type.
icon_brief: Chitin covered in backward-pointing barbs, an enemy's sword shattering on them, the barbs dripping the Instinct's coloured energy.

name: Bonded Deep
description: One Bond you know functions with its Substrates at Depth 1 instead of Depth 2.
icon_brief: Two Substrate gems joined by a short, thick glowing vein that runs deep under the flesh, small but already bonded.

name: Burrower
description: Prerequisite: a metal Substrate at Depth 2 or higher. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet through earth, sand and loose stone.
icon_brief: Carapace-plated claws boring into earth, soil and stone flying, a tunnel spiral behind them, metallic grey sheen on the digging edges.

name: Chimeric Frame
description: You gain two of Nickel's Aberrations without binding Nickel, re-rolled or re-chosen at each daily preparations.
icon_brief: A carapace sprouting two mismatched aberrant parts at once — an extra eye and a fin, or a second arm — each flickering with nickel-silver light.

name: Consume the Fallen
description: ◆◆◆ (1 minute, over a corpse) : gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level , and until your next daily preparations one bound Substrate counts as one Depth higher (never above your cap). Once per day.
icon_brief: A dark maw of chitin opening over a corpse, the body dissolving into motes drawn in, a gem in the plate brightening as it feeds.

name: Deep Feeding
description: Once per day you may Feed as a 1-minute activity instead of 10 minutes. Useful exactly once per dungeon, and that once matters.
icon_brief: A symbiont mouth gulping a gem in one swallow, a tiny clock-face showing a single minute beside it.

name: Deep Vein
description: Prerequisite: a Substrate at your Depth cap. One Substrate of your choice may exceed your Depth cap by 1 , to a maximum of Depth 4. You still pay its Mass.
icon_brief: A single gem burning past its socket's rim, its vein plunging far deeper into the flesh than the others, overflowing light.

name: Devour
description: ◆ (Interact) Consume an object of light Bulk or less that you are holding. Gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level , lasting 1 minute. Once per 10 minutes. The object is gone; be careful whose it was.
icon_brief: A small object — a dagger or trinket — being swallowed whole by a mouth opening in a palm, a faint shield of temporary vitality rising.

name: Devouring Plate
description: When you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with a Carapace Strike, you may Feed on it as a free action: gain a temporary Substrate of any kind at Depth 2 until your next daily preparations, costing no Mass.
icon_brief: A carapace strike felling an enemy, the plate itself opening into a mouth that drinks the falling creature in, a new temporary gem forming.

name: Digest
description: Once per day, ◆◆◆ (1 minute) : reduce the stage of one affliction affecting you by 2 . The symbiont did not consult you about this.
icon_brief: A disease-coloured green-grey sickness swirling inside a translucent stomach-sac, being dissolved into harmless bubbles by the symbiont.

name: Eat the World
description: Once per day, ◆◆◆ (1 minute) : consume a magic item of level equal to or lower than your own. Until your next daily preparations you gain one of its abilities and 4 temporary Mass in either track. The item is destroyed and nobody is getting it back.
icon_brief: A glowing magic item — a wand or ring — cracking as a chitin maw devours it, its enchantment light streaming into the carapace.

name: Fifth Depth
description: One Substrate may reach Depth 5 , costing 5 Mass. Its Depth 4 rider applies twice where that is meaningful, and all of its numeric values increase by half again .
icon_brief: A gem embedded so deep that five concentric glowing rings surround it in the flesh, the outermost ring searing bright.

name: Grasping Plates
description: You grow a second Strike form. Talons — unarmed, 1d6 slashing , brawling group, traits agile, finesse, unarmed. You may use either it or your Carapace Strike freely.
icon_brief: A hand whose fingers have grown into long hooked chitin talons, sharp and agile, a fresh slash mark trailing behind.

name: Greater Bond
description: Choose one Bond you know. Its numeric values increase by half again , rounded up.
icon_brief: A Bond of linked gems whose connecting veins thicken and blaze half again as bright, the pattern enlarged.

name: Greater Mass Growth
description: Your Gem Mass and Metal Mass each increase by 2 .
icon_brief: Two inner reservoirs — one of gem-light, one of molten metal — both swelling larger inside a carapaced torso.

name: Instinct Fusion
description: Prerequisite: Two Instincts, or Electrum at Depth 3. Both of your Instinct clauses operate at full value . You are two organisms sharing a host and they do not always agree.
icon_brief: Two coloured symbiont instincts twisting together like a double helix inside one host, both at full brightness, faintly arguing in clashing colours.

name: Instinctive Surge
description: Free action , once per encounter: until the end of your turn, your Instinct clause treats every Substrate as one Depth higher .
icon_brief: Every gem on a carapace flaring one step brighter at once, a shockwave of instinct-coloured light rippling over the plates.

name: Iron Gullet
description: Your Metal Mass increases by 1 .
icon_brief: A heavy iron-lined gullet glowing dull red, metal shards sliding down it, space for one more.

name: Legendary Mass
description: Your Gem Mass and Metal Mass each increase by 3 .
icon_brief: A colossal inner reservoir of gems and metal spilling over, the carapace distended and radiant with stored material.

name: Living Fortress
description: If you did not move on your last turn, your Carapace's Hardness doubles until you do.
icon_brief: A carapace rooted into the ground with chitin anchors, its plates doubled and fused into a fortress-like shell, blows ringing off it.

name: Mass Growth
description: Your Gem Mass and Metal Mass each increase by 1 .
icon_brief: A small gem pouch and a small metal pouch inside living tissue each swelling slightly, a pair of plus signs.

name: Omnivore
description: You have two Instincts at full value , and your Gem Mass and Metal Mass merge into a single pool of their combined size. Gems and metals no longer compete for separate space — the distinction stops meaning anything to you.
icon_brief: Gems and metals pouring together into one shared glowing maw, their separate colours mixing into a single swirl.

name: Perfect Adaptation
description: You gain Moonstone's Reactive Evolution at Depth 2 without binding Moonstone. If you already hold Moonstone, treat it as one Depth higher for this Mutation only.
icon_brief: A moonstone-white carapace that changes colour wherever it is struck, every element washing off it harmlessly.

name: Perfect Organism
description: Every bound Substrate counts as being at your Depth cap , regardless of the Mass you actually paid for it. Mass now buys only breadth ; depth is free.
icon_brief: A complete carapace with every gem socket blazing at full depth, perfect symmetrical veining, an apex organism glow.

name: Plated Guard
description: ◆ You thicken. Gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. You cannot use Carapace Block while it lasts — the plate is busy.
icon_brief: Overlapping carapace plates thickening into a bulwark on the forearm, raised as a guard, the plates visibly layering.

name: Rampart
description: Once per round, when an adjacent ally takes physical damage, they gain resistance equal to half your Carapace's Hardness (maximum 5) against it.
icon_brief: A carapace arm extending a shell over an adjacent ally, the blow meant for them glancing off the shared plate.

name: Reach of the Thing
description: Free action , once per round, before a Strike: that Carapace Strike gains reach 10 feet . Something extends that was not there a moment ago.
icon_brief: An arm of jointed chitin unfolding an extra segment mid-strike, the fist suddenly reaching across the gap.

name: Regurgitate
description: Free action , once per day: Shed one Substrate and immediately Feed a Substrate you are carrying, at Depth 1. The whole thing takes no time and is extremely unpleasant to watch.
icon_brief: A gem being spat out of a gaping maw while another gem slides in to replace it, in one grotesque motion.

name: Second Hunger
description: Free action , once per encounter: gain 2 Mass in one track for 1 minute, which you must spend immediately to deepen a bound Substrate. When it ends, that Substrate returns to its real Depth.
icon_brief: A ravenous second mouth opening on the carapace, gulping borrowed glowing mass, a gem swelling briefly.

name: Second Stomach
description: Your Gem Mass increases by 1 .
icon_brief: A second translucent sac forming beside the first in a carapaced belly, small gems glittering inside.

name: Shared Symbiosis
description: Once per day, ◆◆ (touch) : a willing ally gains one of your Mutations at Depth 1 for 10 minutes. They also gain a small piece of the thing's opinions.
icon_brief: A carapaced hand on an ally's shoulder, a small tendril of chitin creeping onto them and blooming into a tiny mutation.

name: Shed Skin
description: 🜲 Reaction — Trigger: you gain a condition of value 2 or lower. Effect: end it. Your Carapace takes damage equal to five times the condition's value .
icon_brief: A sloughing layer of cracked carapace peeling away like a snakeskin, a condition's chains falling off with it.

name: Spit
description: ◆ A ranged unarmed Strike , range 20 feet, 1d6 damage of your Instinct's type. It uses your Carapace Strike's attack bonus and counts toward your multiple attack penalty.
icon_brief: A symbiont mouth spitting a glob of instinct-coloured fluid in an arc, splattering and sizzling on impact.

name: Sympathetic Growth
description: Once per day, ◆ (touch) : an ally gains one resistance you have, at half value , for 10 minutes. A piece of the thing goes with them, and it comes back.
icon_brief: A sprig of carapace growing from a fingertip onto an ally's arm, forming a small protective plate that pulses with the same colour.

name: Taste for It
description: You can identify any Substrate by touch. When you deal damage to a creature, you may Recall Knowledge about it as a free action once per encounter, with a +2 circumstance bonus .
icon_brief: A tendril-tongue licking a gem, a faint label of identification glowing above it, a drop of an enemy's blood on the tip.

name: The Thing That Wears You
description: Once per day, ◆◆◆: the Carapace separates for 1 minute. It acts on your initiative − 5 with your Strikes, your Mutations and your Assimilator DC, and it has your Hit Points as its own. While it is away you are unarmoured, unmutated, and a person again. You had forgotten.
icon_brief: An empty human shape stepping away from a hulking living carapace that now stands on its own, eyes lit, tendrils still linking them.

name: Total Assimilation
description: Prerequisite: Assimilate. One ability taken with Assimilate becomes permanent . You may replace it by using Assimilate on something better.
icon_brief: A trait taken from a fallen creature — a scale, eye or wing — fusing permanently into carapace plating, the seam sealing in glowing scar.

name: Twin Maw
description: ◆◆ Make two Carapace Strikes against the same creature. Both count toward your multiple attack penalty as normal, and if both hit, combine their damage before applying resistance .
icon_brief: Two carapace fists striking one target together, their two impacts merging into a single combined burst.

name: Two Instincts
description: You gain a second Instinct clause of your choice. Both operate at half value (round down, minimum 1). This does not stack with Electrum's Alloyed Instinct — take the better.
icon_brief: Two smaller coloured symbiont cores side by side in a carapace, each glowing at half strength.

name: Unbreakable Shell
description: Once per day, when your Carapace would be reduced below its Broken Threshold , it is instead reduced to exactly that threshold.
icon_brief: A carapace cracked right to the edge of shattering, a glowing line holding the fracture exactly at its limit.

name: Wall of Me
description: ◆◆, once per encounter. Extrude a 10-foot line of Carapace in your space or adjacent to it. It provides standard cover , has Hardness equal to your level and Hit Points equal to five times your level , and lasts 1 minute or until destroyed. While it stands, your own Carapace's Hardness is reduced by 2.
icon_brief: A line of living chitin wall erupting from the ground beside a carapaced figure, ridged and veined, blocking an incoming arrow.

name: The Assimilator: Handbook
description: Something alive is wearing you, and it grows by eating . Feed it a ruby and it learns to burn; feed it iron and the limbs get heavier; feed it nickel and neither of you knows what you will have on Tuesday. Your build is not a list of choices made at creation. It is a stomach, and its contents are visible on you. Mechanically: 10 Hit Points per level, expert in all three saves, unarmoured expert, unarmed attacks only — the Carapace Strike (1d8 bludgeoning) — and an Assimilator DC keyed to Strength or Dexterity. Constitution is your most important secondary attribute. The three things a new player should know Open the Gullet. Everything you have eaten, every choice it asks of you each morning, and the Feed and Shed buttons live in one window: the Open the Gullet macro, or the Feed and Shed actions on your sheet. Depth is the number that matters. Each Substrate's effect shows as a counter on its effect — that is its Depth, 1 to 4 — and every Mutation, Instinct and Bond reads it. The plate can break. Carapace Block turns physical damage with your Hardness and the plate pays for it. A broken Carapace switches off every Mutation at Depth 3 or higher until you mend it. You have two pools of Mass , Gem and Metal. A Substrate at Depth N costs N Mass in its own pool. Wide or deep is your call, asked once per pool. Level 1 3 5 8 11 14 17 20 Gem Mass 1 2 3 5 7 9 11 13 Metal Mass 1 1 2 4 5 7 8 10 Depth cap 1 1 2 2 3 3 4 4 Feed and Shed Feed (10 minutes) consumes a Substrate you are carrying — a specimen whose name is the Substrate's, like a looted ruby or a copper ingot — and raises that Substrate's Depth by 1 (a new one enters at Depth 1). The Gullet lists the specimens you carry for each. It is refused in an encounter. Depth 3–4 takes a quickened specimen , which only the GM can mark. Ordinary ones stop at Depth 2. The Vein : each time your Mass grows you get one free Substrate — the Gullet offers it as a source. Shed lowers or removes a Substrate, during daily preparations only. What you shed is destroyed. Every morning Rest for the Night opens daily preparations in the Gullet. That is when you Shed, break an Instinct tie, change a Bond, and make the day's choices your Substrates and feats ask for (Gold's pick, Electrum's second colour, Zinc's energy type, Nickel's Aberrations, and the rest). Finish preparing settles your Instinct. Carapace Strike — unarmed, 1d8 bludgeoning, brawling. Handwraps of Mighty Blows work normally; buy them. Living Plate — your armour, alive: explorer's clothing that takes armour runes. You cannot wear other armour. Hardness 2, plus the highest Hardness bonus among your Substrates (Adamant Shell makes them add), plus the Gray Instinct's. Hit Points 10 + 5 per level; Broken Threshold half of that. Carapace Block (reaction): against physical damage, reduce it by the plate's Hardness; the plate takes that much. Use the action on your sheet to arm it; it answers the next physical blow and is spent. Broken : every Mutation at Depth 3+ switches off, and its actions leave your sheet until the plate is mended. Mend it with the Repair activity, or an hour feeding it a Substrate you don't bind ( Mend in the Gullet). Your Instinct is the colour with the most total Mass, both pools together; ties are yours to break at daily preparations. Its clause applies to every Mutation you have, whatever its colour, and it sets your Instinct's damage type . It moves only at daily preparations (or the first time you bind anything). Instinct Type Clause Red Consume / Destroy fire When a Mutation deals damage, it deals +1 damage per Depth of its Substrate. Against a creature that has already lost Hit Points this encounter, double that bonus. Gold Amplify / Dominate force At daily preparations choose one bound Substrate; it counts as one Depth higher , never above your Depth cap. When you critically hit, that Substrate counts as Depth 4 for that Strike even if it isn't at Depth 4. Orange Move / React electricity The first time each round you Stride, Step or use a reaction, your next Mutation this round deals +1d4 of its own damage type. +5 feet Speed per bound Orange Substrate. Blue Adapt / Understand cold Study a creature (one action). Until the encounter ends, your Mutations treat its resistances as lower by twice your highest Depth , and you gain +1 circumstance to AC against it. One creature at a time. Purple Mutate / Transcend mental Your Mutations count as magical . At daily preparations one Substrate of your choice manifests one Depth higher , and one other, randomly determined, manifests one Depth lower . Green Grow / Reproduce poison When a Mutation deals damage, gain temporary Hit Points equal to its Depth . Fast healing equal to the number of bound Green Substrates. Black Consume / Corrupt void When a Mutation damages a creature, it takes a −1 status penalty to one check or DC of your choice until the end of its next turn, and you gain +1 status to the same thing . At Depth 3+ the penalty and bonus become −2 / +2 . White Preserve / Purify vitality When a Mutation deals damage, one ally within 30 feet gains temporary Hit Points equal to its Depth . A number of times per day equal to your highest Depth , end one condition on yourself or an ally as a free action. Gray Harden / Integrate bludgeoning Your Carapace's Hardness increases by the total Depth of your bound metals . When you use a Mutation, gain resistance equal to its Depth to all physical damage until the start of your next turn. Electrum at Depth 3 adds its second colour's clause beside yours, both at half value; at Depth 4 both at full. Two Instincts does the same at half — you get the better of the two, never both. Thirty-six Substrates, four per colour. Each is an effect whose counter is its Depth; its description lists what every Depth does. Their actions — Flare, Discharge, Shadow Step, Reactive Evolution — appear on your sheet when their Depth is reached. Colour Gems Metals Red Garnet, Ruby Copper, Iron Gold Citrine, Topaz Electrum, Gold Orange Amber, Carnelian Bronze, Mercury Blue Lapis Lazuli, Sapphire Cobalt, Tin Purple Amethyst, Quartz Nickel, Platinum Green Emerald, Jade Chromium, Zinc Black Jet, Onyx Lead, Manganese White Diamond, Pearl Aluminium, Magnesium Gray Hematite, Moonstone Silver, Steel Bonds A Bond needs both its Substrates at Depth 2 or higher and a Bond slot (the first at 4th, then 8th, 12th, 16th, 20th). Slot it in the Gullet; it changes only at daily preparations. If either Substrate drops below Depth 2 the Bond is suppressed, not lost, and comes back when you feed it again. Electrum at Depth 2 may stand in for either Substrate of one Bond you name. Bond Substrates Adamant Shell Diamond + Steel Ascension Platinum + Aluminium Blackfire Ruby + Onyx Blind Hunter Tin + Onyx Chimera Electrum + Nickel Chitin Bloom Emerald + Chromium Cleansing Light Pearl + Magnesium Cold Reading Sapphire + Lapis Lazuli Conduction Ruby + Copper Crowned Fortune Topaz + Citrine Exsanguinary Garnet + Jet Hammerform Bronze + Iron Immune System Jade + Zinc Impossible Body Diamond + Mercury Lightning Lash Copper + Cobalt Living Armour Hematite + Moonstone Living Flame Ruby + Emerald Mindstorm Amethyst + Quartz Molten Carapace Ruby + Iron Null Shroud Onyx + Lead Quicksilver Gait Carnelian + Mercury Reaper's Edge Silver + Jet Rime Flow Sapphire + Mercury Rot Jet + Manganese Runaway Growth Nickel + Emerald Second Heart Garnet + Emerald Siege Frame Iron + Steel Solar Core Ruby + Gold Storm Battery Amber + Cobalt Transmutation Gold + Electrum Almost everything the class does happens by itself. A few things ask you, and a few are left to the table on purpose. It happens by itself Every number: Mutations' damage and resistances, Instinct clauses, Bonds, Hardness, fast healing, Speeds. What a Mutation does when it deals damage, when you are hit, at the start of a turn, when you move — Red's bonus, Green's temporary Hit Points, Copper's arcs, Amber's charges, Manganese's corrosion, Molten Carapace's burn. Once-per-encounter and once-per-round limits: a spent action's card is refused with a notice. Areas: Flare, Null Field and the Healing Flare are emanations and need only a Confirm targets click. The Gland's cone and the Discharge's line are aimed: click where the area starts, point the way it faces, click again. It asks you Cards in chat with buttons: the Black Instinct's check or DC, the White Instinct's ally, Shed Skin, Devouring Plate, Cleansing Light when an ally holds several conditions. Pickers when you use an action: which condition Purify or Cleansing Tide ends, what Devour eats, what Assimilate takes, what Sympathetic Growth shares. Prompts for your choices at the moment they arise: Kinetic Spurs, Battle Frame, Living Armour's Reactive Evolution, Topaz's Depth 4 pick. It leaves to the table Movement it cannot see: teleporting between areas of darkness, hovering, moving through a creature's space, where the Wall of Me stands and the cover it gives. Notes shown on a roll that nothing enforces: a Mutation's situational bonus, a flat check an enemy owes. Rulings: what counts as a corpse or a quickened specimen, and "one of its abilities" from Eat the World. Substrates are your lever. The player's build is what they have eaten; what you put in the world decides what they can become. Ordinary specimens are shop goods and loot; quickened ones never are. Marking a quickened specimen. On the item, set the flag flags.isaacs-hb-pf2e.assimilator.specimen = { substrate: "<slug>", quickened: true } — for example { substrate: "ruby", quickened: true } . The Gullet then offers it for Depth 3–4. The Carapace breaking is a scene, not a punishment. A broken plate at 17th loses its Depth 4 riders; give the player a way to mend it that is worth an hour. Feeding happens in downtime. Feed is 10 minutes and is refused in an encounter. Rulings the module took , which you may overrule: Purple's raised Substrate may pass the Depth cap (never above 4); a lowered Depth 1 Substrate does not manifest that day; Mindstorm's stupefied lasts until the end of the creature's next turn; Moonstone's Reactive Evolution is the player's reaction to take.
icon_brief: A leather book whose cover is overgrown with living chitin and small embedded gems, a tendril curling out from between the pages.

name: Assimilator: Open the Gullet
description: Macro:
icon_brief: A carapaced gullet opening like a flower, gems and metal ingots arranged around it ready to be fed in.

name: Substrate: Jet
description: Essence: Death · Mutation: Carrion Bloom Fossilised organic matter — which is what the symbiont is doing to you, slowly. Depth 1 Your Strikes may deal void . +1 item bonus to saves against death effects. 2 +1d4 void. Gain 2 temporary Hit Points when you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points. 3 +1d6 void. A creature you kill cannot be returned to life by magic below 6th rank. 4 +1d6 void. Once per day, a creature within 30 feet at or below half Hit Points must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or take void damage equal to twice your level . Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A piece of black fossilised jet, with faint leaf-imprints of ancient organic life in it; a tendril creeping over it as death-grey void mist rises.

name: Substrate: Lead
description: Essence: Suppression · Mutation: Null Weight Heavy, dull, and magic stops working properly in the room. This is the anti-magic Substrate. Depth 1 +1 circumstance bonus to saves against magic. Divinations of 3rd rank or lower cannot locate you. 2 Once per round, when a Mutation damages a creature, it takes −1 status to its next save . 3 Creatures within 10 feet take −1 status to spell attack rolls and spell DCs . 4 Once per encounter, as a two-action activity, suppress magical effects in a 15-foot emanation for 1 round (counteract each; rank = half your level). Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A dull grey lead ingot, heavy and matte; floating spell runes around it dimming and sinking toward it.

name: Substrate: Manganese
description: Essence: Corrosion · Mutation: Rot Touch A dark violet-black bloom that leaves pitting on everything it has touched. Depth 1 Your Strikes deal 1 persistent acid on a critical hit. 2 A creature you damage has all its resistances reduced by 2 until the end of its next turn. 3 Reduced by 5 . Objects you Strike take a cumulative −1 item penalty (to a maximum of −3) until Repaired. 4 Reduced by 10 . A creature that ends its turn adjacent to you takes 1d6 persistent acid . Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A dark violet-black manganese crystal bloom, its surface pitted and corroded, acid droplets etching the stone it rests on.

name: Substrate: Onyx
description: Essence: Darkness · Mutation: Shadow Mantle The plate stops returning light. Edges become genuinely hard to locate. Depth 1 Darkvision. +1 item bonus to Stealth in dim light or darkness. 2 Once per day, create a 20-foot emanation of magical darkness for 1 minute. You see through it normally. 3 In dim light or darkness you may Hide and Sneak without cover or concealment , and gain +1 circumstance to AC. 4 Once per round, as a single action, teleport between two areas of darkness within 60 feet. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A polished black onyx stone that seems to swallow light; a carapace plate beside it turning edge-less and lightless.

name: Substrate: Cobalt
description: Essence: Energy / Conductivity · Mutation: Arcane Channel A lash of blue-white energy that is not attached to anything and comes back anyway. Depth 1 You gain a 30-foot ranged unarmed Strike dealing 1d6 damage of your Instinct's type. 2 Range 60 feet ; damage 2d6 . 3 Your Mutations' energy damage counts as magical ; +1 circumstance bonus to counteract checks. 4 Range 120 feet ; damage 4d6 ; once per round it may target two creatures. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A deep-blue cobalt nugget crackling with a lash of blue-white energy that arcs away and loops back to it.

name: Substrate: Lapis Lazuli
description: Essence: Knowledge · Mutation: Reading Eye A ring of small dark lenses around the skull, which track independently. Depth 1 Once per round, Recall Knowledge about a creature you can see as a free action. 2 When you succeed at Recall Knowledge about a creature, allies gain +1 circumstance to attacks against it for 1 round. 3 You automatically learn one resistance, weakness or immunity of any creature you damage. 4 Once per encounter, name a creature's strongest save ; for 1 minute your Mutations target its weakest instead. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A lapis lazuli stone flecked with gold, set in a ring of small dark lenses that each watch a different direction.

name: Substrate: Sapphire
description: Essence: Ice / Focus · Mutation: Glacial Lattice Faceted blue growth along the spine and jaw; the breath fogs indoors. Depth 1 Your Strikes may deal cold . +1 item bonus to saves against effects that would break your concentration. 2 +1d4 cold. Critical hits reduce the target's Speeds by 5 feet until the end of its next turn. 3 +1d6 cold. Critical hits make the target slowed 1 until the end of its next turn. 4 +1d6 cold. Any creature you damage with cold must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be slowed 1 until the end of its next turn. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A faceted blue sapphire, frost forming on its edges, faint icy breath-fog curling around it.

name: Substrate: Tin
description: Essence: Sensitivity · Mutation: Sensory Bloom Fine hairs, pits and antennae across the plate. It is deeply unsettling to watch them move. Depth 1 Imprecise tremorsense 30 feet. 2 You detect the presence of magic within 30 feet as an imprecise sense . 3 Tremorsense 60 feet . Invisible creatures within 30 feet are concealed to you rather than undetected. 4 Precise tremorsense 30 feet. You can track any creature that passed within 30 feet of you in the last 24 hours with a +2 circumstance bonus. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A tin ingot sprouting fine sensitive hairs and antennae that twitch and quiver, ripples of sensing spreading out.

name: Substrate: Citrine
description: Essence: Fortune · Mutation: Gilded Chance A faint gold shimmer that arrives half a second before anything good happens. Depth 1 Once per day, reroll one failed check and take the second result. 2 Twice per day. The reroll gains a +2 circumstance bonus . 3 Once per encounter, when an enemy within 30 feet critically succeeds at a save against you, it gets a success instead. 4 Once per day, after seeing the result, change one d20 roll made within 30 feet by 5 in either direction — yours, an ally's, or an enemy's. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A bright yellow citrine crystal with a gold shimmer flashing around it just before a falling coin lands lucky side up.

name: Substrate: Electrum
description: Essence: Resonance · Mutation: Alloyed Instinct Two metals that never fully mixed, and a symbiont that never fully decided. Depth 1 Choose a second colour. Electrum also counts as a Substrate of that colour for any effect that counts your bound Substrates of a colour; its Mass still counts toward Gold. 2 Electrum may stand in for either Substrate of any one Bond you know. 3 You gain your second colour's Instinct clause as well — but both clauses operate at half value (round down, minimum 1). 4 Both Instinct clauses operate at full value . Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: An electrum nugget of two metals swirling but not fully mixed — pale gold and silver — two instinct colours flickering in it.

name: Substrate: Gold
description: Essence: Amplification · Mutation: Gilded Core Everything already there gets brighter and slower and more certain of itself. Depth 1 At daily preparations, choose one other bound Substrate. It counts as one Depth higher . This can never exceed your level's Depth cap. 2 You may choose the Substrate again at the start of each encounter, instead of only at daily preparations. 3 Choose two Substrates instead of one. 4 Once per day, as a free action, one chosen Substrate manifests at Depth 4 for 1 minute regardless of its real Depth. Apotheosis. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A gold nugget glowing warm, every other gem placed near it brightening and swelling.

name: Substrate: Topaz
description: Essence: Power · Mutation: Regal Aspect The plate thickens into something ceremonial. It looks worn rather than grown. Depth 1 +1 item bonus to Intimidation. Your critical hits deal +2 damage . 2 Your unarmed Strikes gain the critical specialization effect of the brawling group. 3 A creature you critically hit is frightened 1 . 4 When you critically hit, one other bound Substrate counts as Depth 4 for that Strike , whether or not it is at Depth 4. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A deep amber-orange topaz set like a royal jewel in ceremonial carapace plating, regal and heavy.

name: Substrate: Hematite
description: Essence: Blood / Iron · Mutation: Ferrous Blood Iron-grey, blood-red when scratched. The bridge between Red, Green and Gray. Depth 1 +1 item bonus to Athletics. You are immune to persistent bleed . 2 Gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level at the start of each encounter. 3 +2 status bonus to Fortitude saves. You cannot be drained . 4 Once per day, when you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, immediately stand with Hit Points equal to your level . Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A metallic iron-grey hematite stone, a scratch across it bleeding blood-red streak.

name: Substrate: Moonstone
description: Essence: Adaptation · Mutation: Reactive Evolution Pale, and the sheen inside moves to whichever side was last struck. Depth 1 Once per encounter, as a reaction after taking damage of a type, gain resistance 2 to that type for 1 minute. 2 Resistance 5 , twice per encounter. 3 Resistance 8 , it lasts until the encounter ends, and you may hold two types at once. 4 Resistance 12 , unlimited uses, three types at once. The first time each encounter you would take damage of a type you already resist, you take none . Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A pale moonstone with an inner blue sheen sliding to one side, as if toward where it was just struck.

name: Substrate: Silver
description: Essence: Suppression / Supernatural Integration · Mutation: Argent Edge White is purity. Gray is the thing you actually use on a werewolf. Depth 1 Your Strikes count as silver . 2 +1d4 damage against aberrations, fiends, undead and spirits. 3 +1d6 instead. Your Strikes affect incorporeal creatures as though they had the ghost touch rune. 4 +1d6. A supernatural creature you critically hit cannot use reactions or innate spells until the end of its next turn. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A gleaming silver ingot with a crescent-moon glint, a faint wolf's claw mark repelled from it.

name: Substrate: Steel
description: Essence: Structure · Mutation: True Plate Straightforward. Nothing about this is strange and that is its whole appeal. Depth 1 Carapace Hardness +2 . Your unarmed Strikes' damage die increases one step. 2 Hardness +5. 3 Hardness +8. Your unarmed Strikes gain the versatile P and versatile S traits. 4 Hardness +12. +1 damage die on your unarmed Strikes. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A plain, solid steel bar, perfectly straight and polished; carapace plates beside it hardened and riveted.

name: Substrate: Chromium
description: Essence: Armour / Regeneration · Mutation: Lacquer Shell A hard, bright, corrosion-proof lacquer over everything. It buffs out. Depth 1 Carapace Hardness +2 . Resistance 2 to acid. 2 Hardness +5 , resistance 5 to acid. Your Carapace repairs 1 Hit Point per hour on its own. 3 Hardness +8 , resistance 8 to acid. You are immune to rust, corrosion and effects that damage your items with acid. 4 Hardness +12 , resistance 12 to acid. Once per encounter, when your Carapace's Hardness would be reduced or bypassed, it isn't. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A brilliant chrome nugget with a mirror-bright lacquer finish, acid droplets beading and rolling off it.

name: Substrate: Emerald
description: Essence: Regeneration · Mutation: Knitting Flesh Open seams that close while you watch, leaving pale green scar tissue that also closes. Depth 1 Fast healing 1 while you have at least 1 Hit Point and are below your maximum. 2 Fast healing 2. Once per day, regrow a severed part over 1 hour. 3 Fast healing 5. You stabilize automatically when dying. 4 Fast healing 10. Once per day, when reduced to 0 Hit Points, be reduced to 1 instead and gain fast healing 15 for 1 minute. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A green emerald with a fleshy seam across it closing while you watch, pale green scar tissue knitting over.

name: Substrate: Jade
description: Essence: Vitality · Mutation: Deep Root Dense, cool, and very slightly translucent. It is thicker over the organs. Depth 1 +1 item bonus to Fortitude saves. 2 Resistance 5 to poison. You are immune to disease. 3 Once per day, when you roll a success on a Fortitude save, get a critical success instead. 4 Once per round instead of once per day. You cannot be drained or enfeebled . Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A dense, cool, slightly translucent green jade piece shaped like a protective plate over a heart.

name: Substrate: Zinc
description: Essence: Biological Adaptation · Mutation: Shifting Tissue The surface changes texture depending on what last hurt it, and does not change back. Depth 1 At daily preparations, choose one energy damage type. Gain resistance 2 to it. 2 Resistance 5. Change the chosen type as a single action, once per day. 3 Resistance 8. Once per round, as a reaction when you take energy damage, change the chosen type to that type — after learning the type, before damage applies. 4 Resistance 12. The reaction is unlimited, and you keep resistance to the previously chosen type as well. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A dull zinc ingot whose surface has changed texture in patches — scorched, frosted, sparking — each mark of what hit it.

name: Substrate: Amber
description: Essence: Stored Energy · Mutation: Reservoir A translucent sac at the sternum that fills visibly and drains visibly. Depth 1 When you take energy damage, store 1 charge (max 3). Spend 1 as a free action to add 1d4 of that type to a Strike. 2 Max 5 charges . Spending 2 adds 1d6 + 2 instead. 3 You also store a charge whenever you deal energy damage, once per round. 4 Spend 3 charges as a two-action activity: a 30-foot line , 6d6 of the stored type, basic Reflex against your class DC. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A translucent honey-amber sac-like gem, energy visibly filling it from the bottom like a gauge.

name: Substrate: Bronze
description: Essence: Momentum / Combat · Mutation: Battle Frame Utilitarian, scarred, and it keeps re-forming the parts that break. Depth 1 You are trained in improvised weapons as martial weapons, and take no penalty for using them. 2 If you Stride at least 10 feet, your next Strike this turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to hit . 3 Once per round, make a Strike and then a Shove, Trip or Grapple as a single action . 4 On a critical hit, immediately Stride up to half your Speed toward a different enemy as a free action. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A battered bronze ingot with scars and nicks, a broken piece re-forming itself, an improvised weapon beside it.

name: Substrate: Carnelian
description: Essence: Momentum · Mutation: Kinetic Spurs Spurs and vanes that unfold backward when you run and fold flat when you stop. Depth 1 +5 feet Speed. 2 If you moved at least 10 feet this turn before attacking, your Strike deals +1d4 . 3 +10 feet Speed , and the bonus becomes +1d6 . 4 Once per round, after a Strike, Stride up to half your Speed as a free action. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A red-orange carnelian stone with spurs and vanes fanning backward from it as if in a strong wind.

name: Substrate: Mercury
description: Essence: Fluidity · Mutation: Liquid Form Silver liquid moving constantly beneath translucent skin. The limbs are not fixed in number. Depth 1 You Squeeze at full Speed and are not off-guard while squeezing. 2 Resistance 5 to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. 3 Once per round, as a reaction when you are hit, reduce the damage by your level as the blow passes through you. 4 You move through gaps as small as an inch. Once per day, become amorphous for 1 minute: immune to precision damage, and critical hits against you deal normal damage. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A pool of quicksilver shifting and splitting into several moving limbs, beneath a translucent membrane.

name: Substrate: Amethyst
description: Essence: Psychic · Mutation: Thought-Spines Violet spines across the crown, and other people's dreams start including you. Depth 1 Telepathy 30 feet with willing creatures with whom you share a language. 2 Your Strikes may deal mental ; +1d4 mental . 3 +1d6 mental. On a critical hit the target is stupefied 1 until the end of its next turn. 4 +1d6 mental. Once per round, a creature you damage must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or be confused until the end of its next turn. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A violet amethyst geode bristling with crystal spines, faint dream-wisps drifting out of it.

name: Substrate: Nickel
description: Essence: Mutation · Mutation: Unstable Growth You do not know what it will be tomorrow. Neither does it. Depth 1 At daily preparations, gain one Aberration — roll or choose: (1) A limb , (2) An organ , (3) A mode , (4) A plate , (5) A gland , (6) A maw . One Aberration. 2 Two Aberrations. 3 Once per encounter, as a single action, re-roll all your Aberrations . 4 Three Aberrations, and one of them may instead be one other bound Purple Substrate counting as Depth 4 . Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A nickel nugget sprouting an unpredictable growth — a tiny eye, limb or fin — with a question mark of light.

name: Substrate: Platinum
description: Essence: Transcendence · Mutation: Ascendant Plate It stops being a colour and starts being a quality of light. Extremely rare. Depth 1 +1 circumstance bonus to saves against magic. 2 Resistance 5 to your Instinct's damage type. You no longer need to breathe. 3 Once per day, gain a fly Speed equal to half your land Speed for 1 minute. 4 Permanent fly Speed equal to your land Speed . You cannot be slowed by magical effects. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A platinum ingot dissolving into a quality of pure white-silver light rather than a colour, a halo rising off it.

name: Substrate: Quartz
description: Essence: Arcane Resonance · Mutation: Prism Node Clear prisms growing through the plate at angles that don't match the body underneath. Depth 1 +1 circumstance bonus to saves against magic, and you know when a spell is cast within 30 feet. 2 Once per day, counteract one magical effect (counteract rank = half your level; modifier = your class DC − 10). 3 When you counteract an effect, or a spell fails against you, your next Strike deals +2d6 force . 4 Twice per day counteract. Once per day, reflect a spell that targets only you back at its caster (Will save against your class DC negates). Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A cluster of clear quartz prisms jutting at odd angles, splitting a beam of magic into a rainbow.

name: Substrate: Copper
description: Essence: Heat / Conduction · Mutation: Conductive Filament Copper filaments running everywhere under the plate, visibly glowing when it works. Depth 1 When a Mutation of yours deals energy damage, the target takes 1 more of that type at the start of its next turn. 2 When you take fire or electricity damage, your next Strike before the end of your next turn deals +1d4 of that type. 3 Energy damage from your Mutations conducts : one creature adjacent to the target takes 2 of that type. 4 The conduction becomes half the energy damage, and reaches any creature touching the same metal object, water, or surface as the target. Depth is this effect's badge. Depth 3 and 4 switch off while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A coil of copper filament glowing orange-red with conducted heat, energy running along the wire.

name: Substrate: Garnet
description: Essence: Blood · Mutation: Crimson Tendrils Pulsating crimson flesh; blood-like tendrils that reach toward open wounds. Depth 1 Your Strikes deal 1 persistent bleed on a critical hit. You may Treat Wounds on yourself. 2 +1d4 damage against any creature that has already lost Hit Points this encounter. Critical hits deal 1d6 persistent bleed . 3 At the start of your turn, gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level if any creature within 30 feet is taking persistent bleed. 4 Creatures taking persistent bleed from you take +2 damage per weapon damage die from your Strikes. Once per day, drain a dying creature within 30 feet: it dies, you regain Hit Points equal to your level. Depth is this effect's badge. Depth 3 and 4 switch off while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A deep red garnet pulsing like a heart, crimson tendrils reaching from it toward a fresh wound.

name: Substrate: Iron
description: Essence: Brutality · Mutation: Dense Frame Black-red plates growing up through the skin; the limbs get heavier and longer. Depth 1 +1 item bonus to Athletics. Your unarmed Strikes deal +1 bludgeoning . 2 +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Shove, Trip or Grapple a creature you have already damaged this encounter. 3 Your unarmed Strikes gain the shove trait, and forced movement you cause increases by 5 feet . 4 +1 damage die on your unarmed Strikes. A creature you Shove into a wall, hazard or another creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to your level. Depth is this effect's badge. Depth 3 and 4 switch off while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A heavy black-red iron chunk with blocky plates growing out of it, long and brutal.

name: Substrate: Ruby
description: Essence: Flame · Mutation: Furnace Veins Glowing red veins; cracks of internal fire that open wider as the fight goes on. Depth 1 Your Carapace Strikes may deal fire instead of their normal damage type. You shed dim light in a 10-foot radius and cannot suppress it. 2 +1d4 fire. On a critical hit, 1d4 persistent fire . 3 +1d6 fire. Fire damage you deal treats fire resistance as 5 lower . 4 +1d6 fire. On a critical hit, 2d10 persistent fire , and the target's space burns — a creature ending its turn there takes 1d6 fire. Depth is this effect's badge. Depth 3 and 4 switch off while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A blood-red ruby cracked with glowing internal fire, flames licking from the fissures.

name: Substrate: Aluminium
description: Essence: Lightness · Mutation: Hollow Frame Almost nothing. The plate is there and it weighs less than the clothes underneath. Depth 1 Your Carapace has no Bulk and imposes no penalties. +5 feet Speed . 2 +10 feet Speed. You take no damage from falls of less than 30 feet. 3 You Leap twice as far. Once per day, Fly 30 feet as a single action. 4 Permanent fly Speed 20 feet . You may end your turn in midair without falling. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A feather-light aluminium shard floating above an open palm, weightless, airy blue-white.

name: Substrate: Diamond
description: Essence: Hardness · Mutation: Adamant Skin Colourless, flawless, and it does not deform. Neither do you, now. Depth 1 Carapace Hardness +2 . 2 Hardness +5. Reduce persistent damage you take by 2. 3 Hardness +8. Once per encounter, a critical hit against you deals normal damage instead. 4 Hardness +12. Once per round instead of once per encounter. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A colourless, flawless diamond, a hammer cracking on it instead, unchanged.

name: Substrate: Magnesium
description: Essence: Radiance · Mutation: Flare Core It burns white and it does not care what it is burning. Depth 1 You shed bright light in a 20-foot radius at will. +1 item bonus to saves against blindness and dazzle. 2 Once per encounter, as a single action: creatures in a 15-foot emanation must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be dazzled for 1 round. 3 On a failed save they are blinded for 1 round instead. The flare deals fire damage equal to your level to creatures with light sensitivity or light blindness. 4 The emanation becomes 30 feet and counteracts magical darkness . Once per day, it instead heals each ally within it for your level. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A strip of magnesium burning with blinding white flame, sparks and harsh light.

name: Substrate: Pearl
description: Essence: Purification · Mutation: Clear Tide Layers, laid down over an irritant. You are the irritant. Depth 1 +1 item bonus to saves against poison and disease. Once per day, reduce one condition's value by 1. 2 Once per encounter, as a single action, end one condition of value 1 on yourself or an adjacent ally. 3 Range 30 feet , and it may instead reduce one affliction's stage by 1. 4 Twice per encounter, and it may instead counteract one spell effect of 4th rank or lower. Depth is this effect's badge. The whole Mutation switches off at Depth 3+ while the Carapace is broken.
icon_brief: A pearl in cross-section showing nacre layers around a dark irritant grain, a faint cleansing glow.

name: Alms of Fate
description: On each target's next damaging effect before the end of your next turn, they reroll all 1s and 2s on the damage dice and must keep the new results. Heightened (5th) 3 allies. (9th) Each target also maximises one damage die of their choice. The next damage roll each target makes is rewritten as it lands; at 9th the die with the most to gain is maximised.
icon_brief: A pair of silver dice tumbling from a starlit hand, their 1 and 2 faces dissolving into stardust and reforming as higher numbers mid-air; indigo sky behind.

name: Borrowed Second
description: Each target immediately Steps or Strides up to its Speed as a free action and gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. Heightened (5th) 3 targets. (9th) 5 targets.
icon_brief: A pocket watch with its second hand torn free and glowing, a silver footprint stepping out of the dial, a faint ghostly shield shimmering beside it.

name: Coiling Doubt
description: Critical Success Unaffected. Success The next attack roll or skill check the target attempts is rolled twice, taking the lower. Failure As success, but the first attack roll or skill check each round for 3 rounds . Critical Failure As failure for 1 minute , and the target is stupefied 2 for the same minute.
icon_brief: A dark violet thread coiling like a serpent around a falling d20, two dim die faces shown side by side with the lower one lit, a sour green-purple haze.

name: Crown of Fire
description: +2 status bonus to Intimidation and Performance. Each target can Demoralize at 60 feet with no auditory or visual requirement and no penalty for a shared-language failure. Once per round, when a target critically succeeds at any check, one ally within 30 feet of it gains a +1 status bonus to their next roll. Heightened (+2) +1 ally.
icon_brief: A crown of burning stars hovering over an empty space, its flames shaped like shouting mouths, rays of orange-gold light thrown outward across a midnight sky.

name: Death Foretold
description: You show each of them the hour of its own death, in detail, with the date. Critical Success Unaffected. Success Frightened 1. Failure Frightened 2. Critical Failure Frightened 3, stunned 1 , and fleeing for 1 round. Heightened (4th) A creature that fails also takes 2d6 mental damage , doubled on a critical failure. (+2) +2d6.
icon_brief: A tarnished calendar page torn from the sky, a single date circled in blood-red light, a black hourglass with its last grain falling behind it.

name: Deep Dream
description: +2 status bonus to Will saves and to Perception checks to disbelieve illusions. Once during the duration, a critical failure on a Will save becomes a failure. While the Augury lasts, a target is never off-guard merely for being unaware of a creature at the start of an encounter. Heightened (+2) +1 ally.
icon_brief: A closed eye drifting in a deep indigo nebula, a crescent moon cradling it, ripples of pale dream-light peeling away a thin illusory veil.

name: First Blood
description: Cast during exploration. The next time each rolls initiative within the hour, it gains a +2 status bonus to that roll, is not off-guard during the first round, and its first Strike of the encounter that hits deals an extra 1d6 spirit damage . Heightened (+2) +1d6.
icon_brief: A red star rising over a dawn horizon, a single drop of glowing blood falling from it, a racing silver arrow marking the first move of a fight.

name: Fixed Point
description: Name attack rolls, saving throws, or skill checks. Until the end of your next turn, the first roll of that type made by each chosen creature is treated as a 10 on the die, before modifiers. Heightened (6th) Name two roll types. After you cast it, you are asked which roll types to name.
icon_brief: A d20 pinned in place by a silver nail of starlight, frozen showing a glowing 10, hourglass sand stopped mid-fall around it.

name: Guiding Star
description: Each target gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, Perception checks and skill checks . Heightened (4th) 3 allies. (7th) 4 allies. (10th) 5 allies, and the bonus is +2 .
icon_brief: A single bright five-pointed star above a dark landscape, its long silver ray pointing down a path like a compass needle, small stars aligning along the beam.

name: Hunted by the Sky
description: The target cannot be concealed or hidden from you. You and your allies gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Seek and to Perception checks to find it, and the first attack made against it each round gains a +1 circumstance bonus. Your Snarl against it is −3 , or −4 once you have Surer Thread . Heightened (6th) 2 creatures.
icon_brief: A constellation shaped like an open eye locked onto a lone fleeing silhouette, cold starbeams spotlighting it so no shadow can hide it.

name: Iron Auspice
description: +2 status bonus to Fortitude saves, to Athletics checks to Shove, Trip and Grapple, and to checks to resist forced movement. Each target gains temporary Hit Points equal to three times your level , and once during the duration treats a critical failure on a Fortitude save as a failure. Heightened (+2) +1 ally.
icon_brief: An iron-grey astrological sigil forged like an anvil-shaped shield, stars hammered into its surface as rivets, sparks flying off it.

name: Perfect Ledger
description: Each target's next Recall Knowledge before the end of your next turn is a free action , gains a +2 circumstance bonus, and on a success reveals one additional piece of information. On a critical success it also reveals the creature's lowest saving throw and all of its weaknesses . Heightened (5th) Every Recall Knowledge each target makes until the end of your next turn is a free action.
icon_brief: An open ledger book on which a creature's silhouette is written out in glowing silver ink, its weak points marked with small red stars.

name: Poured Knowing
description: +2 status bonus to Arcana, Nature, Occultism, Religion and Society. Each target's counteract checks during the duration use your Stargazer DC and proficiency rank if higher than their own, and count their counteract rank as 1 higher . Heightened (+2) +1 ally.
icon_brief: A crystal ewer tipped from the sky, pouring a stream of liquid starlight full of tiny glyphs and runes into an open waiting cup.

name: Shell of Hours
description: Each regains 2d8 Hit Points immediately and gains a +2 status bonus to saves against disease and poison and to recovery checks. Once during the duration, the first time a target would be reduced to 0 Hit Points it is reduced to 1 Hit Point instead and the Augury ends for that target. Heightened (+2) +2d8 and +1 ally.
icon_brief: A translucent eggshell made of interlocking clock faces enclosing a glowing heart, a crack in one face sealing itself with golden light.

name: The Hour Is Not Come
description: Trigger You or an ally within 30 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Effect It was not going to happen today. The target is reduced to 1 Hit Point instead, gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level , and does not gain the wounded condition from this instance. A creature cannot benefit from this Augury again for 10 minutes. Heightened (5th) The target also regains 2d8 Hit Points. (+2) +2d8. When it triggers, a button appears in your whispers; it spends the Focus Point and the reaction.
icon_brief: A clock hand stopped a hair before midnight, held back by a silver thread pulled taut; a falling figure's shadow caught mid-drop beneath it.

name: Two Roads
