description: Before the end of your next turn, the first skill check each attempts is rolled twice ; each takes the higher result. Heightened (5th) 3 allies, and it applies to saving throws as well. (9th) 4 allies.
icon_brief: A path forking into two starlit roads under a night sky, a d20 hovering at the fork showing two results, the brighter road glowing.

name: Stargazer
description: You have already seen how this ends. Every morning you read the sky — which of thirteen signs is up, and whether it is kind — and every round you bend somebody else's luck by a little: a Guide for an ally's roll, a Snarl for an enemy's. You cannot fight, and you do not need to. Key attribute Wisdom · Hit Points 8 + Constitution modifier per level · Stargazer DC your focus spells and class features, Wisdom-keyed
icon_brief: A brass astrolabe framed against a deep indigo night sky, a single silver thread spooling from its center to a distant star, thirteen faint sigils circling the rim.

name: Chart the Course
description: Name one creature within 60 feet that you can see — two creatures from 11th level . Until the start of your next turn, the first time a named creature rolls a d20, you may use Fortune's Thread on that roll without spending your reaction . If you named two creatures you may do this once for each of them. You can have only one Chart the Course active at a time. Target the creatures and use this: you choose Guide or Snarl for each now, and it lands on that creature's first d20 — no reaction.
icon_brief: A star chart unrolled with a glowing dotted line drawn between two marked stars, a silver compass pinning one point, a target ring around the other.

name: Fortune's Thread
description: Trigger A creature within 30 feet that you can see is about to roll an attack roll, a saving throw, a skill check, or a Perception check. Effect Choose one: Guide — the triggering creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus to the roll. Snarl — the triggering creature takes a −1 circumstance penalty to the roll. Snarl can only be applied to an attack roll, skill check, or Perception check, never a saving throw. At 9th level ( Surer Thread ) the bonus and penalty increase to ±2 . Target the creatures, then use this from your sheet: you pick Guide or Snarl for each, and the GM's client arms it on them. It is spent by the first matching roll; your reaction goes then.
icon_brief: Two threads crossing between a pair of fingers: a gold thread pulled upward bright, a violet thread snagged downward, a d20 hanging where they cross.

name: Portent
description: When you complete a Night Vigil, roll a d20 and record the result. This is your Portent , and you know its value. Speak the Portent [free-action] (prediction) Frequency once per day Trigger A creature within 60 feet that you can see is about to roll a d20 for an attack roll, a saving throw, or a skill check. Effect The creature does not roll. Its d20 result is your recorded Portent, and the roll resolves normally from there. The Portent is spent. A Portent of 20 counts as a natural 20 and a Portent of 1 as a natural 1, because it was one — you rolled it at dawn. Speak the Portent cannot be used on a roll already altered by a fortune or misfortune effect, and does not itself have those traits. A new Night Vigil overwrites an unspent Portent. Target one creature and use this to speak it over that creature's next attack roll, saving throw or skill check.
icon_brief: A d20 sealed inside a crystal orb at dawn, its rolled number glowing faintly through the glass, a night-vigil candle burned low beside it.

name: Rewrite the Ending
description: Frequency once per week Trigger You or an ally within 60 feet dies, or the party is defeated or captured. Effect Time unwinds to the moment initiative was rolled for this encounter. All damage, conditions, deaths, expended spells, expended items and expended resources since that moment are restored, for every creature. The encounter has not happened. You alone remember it. As part of this free action you may share what you saw: each ally who was in the erased timeline gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their initiative roll and to their first d20 roll of the re-run encounter, and the party has full knowledge of everything it learned — tactics, resistances, the ambush, the trap in the floor. The cost. Your Star Chart goes dark. You are drained 2 and doomed 1 , and you lose Night Vigil, Fortune's Thread, Chart the Course, Portent, and all Auguries and Focus Points, until you complete a full 8-hour Night Vigil under open sky . Neither condition can be reduced before then by any means. You cannot use Rewrite the Ending again for 7 days regardless. Post this to chat to invoke it; the GM confirms. The board goes back to when initiative was rolled, and initiative is rolled again.
icon_brief: A great hourglass shattered and reassembling itself in reverse, sand flowing upward, fallen swords and a broken shield rising back into place around it.

name: The Last Thing You See
description: Trigger A creature within 30 feet that you can see deals damage to you. Effect You show it the hour of its own death — not a threat, a date . It attempts a Will save against your Stargazer DC. Critical Success It is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 10 minutes. Success Frightened 1. Failure Frightened 2. Critical Failure Frightened 3 and stunned 1 . When something within 30 feet hurts you, a button appears in your whispers.
icon_brief: A staring teal eye whose pupil holds a tiny skull and a written date; a crack of cold light shooting back toward an attacking claw.

name: Unmake the Moment
description: Frequency once per day (recharges on your next Night Vigil) Trigger Your turn begins. Effect Time rewinds to the start of your last turn . Everything done since then by every creature is undone: damage dealt, conditions applied, spells cast, movement made, resources spent, reactions used. Creatures reduced to 0 Hit Points return to the Hit Points they had. Everyone except you loses all memory of the unwound round. You keep it, and you may spend 1 action on your turn to shout a warning, granting one ally a +2 circumstance bonus to their next roll this round. You are stunned 1 and drained 1 when the loop resolves. Initiative order does not change. Enemies act again as the GM chooses — they are not obliged to repeat what they did, and they do not remember it either. When your turn begins, a card in your whispers offers the rewind. The board, every combatant and the turn go back to the start of your last turn; the chat log stays.
icon_brief: A clock face with its hands spinning backward, a faint afterimage of the last few seconds peeling off it like a ghost layer, silver motion trails.

name: Armor Expertise
description: Your proficiency ranks for unarmored defense and light armor increase to expert.
icon_brief: A padded leather jerkin embroidered with silver constellations, a star-shaped clasp at the collar, glints of reinforcement.

name: Astronomy Lore
description: Celestial events, calendars, navigation by star, prophecy, and — at the GM's discretion — Recall Knowledge about anything that has been foretold .
icon_brief: An open almanac with a moon-phase calendar, a quill resting across it, small stars lifting off the page like dust.

name: Astronomy Lore (15th)
description: Your proficiency rank in Astronomy Lore increases to legendary , and you gain an extra skill feat, which must apply to Astronomy Lore or Occultism.
icon_brief: A complete orrery of every planet, spinning in perfect harmony, a laurel wreath of stars encircling it — mastery of all skies.

name: Astronomy Lore (3rd)
description: Astronomy Lore is your core skill. Your proficiency rank in it increases to expert , and you gain an extra skill feat, which must apply to Astronomy Lore or Occultism.
icon_brief: A single brass telescope pointed at a cluster of stars, one star circled in chalk, a small notebook of notes beneath.

name: Astronomy Lore (7th)
description: Your proficiency rank in Astronomy Lore increases to master , and you gain an extra skill feat, which must apply to Astronomy Lore or Occultism.
icon_brief: Three nested celestial rings of an armillary sphere, brass and silver, aligned around a glowing center, notes fluttering around.

name: Augury (11th)
description: You learn one Augury of your choice. You know nine permanently by 19th level — at 1st, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 13th, 15th, 17th and 19th.
icon_brief: A star-chart card with eleven pinholes of light, the eleventh newly kindled, a silver hand placing it in a fanned deck of sky cards.

name: Augury (13th)
description: You learn one Augury of your choice. You know nine permanently by 19th level — at 1st, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 13th, 15th, 17th and 19th.
icon_brief: A ring of thirteen candles in an occult circle, the thirteenth just lit with indigo flame, an augury sigil forming in its smoke.

name: Augury (15th)
description: You learn one Augury of your choice. You know nine permanently by 19th level — at 1st, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 13th, 15th, 17th and 19th.
icon_brief: A tarot-like card bearing a new constellation drawn in fresh silver ink, fifteen faint stars along its border, glowing at the edges.

name: Augury (17th)
description: You learn one Augury of your choice. You know nine permanently by 19th level — at 1st, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 13th, 15th, 17th and 19th.
icon_brief: An open scroll unrolling into the night sky, a new glyph written in starlight at its end, seventeen small marks along its margin.

name: Augury (19th)
description: You learn one Augury of your choice. You know nine permanently by 19th level — at 1st, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 13th, 15th, 17th and 19th.
icon_brief: A full circle of nine augury sigils around a central eye, every one glowing, the last one at the top blazing white.

name: Augury (1st)
description: You learn one Augury of your choice. You know nine permanently by 19th level — at 1st, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 13th, 15th, 17th and 19th.
icon_brief: A single glowing sigil drawn on a blank star map, a hand's fingertip still trailing silver light from the stroke.

name: Augury (5th)
description: You learn one Augury of your choice. You know nine permanently by 19th level — at 1st, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 13th, 15th, 17th and 19th.
icon_brief: Two augury sigils on a star map linked by a fine thread, the second just ignited, small sparks scattering.

name: Augury (7th)
description: You learn one Augury of your choice. You know nine permanently by 19th level — at 1st, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 13th, 15th, 17th and 19th.
icon_brief: Three augury sigils in a triangle on dark parchment, connected by silver lines, the newest pulsing indigo.

name: Augury (9th)
description: You learn one Augury of your choice. You know nine permanently by 19th level — at 1st, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 13th, 15th, 17th and 19th.
icon_brief: Four augury sigils arranged like compass points around a small astrolabe, the fourth catching light.

name: Constellation Mastery
description: You no longer read the sky. You argue with it. Trade the Day. During your Night Vigil you may swap today’s aspect with the aspect of any of the next three days in your forecast. The two days exchange aspects; the signs do not move. The day you traded away is still coming. A scheduled Zenith cannot move. Forewarned becomes Foreordained. You and the allies you brief treat a negative aspect as Benefic instead of merely reducing it. Exalted and Benefic days are unchanged. Starless. On a Starless sky you may choose any sign’s Augury as your Augury of the Day.
icon_brief: Two calendar tiles being swapped by a hand in the sky, each bearing a different sign's aspect glyph, a forecast row of days stretching away.

name: Expert Stargazer
description: Your proficiency rank for your Stargazer DC increases to expert.
icon_brief: A silver star with a single banded ring around it, tiny compass marks along the ring, glowing over an indigo field.

name: Great Fortitude
description: Your proficiency rank for Fortitude saves increases to expert.
icon_brief: A solid granite pillar with a star carved into its face, unbroken under falling meteors that shatter against it.

name: Greater Resolve
description: Your proficiency rank for Will saves increases to legendary.
icon_brief: An unblinking eye inside a triple-banded gold-and-silver ring, storms of violet mental energy breaking around it.

name: Incredible Senses
description: Your proficiency rank for Perception increases to legendary.
icon_brief: A wide-open eye whose iris is a full star chart, rays of perception reaching every corner of a dark sky.

name: Legendary Stargazer
description: Your proficiency rank for your Stargazer DC increases to legendary.
icon_brief: A silver star crowned with three gold rings and a laurel of tiny stars, blazing at the center of a spiral galaxy.

name: Lightning Reflexes
description: Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to expert.
icon_brief: A shooting star streaking past, a hand snapping aside just in time, motion blur in silver and blue.

name: Master Stargazer
description: Your proficiency rank for your Stargazer DC increases to master.
icon_brief: A silver star circled by two concentric rings with engraved zodiac ticks, brighter than the stars around it.

name: Night Vigil
description: The Sky turns without you. One of thirteen skies is up each day, its aspect is Quiet, Benefic, Retrograde, Malefic or Exalted, rolled at the weights in §8.2. Almost nobody can tell which. During your daily preparations, spend 10 minutes observing the sky. (Indoors, underground or under cloud there is no sky to observe, and your chart is not a substitute — see Clouded Sky .) You gain three things: Certainty. You learn today’s sign and its aspect exactly. No check, no DC, no ambiguity. The Forecast. You learn the sign and aspect of the next three days . The sky is fixed before anyone looks at it, so this answer does not change if you ask again. Augury of the Day. You add the ascendant sign’s Augury to your repertoire until your next daily preparations. On a Starless sky you gain no Augury of the Day — but nothing is written, so you may roll your Portent twice and keep either result. Forewarned. You may spend a further 10 minutes briefing up to five allies. You and each ally who listens reduce the day’s negative aspect by one step for the rest of the day: Malefic → Retrograde , Retrograde → no effect . Positive aspects are unchanged. Clouded Sky. If you cannot complete a Night Vigil you learn nothing, gain no Augury of the Day, get no forecast, and cannot use Forewarned. The GM marks a clouded night on the Sky tracker. Runs by itself when you Rest for the Night: the card is whispered to you, with Forewarned as a button on it.
icon_brief: A lone telescope on a hilltop at night, a lantern beside it, thirteen faint signs arcing across the sky above with one lit brightly.

name: Resolve
description: Your proficiency rank for Will saves increases to master.
icon_brief: A calm eye within two concentric silver rings, a wave of violet fear-mist parting harmlessly around it.

name: Second Star
description: Your focus pool increases to 2 Focus Points . (The third, as for every published class, comes from a class feat — Conjunction , 8th.)
icon_brief: Two stars twinned on a dark sky, the second newly kindling beside the first, a faint focus-ring of light around both.

name: Star Chart
description: You carry an astrolabe, a star-map, a tattoo, or a memorised sky. You gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point and the Auguries you learn. Auguries are focus spells with the prediction trait; their rank is always half your level rounded up, and they use your Stargazer DC and your Wisdom modifier for spell attack rolls and DCs. You Refocus by reading the sky, or your chart, for 10 minutes. You also know 5 occult cantrips , chosen when you take the class, cast at will at a rank of half your level rounded up. You can change one cantrip during your daily preparations. Your Auguries and cantrips live in the Star Chart spellcasting entry, which appears when you take the class. Add your five cantrips to it from the occult list.
icon_brief: A brass astrolabe set on an unrolled star map, its rete pointing to a glowing sigil, a focus point of light pooled at its center.

name: Stargazer's Path
description: Four Paths. Each grants an ability at 1st , 5th , 13th and 17th level.
icon_brief: A crossroads of four starlit roads seen from above, each ending at a different emblem: a loom, an open book, a herald's horn, a broken thread.

name: Surer Thread
description: Fortune's Thread's bonus and penalty increase to ±2 .
icon_brief: A thread of fate doubled and twisted tight, gold and violet strands braided, glowing with a stronger sheen than a single strand.

name: Threefold Thread
description: Fortune's Thread affects three creatures with a single reaction, in any combination of Guide and Snarl. Twin Fates still affects two.
icon_brief: Three threads of fate fanning from one fingertip to three distant points, gold and violet mixed, all pulled taut at once.

name: Twin Fates
description: Once per 10 minutes, when you use Fortune's Thread, you may instead make it a true fortune or misfortune effect for up to two of its targets : each rolls twice and takes the higher result (Guide) or the lower result (Snarl). This replaces the bonus or penalty for those targets, and Snarl's restriction to attack rolls, skill checks and Perception still applies. If a fortune effect and a misfortune effect would apply to the same roll, the two cancel each other out.
icon_brief: Two d20s hanging from a single forked thread, one gold glowing with the higher roll, one violet showing the lower.

name: Vigilant Senses
description: Your proficiency rank for Perception increases to master.
icon_brief: An eye open in the dark with two bands of silver around it, faint shapes in the shadows outlined by thin starlight.

name: Weapon Expertise
description: Your proficiency ranks for unarmed attacks and simple weapons increase to expert.
icon_brief: A simple wooden staff and a bare fist crossed, both etched with small silver stars, a banded ring of expertise behind.

name: Widen the Sky
description: Fortune's Thread's range increases to 60 feet , and when you use it you may affect two creatures with the same reaction, in any combination — two Guides, two Snarls, or one of each. Both must be within range and you must be able to see both. It is still a single reaction, and Snarl's restriction to attack rolls, skill checks and Perception still applies.
icon_brief: A thread of fate splitting into two from one hand, reaching across a wider arc of night sky, its range drawn as a wide silver circle.

name: Deja Vu
description: Frequency once per 10 minutes Trigger You fail, but do not critically fail, a check. Effect Reroll it. This is a fortune effect. Offered as a button when it triggers.
icon_brief: A d20 with a translucent afterimage of itself offset behind it, a curved arrow looping the failed roll back for another throw.

name: Doubled Strand
description: Chart the Course names two creatures instead of one, and three from 11th level. You may use its free Fortune's Thread once for each of them.
icon_brief: A star chart with two separate dotted courses plotted at once, two compasses pinning two marked stars, threads running to both.

name: Every Sky Ever Read
description: Once per hour, ask the GM one yes-or-no question about the next hour. The answer is true . (If the GM genuinely has not decided, the answer is “not yet written,” and the use is not spent.)
icon_brief: A towering stack of star charts and almanacs whose top page glows with a single question mark answered by a bright star.

name: Foregone Conclusion
description: Once per round, when you Snarl an attack roll and the attack misses, the attacker is off-guard until the end of its turn.
icon_brief: An arrow bending away from its target as a violet thread snags it, the attacker's silhouette left open and exposed, a small cracked shield icon.

name: Herald's Omen
description: You learn Coiling Doubt , and it does not count against your Auguries known. In addition, once per round, when a creature critically fails a roll you affected with Snarl , it takes persistent mental damage equal to your Wisdom modifier .
icon_brief: A herald's horn blowing violet smoke shaped like a coiled serpent, a falling d20 cracking where the smoke touches it.

name: Knotted Thread
description: When you Guide an ally with Fortune's Thread, they also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the next attack made against them before the start of your next turn.
icon_brief: A gold thread tied in a protective knot that flares into a small shield of light, warding off an incoming blade.

name: Perfect Recall
description: You can Recall Knowledge using Astronomy Lore in place of any other Knowledge skill, at a −2 circumstance penalty; the penalty goes away at 7th level when Astronomy Lore reaches Master. Your first Recall Knowledge against any creature each combat is a free action . Toggle In place of another skill on the check to take the penalty.
icon_brief: A memory palace of stars — a glowing constellation map inside a silhouetted head's outline, one star flaring as a fact is recalled.

name: Second Sight
description: Deja Vu can instead trigger on a failed check by an ally within 30 feet that you can see.
icon_brief: A second faint eye opening beside the first, its gaze reaching an ally's falling d20 and looping it back for a reroll.

name: Sentence Passed
description: Once per 10 minutes, 1 creature within 60 feet, Will save against your Stargazer DC. Failure For 1 minute the target treats every natural 20 as a natural 10 and cannot benefit from fortune effects. Critical Failure As failure, and it is doomed 1 .
icon_brief: A judge's gavel made of starlight striking a d20, its 20 face cracking into a dull 10, dark chains of doom around it.

name: Skein of Fates
description: Fortune's Thread affects one additional creature with a single reaction — three from 13th, and four once Threefold Thread arrives at 17th. The extra target does not extend Twin Fates or Tapestry .
icon_brief: A loose skein of many threads of fate wound in a ball, strands unspooling toward several points at once, gold and violet.

name: Tapestry
description: Once per 10 minutes, Fortune's Thread affects every ally within 60 feet (Guide) or every enemy within 60 feet (Snarl). One reaction, one choice, everyone. Offered in Fortune's Thread's picker when it is ready.
icon_brief: A vast woven tapestry of the battlefield in gold and violet threads, every figure stitched to the weaver's loom at once.

name: The Almanac
description: Night Vigil's forecast reaches seven days instead of three, and you may determine what the sky was on any past day you were alive for. The Vigil card offers a button to read a past day.
icon_brief: A thick leather almanac open to a seven-day spread of sky forecasts, back pages flipping to past dates, a bookmark ribbon of starlight.

name: The Announcement
description: You can Demoralize using Astronomy Lore instead of Intimidation, at a range of 60 feet, with no auditory or visual requirement — you are not shouting, you are reading out a date. Use this to Demoralize your target with Astronomy Lore.
icon_brief: An open scroll held out, a date read aloud in glowing letters that ripple outward like a shockwave of dread.

name: The Broken Thread
description: I have already lost you once. Your Path grants an ability at 1st, 5th, 13th and 17th level.
icon_brief: A single thread of fate snapped in two, the frayed ends glowing, a clock with its hands reversing behind the break.

name: The Ephemeris
description: I have read every sky. Ask me anything. Your Path grants an ability at 1st, 5th, 13th and 17th level.
icon_brief: An ephemeris table — columns of star positions in silver ink — with an eye at its center that has read every line.

name: The Herald
description: I do not curse them. I announce what is coming. Your Path grants an ability at 1st, 5th, 13th and 17th level.
icon_brief: A herald's long horn against the night sky, a banner hanging from it embroidered with an omen sigil, dark stars falling behind.

name: The Long Way Round
description: Unmake the Moment may rewind to the start of any creature’s last turn, not only your own — declare which as you use it. In addition, once per week, you may use Unmake the Moment while dead , if you died during the round it would undo.
icon_brief: A long silver thread winding back on itself in a loop through several clock faces, one of them belonging to someone else, rewinding.

name: The Weaver
description: Fate is a fabric, and I have hands. Your Path grants an ability at 1st, 5th, 13th and 17th level.
icon_brief: A loom strung with gold and violet threads, its weave forming a constellation, a shuttle of starlight passing through.

name: Unmade Again
description: Unmake the Moment can be used twice per day , and you are no longer drained 1 when it resolves. You are still stunned 1.
icon_brief: Two clock faces spinning backward one after the other, a double rewind arrow wrapping both, silver sparks flying off.

name: Written Down
description: When you critically succeed at a Recall Knowledge check, you and all allies who can hear you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all d20 rolls against that creature type for 1 minute. You may also use Fortune's Thread on a Recall Knowledge check after the roll but before the GM answers .
icon_brief: A quill writing a creature's true name in glowing ink, the letters lifting off the page and drifting to allies as small stars.

name: Effect: Alms of Fate
description: Your next damaging effect before the end of the Stargazer's next turn rerolls every 1 and 2 on its damage dice, and keeps the new results.
icon_brief: Damage dice hovering over a weapon, the low faces flickering and flipping to higher numbers, a faint coin of starlight above.

name: Effect: Borrowed Second
description: +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of the Stargazer's next turn.
icon_brief: A faint silver second hand circling a creature like a halo, a thin translucent barrier shimmering in front of it.

name: Effect: Coiling Doubt
description: The next attack roll or skill check is rolled twice, taking the lower.
icon_brief: A single coil of violet thread tightening around a creature's hand just before a roll, a cracked d20 at its fingertips.

name: Effect: Coiling Doubt (Lingering)
description: The first attack roll or skill check each round is rolled twice, taking the lower.
icon_brief: A violet serpent-thread wound loosely around a creature's wrist, a pulse of doubt flaring each round, two dice shown, the lower lit.

name: Effect: Crown of Fire
description: +2 status bonus to Intimidation and Performance. You can Demoralize at 60 feet with no auditory or visual requirement and no penalty for a shared-language failure.
icon_brief: A small crown of burning stars floating over the creature's head, flame-rays pulsing out like a roar.

name: Effect: Crown's Blessing
description: Crown of Fire: +1 status bonus to your next roll.
icon_brief: A single ember falling from a crown of fire onto an ally's open palm, glowing gold, a tiny +1 spark rising from it.

name: Effect: Deep Dream
description: +2 status bonus to Will saves and to Perception checks to disbelieve illusions.
icon_brief: A closed eye wrapped in drifting indigo dream-mist, silver constellations reflected on its lid, an illusory mask dissolving into stardust in front of it.

name: Effect: Deep Dream (Reprieve)
description: Once during Deep Dream: a critical failure on a Will save is a failure. Spent when it happens.
icon_brief: A sleeping mind drawn as a crescent moon over indigo water, one bright silver star catching a falling shard of a broken mirror just before it hits the surface.

name: Effect: Fate's Favourite
description: Your next d20 roll is a natural 20.
icon_brief: A d20 frozen mid-tumble, its 20 face blazing gold, a single shooting star streaking down to land on that face against a deep indigo sky.

name: Effect: First Blood (Initiative)
description: +2 status bonus to the next initiative roll within the hour.
icon_brief: A dawn star rising ahead of a row of dim stars, a silver arrowhead of light pointing forward, the first of a line to move.

name: Effect: First Blood (Strike)
description: The first Strike of the encounter that hits deals extra spirit damage. Spent when it lands.
icon_brief: A blade edge touched by a single falling star, a pale spectral spark bursting at the point of first contact, faint blue spirit light trailing.

name: Effect: Guiding Star
description: +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, Perception checks and skill checks (+2 from the 10th-rank Augury), until the start of the Stargazer's next turn.
icon_brief: A single brilliant eight-pointed star shining down a beam of soft gold light, a silver path of smaller stars leading toward it across the night.

name: Effect: Hunted by the Sky
description: Hunted: it cannot be concealed or hidden from the Stargazer; the Stargazer and allies gain +1 circumstance to Seek it; the first attack against it each round gains +1 circumstance; the Stargazer's Snarl against it is −3, or −4 with Surer Thread.
icon_brief: A dark silhouette pinned in a cone of cold starlight from above, a ring of constellation lines closing around it like a net, nowhere to hide.

name: Effect: Iron Auspice
description: +2 status bonus to Fortitude saves and to Athletics checks to Shove, Trip and Grapple; temporary Hit Points equal to three times the Stargazer's level.
icon_brief: A body outline plated in dark iron starmetal, a glowing red-gold planet (Mars-like) above it, a layer of shimmering temporary armour around the edges.

name: Effect: Iron Auspice (Reprieve)
description: Once during Iron Auspice: a critical failure on a Fortitude save is a failure. Spent when it happens.
icon_brief: An iron shield-plate stamped with a star, cracked down the middle but held together by a single silver thread pulled tight across the crack.

name: Effect: Knotted Thread
description: +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the next attack before the start of the Stargazer's next turn.
icon_brief: A silver fate-thread tied into a tight knot that a sword-point strikes and glances off, a small shield of light flaring at the knot.

name: Effect: Perfect Ledger
description: +2 circumstance bonus to the next Recall Knowledge before the end of the Stargazer's next turn, which is a free action. A critical success also reveals the creature's lowest saving throw and all its weaknesses.
icon_brief: An open ledger of star charts with one entry glowing gold, a quill of light underlining a creature's sketched outline and its weak points circled.

name: Effect: Poured Knowing
description: +2 status bonus to Arcana, Nature, Occultism, Religion and Society.
icon_brief: A silver ewer tipped over a head-shaped outline, a stream of tiny glowing glyphs and runes pouring in, five symbols (arcane rune, leaf, eye, sun, scroll) orbiting.

name: Effect: Remembered Ending
description: You were in the erased timeline: +2 circumstance bonus to your first d20 roll of the re-run encounter.
icon_brief: A torn page of a battle map, the erased half ghosted in faint silver, a single gold star kept in a hand as the scene redraws.

name: Effect: Remembered Initiative
description: You were in the erased timeline: +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll.
icon_brief: A broken hourglass whose sand flows back up, one grain glowing gold and leaping ahead of the rest like a starting signal.

name: Effect: Sentence Passed
description: For 1 minute this creature treats every natural 20 as a natural 10 and cannot benefit from fortune effects.
icon_brief: A d20 with its 20 face crossed out and overwritten as a dull 10, a black gavel-shaped star above, the die's glow snuffed to grey.

name: Effect: Shell of Hours
description: +2 status bonus to saves against disease and poison. Once : the first time this creature would be reduced to 0 Hit Points it is reduced to 1 Hit Point instead, and the Augury ends for it.
icon_brief: A translucent egg-like shell made of clock faces wrapped around a small figure, green poison droplets beading off it, one hand of the clock stopped at the brink.

name: Effect: Shouted Warning
description: A Stargazer who has seen this round already shouted a warning: +2 circumstance bonus to your next roll this round.
icon_brief: An open mouth-shape of starlight sending out concentric silver sound rings, a raised exclamation-star in the middle, an incoming blade dimly visible.

name: Effect: Star Chart Dark
description: Your Star Chart is dark: no Night Vigil, Fortune's Thread, Chart the Course, Portent, Auguries or Focus Points until a full 8-hour Night Vigil under open sky. Your drained and doomed cannot be reduced before then.
icon_brief: A star chart scroll gone black, its constellations faded to ash-grey dots, a covered moon behind heavy clouds, a single candle snuffed beside it.

name: Effect: Star-Marked
description: Marked by a Stargazer's Star-Marked Enemy: Coiling Doubt and Snarl reach it wherever it is known to be, until their next daily preparations.
icon_brief: A creature's shadow branded with a glowing silver star sigil, a thin line of light linking it to a distant watching star far overhead.

name: Effect: The Hour Is Not Come (Immune)
description: Cannot benefit from The Hour Is Not Come again for 10 minutes.
canon_source: Stargazer — The Hour Is Not Come — spent
icon_brief: A pocket watch closed and chained shut, its face greyed out, a small ten-minute arc of dim silver light marking when it can open again.

name: Effect: Two Roads
description: The first skill check before the end of the Stargazer's next turn is rolled twice, keeping the higher — saving throws too, from the 5th-rank Augury.
icon_brief: A starlit path forking in two, two d20s rolling down each branch, the brighter one's road lit gold while the other fades.

name: Effect: Written in Advance
description: Your next skill check within the hour is an automatic success, not a critical success.
icon_brief: A page on which a check mark is already inked before the hand reaches it, a quill of starlight hovering, the ink glowing silver.

name: Fate's Favourite
description: Once per day, treat one d20 roll you make as a natural 20 . You saw this. Post this to chat before the roll: your next d20 is a natural 20.
icon_brief: A hand releasing a d20 that already shows a golden 20 before it lands, a halo of stars around it and a chat-scroll banner reading the prophecy.

name: Two Warnings
description: You gain a second reaction each round, usable only for Fortune's Thread , The Last Thing You See , or The Hour Is Not Come .
icon_brief: Two silver warning bells ringing together under a star, each sending out its own wave of light.

name: Unspent Thread
description: If you have not used your reaction by the start of your turn, your first Chart the Course that turn is a free action .
icon_brief: A spool of fate-thread still full and glowing, a silver compass needle springing off it to chart a course on a star map.

name: Wide Vigil
description: Forewarned has no limit on the number of allies you may brief, and briefing takes 1 minute.
icon_brief: A lantern of starlight held high, its warm circle widening outward to cover many small shield-emblems of allies.

name: Cascade
description: You gain Twin Fates (§4.13) now, affecting one of its targets. From 15th level, when the class feature arrives, Twin Fates affects up to three of its targets instead of two.
icon_brief: A single silver fate-thread splitting into a branching waterfall of threads, gold and purple strands cascading down onto several small target marks at once.

name: Long Now
description: Your Auguries whose Duration line reads 1 minute last 10 minutes . A duration inside a degree of success, such as Coiling Doubt 's critical failure, does not change.
icon_brief: An hourglass stretched tall and thin, its sand falling very slowly, a single minute-mark on its side multiplied into ten silver lines.

name: Prophesied Ally
description: Choose one ally during your Night Vigil. Fortune's Thread used on that ally does not consume your reaction, once per round. Your Night Vigil card offers the choice.
icon_brief: A silver fate-thread tied between a star and a shield-shaped ally emblem, a loop of thread looping freely without breaking.

name: Echo of the Unmade
description: When you use Unmake the Moment , you may also grant one ally the memory of the erased round. They keep it; everyone else does not.
icon_brief: A shattered moment of glass reassembling, one shard kept glowing in a second hand, a faint ghost-echo of the erased round inside it.

name: Inevitable
description: Once per day, when a creature critically succeeds at a check against you, it gets a success instead. This is a misfortune effect. Offered as a button when it triggers.
icon_brief: A rising golden spark of triumph pressed down by a heavy dark star, the critical burst flattened into an ordinary flicker.

name: Star-Marked Enemy
description: Choose one creature you can see. Until your next daily preparations, Coiling Doubt and Snarl against it do not require line of sight, only knowledge of its location. For Snarl, this replaces Fortune's Thread's requirement that you can see the creature. Target the creature and post this to chat to mark it.
icon_brief: A silver star brand burned onto a red target emblem, a thread of light linking it across a wall to a far-off watching eye.

name: Foretold Escape
description: Once per day, when an attack roll against you would deal damage that reduces you to 0 Hit Points, you may Speak the Portent on that attack roll even though it has already been rolled, even if your Portent is spent, and even if a fortune or misfortune effect altered it — using a value of 1. It cannot be used on your own saving throw, or on damage no attack roll dealt.
icon_brief: An attacking blade stopping a hair's breadth short as a silver fate-thread loops around it, the target's outline stepping aside under a protective star.

name: Private Sign
description: Add a fourteenth sign to the wheel: your own. Choose one Augury from §5.2 for it to grant and one existing sign's domain for it to govern; it should be an Augury you would not otherwise take. It rises only over you, on days the sky is Starless, and uses the standard aspect scaling. Its aspect is rolled in advance with the day, as part of the seven-day queue. Your two choices are asked when you take the feat. On a Starless day your Augury of the Day is its Augury, and the Sky applies its domain to you at its aspect.
icon_brief: A thirteen-sign zodiac wheel with a fourteenth, unique glyph added in personal violet ink, its star shining only over a single small point.

name: Written in Advance
description: Spend 10 minutes. The next skill check you attempt within the hour is an automatic success (not a critical success). You already did this. Post this to chat after the 10 minutes.
icon_brief: A book open to a page whose ink is already dry, the quill resting beside it and a sand-timer showing ten minutes already spent.

name: The Long Vigil
description: Rewrite the Ending 's cooldown drops to 3 days if you have not used it at all during the current adventure.
icon_brief: A lantern burning through many nights, its flame shaped like a star, a calendar of moons with only three crossed off before it can be lit again.

name: Two Skies
description: During your Night Vigil, read the sky twice . Both signs are ascendant for you and the allies you brief: you gain both Auguries of the Day. The second sign and its aspect are rolled in advance with the day, as part of the seven-day queue.
icon_brief: Two zodiac signs rising at once over the same horizon, one silver and one gold, their light overlapping in the middle.

name: Unbroken Chain
description: Unmake the Moment recharges on a 10-minute rest rather than on your Night Vigil, but no more than once per hour.
icon_brief: A chain of silver links each shaped like a tiny clock face, unbroken, looping back on itself in a ring around a cracked moment of glass.

name: Astrological Sign
description: Once per day, when you record your Portent, you may treat its value as any number within 3 of what you rolled. Your Night Vigil card offers the values when you have this feat.
icon_brief: A zodiac wheel with a d20 at its centre, a small silver dial nudging the die's number up or down by a few notches.

name: Cold Read
description: You can attempt a Deception check to invent a prophecy convincingly. The GM rolls a secret Astronomy Lore check for you at the same time; on a critical success, you were accidentally right , and the GM should treat what you said as true. Post this to chat: it rolls your Deception, and a secret Astronomy Lore check for the GM.
icon_brief: A theatrical mask half smiling, its hand gesturing at a crystal ball, behind which a real constellation accidentally lights up and matches the gesture.

name: Companion of the Watch
description: You gain a familiar. It has the celestial trait and you gain one extra familiar ability, which must be an ability that gathers or carries information. Your familiar is made for you when you take this feat, with the celestial trait. The extra ability is counted on your sheet; pick one that gathers or carries information.
icon_brief: A small celestial owl with star-speckled feathers perched on a brass telescope, a tiny scroll of notes tied to its leg.

name: Sky Reader
description: Your Night Vigil takes 1 minute instead of 10, and Forewarned takes 1 minute instead of 10.
icon_brief: A brass sextant swung quickly across the night sky, motion streaks and a tiny sand-timer showing the reading done in a moment.

name: Star-Touched Cantrip
description: You learn one additional occult cantrip, and may swap it during daily preparations. Your Night Vigil card offers the swap.
icon_brief: A small spark-spell cupped in a palm, sprinkled with stardust and gaining a single tiny silver star at its heart.

name: Cartographer of Endings
description: Once per day, ask the GM one yes-or-no question about the next 24 hours . The answer is true.
icon_brief: A map drawn on a night sky with a single road ending at a glowing gold point, a question mark of stars above answered by one bright yes/no star.

name: Fixed Sky
description: One of your Portents is always a 20 , and you may speak that one only once per week . Any other Portents you record, from Twin Portent or Second Portent , are still rolled and spoken daily.
icon_brief: A single star nailed in place with a silver pin at the centre of a rotating sky, the d20 beneath it locked on 20 while the other stars wheel.

name: The Sky Answers
description: Once per day, when you would use Rewrite the Ending , you may instead use Unmake the Moment without spending its frequency, and Rewrite the Ending is not expended.
icon_brief: A night sky opening like a curtain to drop a single bright star into a waiting hand, a quill and a broken hourglass side by side below.

name: Augury Adept
description: You learn one additional Augury.
icon_brief: An augury scroll with one new sign-glyph blooming into light among the older ones, a silver star pinning it to the chart.

name: Patient Watcher
description: When you Refocus, you may also change one of your known Auguries. Post this to chat, or Refocus, to swap an Augury.
icon_brief: A meditating hand turning one card of a ring of augury cards face-down and another face-up, a quiet moon overhead.

name: Reckoning of Days
description: You can attempt an Astronomy Lore check to determine the sky of yesterday or of a day more than three days out, as far as the end of the seven-day queue, at the DCs in §8.4. Post this to chat to choose the day and roll.
icon_brief: A row of seven small sky-discs like a calendar strip, one past day and one far-future day lit, an astrolabe sighting along them.

name: Thread of Warning
description: Fortune's Thread can trigger on an initiative roll , even though positions are not yet set and you may not be able to see the roller. Fortune's Thread offers its next initiative roll , at any range.
icon_brief: A taut silver tripwire of fate thread across the start of a battle line, plucked and ringing with light before anyone moves.

name: Twin Portent
description: Roll two d20s at your Night Vigil and record both as separate Portents. You must spend both before your next Vigil or lose them, and Speak the Portent 's frequency becomes twice per day.
icon_brief: Two d20s glowing side by side in a starry bowl, each with a different number, joined by a forked silver ribbon.

name: Borrowed Eyes
description: You can perform a Night Vigil through the senses of your familiar or a willing ally under an open sky, as long as you are within 1 mile of them. On a clouded night, your Vigil card asks the GM to let you read through them.
icon_brief: An owl's eye reflecting a starry sky, a silver thread of sight running from it to a distant closed human eye, constellations travelling along the thread.

name: Omen of Blades
description: When you Snarl an attack roll and the attack still hits, you may spend 1 Focus Point to reduce the damage by 2 plus 2 per your Stargazer DC proficiency rank (so 4 at Trained, 6 at Expert, 8 at Master, 10 at Legendary). Offered as a button when a Snarled attack hits.
icon_brief: A sword striking through a purple omen-orb, its edge dulled and slowed as the purple glow absorbs part of the blow, notches counting the damage saved.

name: Read the Room
description: Once per encounter, Sense Motive as a free action . Post this to chat to Sense Motive; once per encounter.
icon_brief: A single watching eye whose iris is a tiny constellation, faint coloured auras of intent rising from shadowy figures around it.

name: Widened Chart
description: Chart the Course has a range of 120 feet and no longer requires you to see the creature, only to know where it is.
icon_brief: A star chart unrolled very wide, a dotted line of course drawn from one edge to a target mark hidden behind a cloud.

name: Long Thread
description: Fortune's Thread's range increases by 30 feet.
icon_brief: A silver fate-thread uncoiling far across a starry field from a spindle, a ruler-like measure of extra distance glowing along its length.

name: Prophecy's Weight
description: You can Demoralize using Astronomy Lore, at 60 feet, with no auditory or visual requirement. (The Herald gets this at 5th; this feat exists for everyone else.) Use this to Demoralize your target with Astronomy Lore.
icon_brief: A pointing hand of starlight casting a long shadow of a doom-glyph over a cowering foe, ominous constellation lines pressing down.

name: Second Chance at Fate
description: Once per day, when a creature within 30 feet critically fails a check, you may have it reroll and use the new result. This is a fortune effect. You might want it to succeed. Offered as a button when it triggers.
icon_brief: A d20 showing a cracked 1 being rerolled by a silver hand, a second die mid-air glowing with a new chance.

name: Sky Anchor
description: You can perform a Night Vigil with no sky at all. Clouded Sky never applies to you.
icon_brief: An anchor cast from silver starlight sinking through thick grey clouds, its chain fastened to an unseen star beyond them.

name: Conjunction
description: Your focus pool increases to 3 Focus Points , the game's maximum.
icon_brief: Three planets aligning in a straight line across a dark sky, their light merging into one brilliant point, three focus pips glowing beneath.

name: Doubled Reading
description: Once per day you may take the better of two Auguries of the Day by reading both today's sign and tomorrow's. Your Night Vigil card offers tomorrow's Augury.
icon_brief: Two zodiac wheels overlapping like a Venn diagram — today's silver, tomorrow's pale gold — the brighter overlap chosen.

name: Second Portent
description: You may Speak the Portent twice per day. If you also have Twin Portent , you may speak three times, and you record three Portents.
icon_brief: Two prophecy scrolls unrolling side by side, each sealed with a star-wax seal showing a different number.

name: The Stargazer: Handbook
description: You read the sky, and the sky is not kind. Every dawn one of thirteen signs rises with an aspect — Quiet, Benefic, Retrograde, Malefic or Exalted — and it tilts one narrow domain for everyone under it, the ogre in the cave included. Nobody else at the table knows what today is. You do. Mechanically: 8 Hit Points per level, expert Perception, expert Will, trained Fortitude and Reflex, simple weapons and light armour, and a Stargazer DC keyed to Wisdom. Your output is a number on somebody else's sheet: a +1 there, a −1 here, a 20 exactly where it is needed. Night Vigil — every night, the day's sign and aspect, the next three days, your Portent and your Augury of the Day, whispered to you. Fortune's Thread — a reaction: Guide an ally's d20 (+1) or Snarl an enemy's (−1). Portent — a d20 rolled at the Vigil that you spend as somebody else's die. Auguries — focus spells that bend the next few rolls. A Path at 1st — the Weaver, the Herald, the Ephemeris or the Broken Thread. Unmake the Moment at 11th and Rewrite the Ending at 19th — the round, and then the whole encounter, undone. Fortune's Thread acts on a d20 before it is rolled , and Foundry has no such moment — a roll resolves the instant it is clicked. So you arm it in advance: post Fortune's Thread with the creature targeted, choose Guide or Snarl and which roll it waits for, and the next matching roll takes it. The reaction is spent then, not when you arm it. One reaction arms as many creatures as your Thread can affect. Snarl reaches attack rolls, skill checks and Perception, never a saving throw. An armed Thread expires at the start of your next turn. You cannot arm one with no reaction left. Chart the Course names creatures and arms each with a free Thread, spent by that creature's first d20. Speak the Portent is armed the same way, on a creature and a roll type; it waits until spoken or until your next Vigil overwrites it. A Portent of 20 is a natural 20. At the table Declare a standing policy at the start of each fight — "I Snarl the first attack against Kesh each round" — and change it out loud. Otherwise every d20 in the game pauses for "wait — reaction?" , and the class eats the table's clock. GM: announce a roll before you make it. The Thread triggers before the die. Rolling fast behind a screen turns the class off; this is the same courtesy Aid and the Champion's reaction already need. Reactions that answer something that already happened — The Last Thing You See , The Hour Is Not Come , Deja Vu , Inevitable , Second Chance at Fate , Omen of Blades — are not armed. When they trigger, a button appears in your whispers. The Vigil runs by itself when you Rest for the Night . Its card, whispered to you, carries today's sign and aspect exactly, the forecast, your Portents and the Augury of the Day, and the buttons you act on afterwards: Forewarned (brief up to five allies, who take the day's bad aspect one step milder), and from 13th Trade the Day . A clouded night reads nothing. Indoors, underground or under cloud, the GM ticks Clouded on the Sky tracker before you rest. A chart read indoors is not a Vigil. GM: turn announceSky off The module posts the day's sign to chat by default, which is right for a table running only the Saint. With a Stargazer at the table, turn it off in the module settings: the Vigil's certainty is the class, and it is worth nothing if chat gives it away for free. With it off, the day is whispered to every player who owns a Stargazer. The Sky's effects then appear on every sheet as a blank The Sky — players see that something is on them, not what. Let them get it wrong for months; the folklore is the point. Reading the sky without the class Anyone can try: ten minutes under an open sky and an Astronomy Lore or Occultism Recall Knowledge check against the region's Hard DC, 5 lower on an Exalted or Malefic day. A critical success learns the sign and aspect, a success the sign, a critical failure a wrong sign — confidently. The Read the Sky macro in the Stargazer's macro pack rolls it for any selected character, secretly, and whispers what they learn. The Stargazer's Reckoning of Days automates the same reading for yesterday and for days four to seven out. Every dawn Advance the day on the Sky tracker as part of your morning routine. If you skip one, do not retcon it — the sky was cloudy. Auguries are occult focus spells with the prediction trait. You learn one at 1st and more at 5th, 7th, 9th and every other level to 19th; each Vigil adds the Augury of the Day — the rising sign's — until your next daily preparations, unless you already know it. On a Starless night none is granted (from 13th you choose any). Refocus — post pf2e's Refocus action — restores one Focus Point. Chosen at 1st; each grants an ability at 1st, 5th, 13th and 17th, and they come and go with your level. Path 1st 5th 13th 17th The Weaver Fate is a fabric, and I have hands. Knotted Thread Doubled Strand Skein of Fates Tapestry The Herald I do not curse them. I announce what is coming. Herald's Omen The Announcement Sentence Passed Foregone Conclusion The Ephemeris I have read every sky. Ask me anything. Perfect Recall The Almanac Written Down Every Sky Ever Read The Broken Thread I have already lost you once. Deja Vu Second Sight Unmade Again The Long Way Round Stargazer feats come at 1st, 2nd, 4th and every even level to 20th. Several are used by posting them to chat (Cold Read, Read the Room, Fate's Favourite, Written in Advance, Star-Marked Enemy, Patient Watcher, Reckoning of Days); several offer a button when they trigger (Omen of Blades, Second Chance at Fate, Inevitable, Foretold Escape); the Vigil card carries the rest (Astrological Sign, Doubled Reading, Prophesied Ally, Borrowed Eyes, the Star-Touched Cantrip swap). Level Feats 1 Astrological Sign, Cold Read, Companion of the Watch, Sky Reader, Star-Touched Cantrip 2 Augury Adept, Patient Watcher, Reckoning of Days, Thread of Warning, Twin Portent 4 Borrowed Eyes, Omen of Blades, Read the Room, Widened Chart 6 Long Thread, Prophecy's Weight, Second Chance at Fate, Sky Anchor 8 Conjunction, Doubled Reading, Second Portent 10 Fate's Favourite, Two Warnings, Unspent Thread, Wide Vigil 12 Cascade, Long Now, Prophesied Ally 14 Echo of the Unmade, Inevitable, Star-Marked Enemy 16 Foretold Escape, Private Sign, Written in Advance 18 The Long Vigil, Two Skies, Unbroken Chain 20 Cartographer of Endings, Fixed Sky, The Sky Answers Tier 1 — The Dream (a GM technique) Not a button. With the Stargazer's player's permission: the Night Vigil produces a vision the player does not get to interpret — an image, a name, a colour; write it down. When the party is about to do something catastrophic, run the bad timeline for real, and let it end badly. Then the Stargazer wakes at their Vigil and it is undone. The players keep every piece of information they learned. Once per adventure or arc at most, and only when the GM starts it — if a player can invoke it, they will ask "is this a bad ending?" at every fork. Tier 2 — Unmake the Moment (11th) As your turn begins, a card offers to rewind to the start of your last turn . Pressing it puts the board back — Hit Points, conditions, effects, resources, positions, the turn, the clock — and deletes tokens and actors created since; the chat log stays. You are stunned 1 and drained 1, and you may shout a warning worth +2 to one ally's next roll. Once per day; it recharges at your Vigil. Tier 3 — Rewrite the Ending (19th) When you or an ally within 60 feet dies, or the party falls, post it; the GM confirms . The encounter goes back to the moment initiative was rolled, everyone rolls initiative again, and each ally who was there takes +2 to that roll and to their first d20. Your Star Chart goes dark: drained 2 and doomed 1 that cannot be reduced, no Focus Points, no Threads, Chart, Portent or Vigil — until a Vigil the GM marks as the full eight hours under open sky . Once per week of the Sky's dawns. GM: what to know The snapshots live in your client's memory. The module takes them at each Stargazer's turn and when an encounter starts. Reloading your browser forgets them , and the rewinds will say there is nothing to go back to. Do not re-run the enemies' identical dice. Re-run the encounter; it will go differently, and the enemies do not remember. The Long Vigil shortens Rewrite's cooldown in a new adventure: set Stargazer: current adventure in the module settings when one begins. Tell the table Rewrite exists before session one. It is a plot device with a stat block. Nearly everything is automated. What is not: Memory. Who remembers an unmade round is the table's; the cards say who does. The GM's answers. Every Sky Ever Read and Cartographer of Endings ask the GM a question; the module counts the use, the GM answers truly. Darkness. "That you can see" is checked against walls, blindness, and a target that is invisible, hidden, undetected or unnoticed. What a creature can see in dim light or darkness is left to you: pf2e records concealment, not eyesight. Uses. A feat or action with no uses left cannot be posted — the module refuses it. Refilling uses is pf2e's (Rest for the Night) and the module's (every minute, ten minutes and hour); a use the GM hands back is set on the sheet. Companion of the Watch. pf2e 8's familiars have no trait list, so your familiar is celestial as far as rules can read, not on its sheet. Action costs. A free Recall Knowledge, a free Chart the Course: pf2e does not count actions, so neither does the module. In order of how likely each is to bite: Fortune's Thread eats the clock. Standing policies, every combat. Announce rolls before you make them. The class is built on it. You forget the sky. Advance the day every morning. The sky is loud. One day in five is Quiet and 30% are Retrograde. If your table finds it oppressive, move 10 weight from Retrograde to Quiet before abandoning it. The player hoards a Portent of 20. Fine, and the best part of the class — remind them once that a new Vigil overwrites it. 8 Hit Points, light armour, trained Reflex until 13th. The Stargazer dies to fireballs. Intentional; make sure the player knows. Rewrite never comes up , because 19th level. Run the Dream instead. Nobody notices the class is a support. Have the Stargazer's player count "rolls I changed the outcome of" for three sessions.

name: Read the Sky
description: Macro:
icon_brief: A brass sextant aimed at a single rising zodiac sign on the horizon, the sign's glyph lit and its aspect colour glowing around it.

name: Sympathetic Growth (effect)
description: Effect an Assimilator lends an ally: half of one of its resistances, for 10 minutes.
icon_brief: A living membrane of red-and-green tissue grafting from one hand onto another, a shared resistance glyph pulsing in both.

name: Wall of Me (hazard actor)
description: A wall of the Assimilator's own flesh placed on the map (HP 5×level, Hardness = level).
icon_brief: A wall built of fleshy chitin plates and sinew instead of bricks, veins pulsing across its surface, an eye or two blinking in the mortar.

name: Assimilated: … (effect)
description: A trait/resistance taken from a creature, held for the day or permanently.
icon_brief: A stolen trait drawn as a glowing glyph being absorbed into green-veined skin, tendrils wrapping it, a faint outline of the creature it came from.

name: The Thing That Wears … (NPC actor)
description: The symbiont split off as its own creature, using the Carapace Strike.
icon_brief: A mass of glistening carapace and long red teeth peeling away from an empty humanoid outline, standing on its own.

name: Eat the World: … (effect)
description: An eaten item turned into a temporary Mass grant and ability.
icon_brief: A pink-purple orb clutched in clawed hands, the shape of an eaten object dissolving inside it into raw growth-energy.

name: Cosmo (spellcasting entry)
description: The Saint's Technique spellcasting entry, created on the sheet.
icon_brief: A burning orange-gold star of cosmo exploding outward from a clenched fist, a faint constellation of lines behind it.

name: Sky tracker blank icon
description: Fallback icon for the sky tracker when no sign is set (Starless sky).
icon_brief: An empty dark sky with only the faint outline of a star — no constellation, a hollow silhouette waiting to be filled.

name: Reiatsu (spellcasting entry)
description: The Soulbound's Release Technique / Kidō spellcasting entry.
icon_brief: A towering pillar of blue spiritual pressure flaring upward from a sword's guard, the air distorting around it.

name: Star Chart (spellcasting entry)
description: The Stargazer's Augury spellcasting entry.
icon_brief: An unrolled star chart of indigo vellum, constellations linked by silver lines, a blue star blazing where today's Augury is marked.

name: Fixed Point (…) (effect)
description: A fixed-point effect pinning one roll type in place.
icon_brief: A tilted grey hourglass pinned in place by a silver nail of starlight, its sand frozen mid-fall.

name: Omen of Blades (effect)
description: An omen placed on a target by spending Focus.
icon_brief: A purple omen-orb hovering before a creature, a sword's edge slowed and dulled as it passes through the glow.

name: …'s Watcher (familiar actor)
description: The Stargazer's watching familiar (an owl).
icon_brief: A white owl in flight with star-speckled wings, its eyes reflecting two tiny constellations.

name: Foregone Conclusion (effect)
description: Effect marking an attacker whose outcome was foreseen.
icon_brief: An attacker's outline caught in a purple orb, its swing already drawn as a faded afterimage of the outcome.

name: Written Down: … (effect)
description: A briefing written down and shared with allies in earshot.
icon_brief: A small blue notebook open on a page of prophecy notes, copies of the page fluttering out to allies.

name: Fortune's Thread: Guide / Twin Fates (fortune)
description: A fortune thread woven onto an ally.
icon_brief: A golden fate-thread looped gently around an ally's wrist, a bright yellow star at the knot pulling the roll upward.

name: Fortune's Thread: Snarl / Twin Fates (misfortune)
description: A misfortune thread woven onto an enemy.
icon_brief: A purple-black thread snarled into a tangle around an enemy's hand, a dim purple orb weighing the roll down.

name: Portent: … (effect)
description: A stored portent value to be swapped in for a roll.
icon_brief: A teal-ringed eye with a number glowing in its pupil, the stored portent waiting to replace a roll.

description: Temporary immunity after resisting The Last Thing You See.
